**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 As a Program Management Strategy \& Operations Manager/Sr Manager, your work will cut across areas of Strategy, Program planning, Operational excellence, Governance and Enablement. You will help in implementing Global business vision and strategy,
   

  

 This position requires big\-picture thinking, initiative, zeal, attention to detail, the ability to learn quickly, the capacity to handle internal and external relationships, the competence to work with senior executives, and excellent soft skills.
   

  

 Work location: Bangalore/Hyderabad
   

  

 Key Responsibilities

* Manage the partner program, running governance for their performance and effectiveness in meeting GDC requirements.

* Support the Talent Strategy charter in driving enablement programs that create a workforce ready for current and future business requirements

* Hands\-on experience with PM tools like JIRA / MS Project

**Job Title: BA \- Reg Reporting \- Mumbai/Bangalore**
**About Us**
*“Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. Awarded with
 **Consultancy of the year in the British Bank Award** 
 and has been ranked
 **Top 100 Best Companies for Women in India 2022 by***
***Avtar \& Seramount***
*. With our presence across 32 cities across globe, we support 100\+ clients across banking, financial and Energy sectors. We are recognized for our deep transformation execution and delivery.*
***WHY JOIN CAPCO?***
 You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry.
   

  

***MAKE AN IMPACT***
 Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.
   

  

***\#BEYOURSELFATWORK***
 Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity.
   

  

***CAREER ADVANCEMENT***
*With no forced hierarchy at Capco, everyone has the opportunity to grow as we grow, taking their career into their own hands.*
***DIVERSITY \& INCLUSION***
*We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage.*
 Location \- Mumbai /Bangalore
   

  

 Years of Exp \- 7 to 14 Years
   

  

**Role Description**
**Reg BA (JD) –**
 CMT Trade Reporting team is responsible for change management, analysis, definition and delivery of solutions for business requirements resulting from the introduction of new and updated Trade Reporting rules by the various Global Regulatory Bodies, such as HKMA, MIFID2, CFTC, EMIR, and SFTR, working closely alongside the IT function
   

  

* The industry remains under increased regulatory pressure across our businesses as these reporting obligations are put into effect; therefore a substantial amount of cross functional change is required, and is coordinated by the CMT Trade Reporting team to ensure bank adhere to regulatory objectives in the most time, cost, controlled and technologically efficient manner.


**Key Accountabilities**
**Impact on Business**
* The role of the Business Analyst is to support the Project Manager(s), and Product Owners to deliver critical analysis to deliver the relevant project.
* The BA is responsible for the following activities and deliverables:
* Responsible for the end to end analysis for Regulatory Change projects such as (SFTR, HKMA, MiFID, EMIR, CFTC etc) and internal Strategic Architecture implementations
* Work with FO stakeholders, Compliance, Asset Class Business Managers and Technology in order elicit requirements, offer solutions and deliver change to satisfy regulatory demand and ensure sustainable Operational Controls
* Challenge and question required business flows where necessary in order to define an optimal and efficient business processes
* Produce Business Requirements relating to the Reporting of any trades and transactions across major Global Regulators (e.g. SFTR, CFTC, EMIR, HKMA, MAS) to Trade / Swap Data Repositories (e.g. DTCC, Unavista, US SEC, etc).
* Fully document scope of all related business requirements, relating to each deliverable, and ensure these are understood by by business and operational stakeholders and IT teams
* Link with Asset Class Business Managers and Technical Specialists in order to write documents that can then be signed off and used as the basis to construct technical documents used to support the necessary changes.
* Provide input into the generation of test cases to support the Test strategy and support any analysis to resolve defects.
* Work closely with the Product Owners and Architecture teams to ensure all regional deliveries are consistent with the global approach.
* Develop and maintain strong working relationships with key stakeholders (Business, Operations, Compliance, and IT) in understanding the impact of each business initiatives on regulatory reporting.
* Work to ensure potential gaps and issues in solutions are risk assessed, and appropriate solutions/controls are defined. Work with BAU teams to ensure there is an appropriate enduring model for data ownership, exception management, and ongoing maintenance for reporting compliance
* Establish a model that ensures all artefacts and deliveries are of a consistent high quality, .timely and accurate
* Ensure that artefacts are of a suitable level, cohesiveness, and availability to be available to show to auditors, regulators, and evidence how bank is meeting its obligations


**Desired profile**
**Qualifications**
**Knowledge \& Experience / Qualifications**
* Strong business writing skills with ability to communicate complex ideas simply and convincingly, ask insightful questions, break analytical challenges into workable components, and draw meaningful conclusions.
* Highly motivated, with strong organizational, analytical and problem solving skills, possessing follow through, ability to manage, monitor, track, and clearly communicate progress on multiple initiatives
* Experience of Product Based Planning a distinct advantage
* Evidence of effective relationship management (both internal and external)
* Experience in producing both business requirement and functional requirements is essential
* Experience with working as a conduit between Business and Technology teams to ensure requirements are clearly understood and solutions delivered
* Experience within Technology with a track record delivering Regulatory Trade Reporting requirements
* Excellent documentation and communication skills
* Positive ‘can do' attitude, and problem solving ability
* Ability to work effectively to strict timelines and deadlines, and do “whatever it takes” to meet deadlines
* Prior experience of working on a Agile, Trade confirmations, Trade / Transaction Reporting programme susch as CFTC, HKMA, MAS, ASIC, DFA and/or EMIR).
* Awareness of Trade Reporting mechanisms (e.g. connectivity to GTR, FpML etc)


*If you are keen to join us, you will be part of an organization that values your contributions, recognizes your potential, and provides ample opportunities for growth. For more information, visit www.capco.com. Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.*

Position Description
   

  

 We are seeking an energetic and experienced Scrum Master with 3 to 6 years of experience to lead our Agile teams. In this role, you will champion Agile and SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) principles, facilitate key ceremonies, and partner with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality software solutions. The ideal candidate has a strong technical background in tracking tools like JIRA and excels at data\-driven reporting to drive continuous team improvement.
   

  

 Your future duties and responsibilities
   

  

 Facilitate Agile Ceremonies: Lead Daily Standups, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives to ensure team alignment and momentum.
   

  

 Scale with SAFe: Guide the team through SAFe practices, aligning delivery with Program Increment (PI) objectives and cross\-team dependencies.
   

  

 Track \& Report Metrics: Leverage JIRA to manage backlogs, track workflows, and generate actionable reports (e.g., velocity, burndown/burnup charts, cumulative flow) for stakeholders.
   

  

 Remove Impediments: Proactively identify, track, and resolve blockers to protect the team's focus and velocity.
   

  

 Coach \& Mentor: Foster a culture of psychological safety, continuous improvement, and self\-organization within the team.
   

  

**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
 Experience: 3 to 6 years of professional experience working as a Scrum Master in software development environments.
   

  

 Certification: Mandatory SAFe Certification (e.g., SAFe Scrum Master \- SSM or SAFe Agilist \- SA).
   

  

 Agile Expertise: Deep understanding of Agile frameworks, Scrum values, Kanban principles, and scaling patterns.
   

  

 Tool Proficiency: Hands\-on expertise with JIRA (creating custom dashboards, filters, epics, and advanced reporting).
   

  

 Communication \& Collaboration: Exceptional stakeholder management, conflict\-resolution, and transparent reporting skills.
   

  

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**

 You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

Join us as a Scrum Master at Barclays, where you will drive agile delivery excellence across cross\-functional teams, enabling the successful delivery of strategic business and technology outcomes. You will facilitate Agile ceremonies, remove impediments, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and work closely with Product Owners, Engineers, Architects, and stakeholders to maximize value delivery and team performance.
   

  

 To be successful as a Scrum Master, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Agile delivery leadership within Scrum and/or SAFe environments
* Facilitating Agile ceremonies and driving continuous improvement
* Managing dependencies, risks, impediments, and stakeholder engagement
* Agile tooling such as Jira, Confluence, and reporting dashboards


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), CSM, PSM or equivalent Agile certification
* Experience supporting large\-scale transformation and change initiatives
* Data\-driven delivery management using metrics and KPIs
* Financial Services, Payments, Banking, or Regulatory programme experience


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific Agile delivery and stakeholder management skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune, India.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
* Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
* Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
* Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
* Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
* Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
* Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
 To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
   

  

 Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
   

  

 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
   

  

 Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
   

  

 Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
   

  

 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
   

  

 Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
   

  

 Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
   

  

 Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
   

  

 Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
   

  

 Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

**Be the one building AI\-powered experiences where they matter most.**
 At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI\-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
   

  

 Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real\-world enterprise environments every day.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Every sprint that ships depends on someone keeping ceremonies structured, blockers visible, and Jira data trustworthy. Without that, planning drifts, standups run long without resolving anything, and status reports stop reflecting what teams shipped. The Scrum Master owns that day\-to\-day discipline for one or more Platform teams, especially teams still building their agile habits, so the team can focus on delivery instead of process friction.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Ceremony Facilitation**
* Facilitate sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives for assigned teams, keeping sessions time\-boxed and outcome\-focused
* Support charter reviews and team kickoffs, helping new or forming teams set working agreements and delivery expectations
* Document ceremony decisions and action items so commitments carry over cleanly between sprints


**Team Support \& Impediment Removal**
* Support teams new to agile in applying Scrum mechanics day to day, resolving confusion before it slows delivery
* Identify and escalate blockers quickly enough that they don't carry over into the next sprint
* Encourage open retrospectives and follow through on improvement commitments until they're implemented


**Jira \& Delivery Tracking**
* Maintain Jira boards and backlog health for assigned teams, keeping stories current and sprints configured correctly
* Track and report team\-level delivery metrics (velocity, sprint completion rate, open impediments) using Platform\-standard Jira dashboards
* Give stakeholders concise, accurate delivery status updates based on what the team completed


**AI\-Assisted Support**
* Use AI\-assisted tools to support ceremony prep, note capture, and status reporting, cutting down manual admin work


**What You Bring**
**Required Qualifications**
* 2\+ years working as a Scrum Master or in an agile delivery support role within a technology team
* Working knowledge of Scrum principles and ceremonies, with experience running or co\-facilitating them
* Familiarity with Jira for sprint tracking, story management, and basic dashboard configuration
* Strong communication and organizational skills, with a track record of keeping teams on track and following through on commitments
* Comfort supporting teams that are still building their agile practice, adjusting approach as the team matures


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Scrum certification (CSM, PSM I, or equivalent)
* Experience supporting technology teams in Software Engineering, IT infrastructure, or enterprise environments
* Comfort with AI productivity tools or interest in applying automation to reduce repetitive work
* Experience working within an organization with established agile standards


**Key Skills**
* Scrum ceremony facilitation
* Jira sprint and backlog management
* Impediment identification and escalation
* Stakeholder communication and status reporting
* Retrospective facilitation


**BUSINESS IMPACT**
* Builds consistent delivery habits in teams new to agile, improving sprint predictability over time
* Keeps delivery moving by resolving day\-to\-day blockers before they stall a sprint
* Gives Platform leadership accurate, current delivery visibility through disciplined Jira hygiene and status reporting

**Why We Stand Out**
 Seeking a new challenge where your professional and personal aspirations are not only possible but supported? Kaufman Rossin might be just the place for you!
   

  

 Kaufman Rossin Professional Services Private Limited's (the "Company") offices are located in the World Trade Center (WTC) in Bangalore, Karnataka, India, and at Udyog Vihar, in Gurgaon, Haryana, India.
   

  

 The Bangalore office provides a range of services, including risk management, corporate governance, tax, assurance, and family office services. Out of the Gurgaon office, we render highly specialized back\-office alternative investment services for global hedge funds and related fund types. As one of the top accounting firms in the US, our foundation is "people first". In the words of James Kaufman, one of our founders, "We prioritize our people, their development, and their well\-being. Our values are translated into action every day."
   

  

 Kaufman Rossin, headquartered in Miami, Florida has been celebrated as the Best Place to Work in South Florida more than a dozen times. The firm has grown to over 700 employees, with offices spanning the tri\-county area and sister entities, Kaufman Rossin Wealth and Kaufman Rossin Alternative Investment Services.
   

  

 The Firm is ranked 49th among the top 100 firms in the US by Inside Public Accounting 2023\. Internationally, the Firm has offices in Bangalore and Haryana in India and the Ivory Coast in Africa.
   

  

**Think you have what it takes?**
 This is a single blended position based in Bengaluru within Kaufman Rossin's internal Information Technology department. One person owns both Scrum Master and Product Owner/Business Analyst functions for internal IT initiatives. The role partners directly with US\-based IT stakeholders as an equal contributor, proactively driving requirements conversations and jointly defining solutions while facilitating agile ceremonies and coaching the Bengaluru delivery team.
   

  

**Requirements**
**How You'll Contribute:**
**Product Owner Responsibilities**
* Own and maintain the internal IT product backlog, ensuring every Epic, Feature, Story, and Task is well\-defined, prioritized, and sprint\-ready
* Own the work\-item hierarchy: Epics to Features to user stories to tasks, with clear acceptance criteria.
* Partner with US\-based IT stakeholders as a peer to drive requirements, challenge assumptions, and co\-define solutions.
* Lead backlog refinement with the Bengaluru engineering and delivery teams


**Business Analysis Responsibilities**
* Jointly lead discovery and requirements sessions with internal US IT stakeholders, actively driving conversations rather than only documenting them
* Produce BRDs, functional specifications, process\-flow diagrams, and acceptance criteria, collaboratively reviewed with US counterparts
* Own requirements traceability so every delivered feature connects to a documented internal business or technology requirement
* Translate complex internal technology, automation, integration, infrastructure, security, and operational workflows into structured user stories


**Scrum Master Responsibilities**
* Facilitate sprint planning, standups, reviews, and retrospectives across internal IT initiatives
* Provide hands\-on Jira and Azure DevOps administration, including boards, workflows, hierarchy, sprint setup, automation, and reporting
* Remove impediments, protect sprint integrity, track and report delivery metrics.
* Drive continuous improvement and coach the Bengaluru team on agile principles and self\-organization


**Stakeholder Partnership**
* Engage US IT leaders, internal product owners, technical leads, and business\-system stakeholders as a peer; proactively initiate requirements conversations and propose solutions.
* Build trusted relationships across internal IT and with the departments supported by IT, developing genuine knowledge of KR's systems and operating environment.
* Prepare and deliver structured status updates, backlog reviews, sprint metrics, and requirement walkthroughs for US audiences.
* Coordinate across internal IT workstreams while maintaining clear ownership, priorities, dependencies, and escalation paths

* 4\+ years of Scrum Master, Product Owner, and/or Business Analyst experience in agile delivery, including 2\+ years in a blended or dual\-capacity role.
* SAFe certification \- SAFe Agilist, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, or SAFe Scrum Master \- is mandatory.
* Hands\-on Jira and Azure DevOps experience, including board configuration, work\-item hierarchy, sprint setup, workflow automation, and reporting.
* Proven business\-analysis skills in process mapping, requirements traceability, use\-case documentation, acceptance criteria, and stakeholder facilitation.
* Experience working with distributed delivery teams and stakeholders across US and India time zones.
* Excellent written and spoken English for stakeholder communication, technical documentation, presentations, and vendor interactions

 Success means establishing a reliable, transparent delivery structure for internal IT: a prioritized and sprint\-ready backlog, well\-run agile ceremonies, traceable requirements, clear delivery metrics, timely escalation of impediments, and trusted working relationships between US stakeholders and the Bengaluru delivery team
   

  

**Benefits**
* Work\-Life Balance
* People First Company
* Hybrid work policy
* Working directly with peers in the US

***Differences make unique varieties.***

description:
**Summary**
 The Software Engineering Lead is a hands\-on subject matter expert, engineering leader and people manager responsible for a cross\-functional team delivering a defined set of products and services. This role combines technical leadership, delivery ownership, and people management.
   

  

 The Lead sets technical direction, ensures technical and operational excellence, and partners with Product to deliver business outcomes. Through their direct team; ensures designs have effective architectural and structural oversight, reliable products are delivered. As a peer to a Principal Software Engineer, this role is accountable for engineering outcomes (quality, reliability, security, compliance, cost, and speed) and for cultivating a high\-performance, inclusive engineering culture. Analyses and aligns product roadmaps and determines the technical feasibility of future development projects. In addition will provide direction into delivery plans, schedules, raises risks and updated roadmaps.
   

  

 Accountable for ensuring good management to oversee and continuously improve the quality, service, and efficiency of staff, products and processes. Follows and enforces necessary compliance.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Engineering Leadership \& Culture**
* Carry out management responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies, procedures, and applicable laws
* Build an inclusive, psychologically safe culture; resolve conflict constructively; model One\-Team behaviours.
* Provides effective line management to direct reports and acts as an independent escalation point
* Conduct standard HR related duties such as absence management, performance management, disciplinaries, addressing complaints and resolving problem
* Participate in hiring processes, interviewing and develop onboarding plans of new team members
* Ensure all staff are provided with training and resources needed to perform their jobs to the most outstanding degree possible.
* Coach, mentor and support the professional development of individuals, provide with frequent feedback in order to meet and exceed individual and team performance goals consistently; fostering autonomy and ownership


**Product \& Delivery Excellence**
* Own delivery outcomes: predictability, throughput, quality, and customer value—using metrics (e.g., cycle time, lead time, escaped defects, change failure rate).
* Drive planning, capacity \& dependency management; ensure delivery plans are feasible and transparent.
* Balance product growth opportunities with technical enablement (tech debt, reliability, security) using clear trade\-off decisions.
* Serve as engineering voice in roadmap prioritisation and discovery; ensure requirements are clear, testable, and aligned to architecture constraints.
* Collaborate with direct reports and various stakeholders to support the development and maintenance of the technical roadmap, ensuring roadmap planning is well thought out technically and will be successful
* Proactively surface risks and mitigations; manage external dependencies and vendor/partner engagement.
* Serve as the initial point of escalation for software development issues within the specific area of responsibility leading on
* Manage and encourage new ideas from team members to foster improvements through innovations
* Interface with Product, UX, other technical personnel, or team members to finalise requirements
* Write and reviews portions of detailed specifications for the development of system components of moderate complexity
* Work closely with other development team members to understand moderately complex product requirements and translate them into software designs
* Ensure platform and features are compliant


**Technical Excellence \& Innovation**
* Align with domain/platform tech leads and the architecture function to drive standards, patterns, and reusability.
* Collaborate with team and domain tech leads on platform architecture, cross functional requirements and complex data models
* Ensure API and integration designs are robust, reliable and fault tolerant, versioned, observable, secure, and well\-documented.
* Ensure sufficient \& relevant technical documentation is available so that any staff can get up to speed quickly with the technical concerns of the product and services leading on
* Maintain a healthy technical estate: modernisation, simplification, deprecations; manage technical debt with a transparent backlog and guardrails, so that the technical burden is kept in equilibrium
* Provide technical assurance for the team: designs, code quality, reviews, and architectural alignment.
* Ensure security practices and standards are adopted within the team leading and acceptance criteria, with regular security testing is scheduled across all products and services leading on
* Ensure suitable dashboards are developed and enhanced to highlight technical concerns, risks and KPIs
* Keep abreast of new technology developments
* Lead system design at scale, using ADRs, C4 or similar; ensure architectural decisions are traceable and pragmatic.
* Champion modern design principles: SOLID, DDD, event\-driven architectures, CQRS where appropriate.


**Operational Excellence**
* Ensure zero/minimal downtime deployments (blue/green, canary); enforce release readiness and rollback plans.
* Ensure continuous improvement of engineering practices and operational processes
* Own operational readiness: instrumentation, logging, tracing, monitoring, alerts; production “run” quality.
* Define SLIs/SLOs/SLA and error budgets; drive MTTR, availability, and performance targets.
* Lead incident response and blameless post\-incident reviews; ensure actionable follow\-ups and learning loops
* Ensure software is maintained and upgrade as appropriate
* Maintain disaster recovery and business continuity (DR/BCP) plans and are well practiced; ensure compliance for resilience and recovery objectives (RPO/RTO).
* Ensure suitable testing is in place for all services and external interfaces managed are performant, scalable, fault tolerant, reliable and future capacity modelling is considered and performance targets are in defined
* Resolve complex technical issues and complete complex bug fixes as necessary
* Own cloud cost awareness (FinOps\-lite): budgeting inputs, cost\-to\-serve, scaling policies, right\-sizing, elasticity.
* Drive performance efficiency: load testing, capacity planning, caching strategies, and scalable architectures.


**Qualifications**
* A polygot with a wide range of experience of different technologies and systems
* Proven experience as a Tech Lead / Lead Engineer delivering software at scale
* Strong organizational and project planning, time management and change management skills across functional groups
* Advanced problem solving and leading/co\-ordinating people across teams as necessary to troubleshoot/diagnose complex project issues and get beyond symptoms to identifying root cause
* Focus more on the design and configuration of new systems to meet user requirements than on the implementation, technical support and evaluation of existing systems
* Demonstrable success leading cross\-functional teams through full SDLC to production.
* Experience in systems analysis, design and a solid understanding of development, quality assurance and integration methodologies
* Experienced developing integrated solutions within a broad technical and business context of significant impact
* Experience balancing product delivery with technical investments (security, reliability, debt).
* Experienced in evaluating and participated in competitive analysis of 3rd party software and services
* Strong interpersonal communication and presentation skills
* Skilled in stakeholder management and communicating effectively at multiple levels (engineers → executives)
* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in a relevant field of work or equivalent work experience \#


**Skills**
* Advanced knowledge of agile software development methodologies (Scrum, XP, Pair programming, 3\-Amigos, DevSecOps )
* Expertise in various development languages and interfaces such as c\#/.netcore, JavaScript (JQuery, ReactJS), Java, Node.Js, Python, Web, MVC, Restful APIs, GraphQL, CSS, Swagger
* Strong knowledge of SOLID Principles, KISS, YAGANI, Design patterns, Domain Modelling, DDD, CQRS, Event Driven Architectures, micro\-services and message Queues, feature toggles, SOA, and software\-as\-a\-service
* Broad knowledge of Continuous Testing, TDD / BDD, Integration Tests, Performance \& Scalability Testing, Instrumentation (Logging, monitoring, alerting, metrics, health checks)
* Strong knowledge of relational and document based data stores, with strong understanding of normalised/dimensional data modelling principles and data manipulation languages including optimisation techniques
* Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10, Security \& Privacy By Design, SAST/DAST, Encryption, TLS, Secure Coding, Threat Modelling
* Strong knowledge of cloud based hosting, IaC, Immutable Infrastructure and container solutions, and cost/efficiency optimisations
* Strong knowledge of Continuous Integration, Continuous Deployment, Source Control, Build Orchestration, Artefact Repositories, Static Analysis, powershell, green\-blue deployments and canary releases.

title: Scrum Master - AVP
description:
Join us as a Scrum Master \- AVP at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Scrum Master \- AVP, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Strong understanding of Scaled Agile and Scrum practices.
* Excellent Communication \& Stakeholder Facilitation.
* Familiarity with Agile Tooling (JIRA) \& Reporting Practices.
* Ability to Work Across Multi‑disciplinary, Distributed POD Structures.
* Ability to take e2e accountability of team delivering a quality product increment in every release.
* Ability to provide situational servant leadership to the team.
* Ability to manage complex projects in banking at enterprise scale.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Proven experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Delivery Lead.
* Strong understanding of Agile frameworks (Scrum, SAFe).
* Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and coaching teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience managing risks, issues, and dependencies.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
* Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
* Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
* Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
* Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
* Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
* Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
 To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
   

  

 Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
   

  

 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
   

  

 Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
   

  

 Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
   

  

 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
   

  

 Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
   

  

 Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
   

  

 Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
   

  

 Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
   

  

 Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Tower Lead - ServiceNow
description:
**Hello,**

 is one of the world’s largest travel management companies and a trusted partner for nationals and multinational companies. With a 24/7 reach in 97 countries, FCM’s flexible technology anticipates and solves client needs, supported by experts who provide in\-depth local knowledge and duty of care as part of the ultimate personalised business travel experience.

 **Great Place to Work certification for the fifth time**

 A leader in the travel tech space, FCM has proprietary client solutions. FCM provides specialist services via FCM Consulting and FCM Meetings \& Events.
   

  

**Summary**
 The ServiceNow Tower Lead is the assistant team leader for the ETS ServiceNow team, responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery of ITSM support, project engineering, and platform maintenance, based in the Global Capability Centre. The Tower Lead operates with a high degree of independence, owning solution design and delivery for standard BAU and ITSM work, and coordinating with onshore design leads for major or complex projects where additional design authority is required.
   

  

 Operating within the SIAM framework as part of an internal service provider function, the Tower Lead enables the offshore team to function as a capable, self\-directing delivery unit — maintaining quality, throughput, and platform standards with little routine onshore dependency. The Tower Lead is a senior technical practitioner who leads by example, uplifts team capability, and holds full delivery accountability within the offshore context.
   

  

**Day in the life:**
**Offshore Delivery Leadership**
* Lead and coordinate the offshore ServiceNow development team across BAU support, project delivery, and platform maintenance workstreams.
* Manage daily stand\-ups, sprint ceremonies, and team workflow, driving a high\-performing delivery cadence with minimal onshore direction required.
* Act as the primary escalation point for the development team, resolving blockers and maintaining momentum through active, technically\-grounded leadership.
* Allocate work across the development team based on capacity, skillset, and priority, optimising throughput without compromising quality.
* Foster a culture of ownership and continuous improvement within the team, setting clear expectations for delivery standards and individual accountability.


**Solution Design and Technical Authority**
* Own end\-to\-end solution design for all BAU ITSM work and small projects, translating business requirements into well\-defined technical specifications and acceptance criteria without requiring onshore input (except where a Technical Business Analyst is also assigned).
* Engage with internal business customers to understand requirements, conduct discovery, and propose fit\-for\-purpose ServiceNow solutions aligned to platform best practices and FCTG standards.
* For major or complex projects, receive design artefacts and functional specifications from design leads, interpret these accurately, and direct the team in executing against the agreed design.


**You'll be perfect for the role if you have:**
**BAU Support Coordination**
* Oversee the offshore team's response to BAU ServiceNow support tickets, ensuring SLA adherence and customer experience standards are maintained independently of onshore involvement.
* Triage incoming support requests, assign to appropriate developers, and track resolution to closure.
* Identify recurring issues or systemic defects and initiate remediation or platform improvement actions within the team's remit, escalating only where broader platform decisions are needed.
* Maintain awareness of platform incidents and manage support team contribution to resolution activities.


**Testing and Release Coordination**
* Oversee the QA function and ensure test plans, test cases, and defect tracking align to agreed acceptance criteria and standards.
* Coordinate release packaging and submission through ETS change management processes, ensuring all governance requirements are met prior to deployment.
* Ensure all release artefacts, documentation, and post\-release validation activities are completed to standard.


**Governance and Reporting**
* Maintain accurate sprint and delivery reporting to support visibility of the team's productivity, quality, and capacity.
* Contribute to standards, documentation, and knowledge base maintenance in Confluence, ServiceNow and Sharepoint.
* Adhere to change management, release, and governance processes as defined by FCTG, ensuring relevant activity is auditable and compliant.


**Work Perks! \- What’s in it for you:**
 FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.
   

  

 You will be rewarded with competitive market salary. You will also be equipped with relevant training courses and tools to set you up for success with endless career advancement and job opportunities all over the world.

 and a highly competitive salary

**Work life Balance**

**Great place to work** 
 \- Recognized as a top workplace for 5 consecutive years, which is a testimonial of our commitment towards our people
   

  

**Wellbeing Focus** 
 \- We take care of our employee with comprehensive medical coverage, accidental insurance, and term insurance for the well being of our people.
   

  

**Paternity Leave:** 
 We ensure that you can spend quality time with your growing family
   

  

**Travel perks**

**A career, not a job** 
 : We believe in our people brightness of future. As a high growth company, you will have the opportunity to advance your career in any direction you choose whether that is locally or globally.
   

  

**Reward \& Recognition** 
 : Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering \- You'll have to experience it to believe it!
   

  

**Love for travel** 
 : We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
   

  

**We value you...**
 Flight Centre Travel Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace that supports your unique identity to create better, safer experiences for everyone. We encourage you to come as you are; to foster inclusivity and collaboration. We celebrate you.
   

  

**Who We Are...**
 Since our beginning, our vision has always been to open up the world for those who want to see.
   

  

 As a global travel retailer, our people come from all different backgrounds, and our connections spread to the far reaches of the globe \- 20\+ countries and counting! Together, we are a family (we call ourselves Flighties).
   

  

 We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve. We embrace new experiences, we celebrate the wins, seize all opportunities, and empower all of our people to find their
 **Brightness of Future.**
 We encourage you to
 **DREAM BIG** 
 through collaboration and innovation, and make sure you are supported to make incredible ideas a reality. Together, we deliver quality, innovative solutions that delight our customers and achieve our strategic priorities.

title: Agile Scrum Master Senior Analyst- Cigna Healthcare
description:
**Job Role:** Scrum Master/Agile Team Coach


About Cigna


Cigna is a global health insurance company, dedicated to its mission of helping improve the health, well\-being, and peace of mind of those we serve by making health care simple, affordable, and predictable.


Together with colleagues located across Europe, Asia Pacific, the Middle East, Africa, and India, you will support Cigna's International Health business. As part of Cigna Healthcare, International Health provides global and local health insurance solutions for internationally mobile individuals, multinational organizations, government entities, IGOs, NGOs, and local customers worldwide.


We are going through a global Agile transformation. As a result, we are expanding our teams and are looking for experienced Scrum Masters / Agile Team Coaches to join our team.

**Purpose of the Role**
=======================


The purpose of the Scrum Master / Agile Team Coach role is to maximize value delivery through collaboration, impediment removal, visibility, learning, and evidence\-based improvement.


This role supports high\-performing team dynamics, sustainable delivery, continuous flow, and self\-managed teams that are shaping and maturing Agile ways of working across International Health.

**About the Role**
==================


The Scrum Master / Agile Team Coach is a team coach and servant leader who facilitates change through the adoption and application of Agile principles, practices, and frameworks.


The role enables teams to self\-organize, improve flow, embrace effective ways of working, and consistently deliver value outcomes to stakeholders. The role partners closely with Product Owners, team members, Release Train Engineers, Agile Product Managers, and other stakeholders to support predictable delivery and continuous improvement.


This is a Band 3 Contributor Career Track Role.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Team Coaching and Agile Enablement**
--------------------------------------

* Provide coaching and guidance to Agile Teams and support the adoption and application of Agile values, principles, and practices.
* Act as a servant leader, facilitator, mentor, and coach for individuals and teams.
* Enable teams to improve collaboration, transparency, psychological safety, accountability, and self\-management.
* Use effective communication and listening skills to teach, coach, mentor, and support healthy team interactions.
* Foster a healthy working culture, build strong relationships, and strengthen key interactions across teams and stakeholders.

**Delivery Flow and Continuous Improvement**
--------------------------------------------

* Support teams in improving flow, reducing bottlenecks, managing impediments, and operating at a sustainable pace.
* Help teams establish realistic and achievable delivery commitments based on capacity, clarity, dependencies, and delivery risks.
* Maintain metrics and data necessary to provide visibility into maturity, progress, quality, flow, predictability, and value delivery.
* Facilitate evidence\-based improvement through retrospectives, improvement actions, and follow\-through on agreed outcomes.
* Encourage Built\-In Quality, continuous learning, and relentless improvement as part of day\-to\-day team working practices.

**Facilitation and Cadence Events**
-----------------------------------

* Support and facilitate team ceremonies and cadence events that drive progress toward value delivery and business outcomes.
* Facilitate team events such as planning, team syncs, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and improvement workshops, as applicable to the team context.
* Participate in Sync events, Scrum Master / Team Coach forums, and internal Agile communities of practice.
* Support ART\-level alignment events, including PI Planning, ART Sync, Coach Sync, System Demo, and Inspect \& Adapt, as applicable.

**ART Alignment, Dependencies, and Impediments**
------------------------------------------------

* Provide support that helps Agile Teams improve overall ART performance through collaboration and alignment between team objectives, vision, and strategic themes.
* Facilitate and support dependency management to ensure alignment of delivery across teams.
* Support removal of impediments that hinder achievement of team goals and objectives.
* Protect the team from unnecessary disruptions and external distractions while escalating systemic impediments in a timely manner.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, RTEs, Agile Product Managers, business stakeholders, and technology partners to maintain transparency and alignment.

**Success in this Role**
========================

* Teams demonstrate stronger self\-management, collaboration, and ownership of delivery outcomes.
* Impediments, blockers, dependencies, and delivery risks are made visible and addressed promptly.

Job Overview
  
  

ROLE PURPOSE
  
  

Own training and enablement across the entire programme, and act as the offshore agile coaching anchor. The role designs and delivers persona\-based learning for a heterogeneous audience — from engineering teams to corporate functions — with training intensity that scales by wave complexity, and supports the broader OCM effort in partnership with the onshore OCM Lead and Agile Coach.
  
  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

Design the end\-to\-end training strategy and curriculum for Jira Cloud and Confluence Cloud, segmented by persona: technical delivery teams (developers, QA, RTEs, Scrum Masters, product owners, architects) and non\-technical functional teams (corporate functions, PMO, commercial, operations).
  
**Scale training intensity to the wave model:** self\-serve and standard assets for Wave 1 (lower complexity), wave\-specific guided training for Wave 2, and role\-based, customized, hands\-on preparation for Wave 3 (complex/integrated projects).
  
**Build and maintain the enablement library:** quick\-start guides, job aids, how\-to videos, onboarding modules, FAQs, and greenfield onboarding paths for users new to Jira/Confluence.
  
Launch and nurture Communities of Practice and champion networks; run Lunch \& Learn sessions, workshops, and office hours across US, EU, and APAC time zones on a predictable calendar.
  
As offshore agile coach, reinforce SAFe\-aligned ways of working in the new environment — backlog hygiene, boards, PI planning artifacts, ART dashboards — in coordination with the onshore Agile Coach.
  
Embed AI\-capability content (developed with the Senior AI Engineer) into curricula so AI adoption is trained as part of normal ways of working, not as a separate initiative.
  
Track training completion, satisfaction, and post\-training usage; feed insights to the OCM Lead and programme reporting.
  
  

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE
  
  

8\+ years across Atlassian administration/SME work and enterprise training or enablement leadership; deep hands\-on Jira and Confluence knowledge (cloud experience strongly preferred).
  
Proven design and delivery of persona\-based training programmes for global, multi\-time\-zone audiences at enterprise scale.

Strong content\-development craft across written, video, and live formats; comfort with LMS and content tooling.
  
Facilitation excellence in both technical and non\-technical rooms.
  
  

PREFERRED
  
  

Prior enablement work on a Data Center\-to\-Cloud (or equivalent platform) migration.
  
Experience partnering with formal OCM functions and communications teams.
  
Familiarity with adoption analytics and sentiment measurement.

You will play a crucial role in the creation of new products and features, driving forward our technological advancements and market competitiveness. The portfolio you will be delivering includes mobile apps (iOS and Android), cloud\-based data platforms, web applications, software test frameworks, automation, and test scripts.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**About us**


Camascope India is part of Person\-Centred Software (PCS) Group who are, a fast\-growing technology group focused on empowering the care and medication sector. Following PCS's acquisition of Camascope, our India team continues to build the products that connect pharmacies, care homes and doctors — now as part of a larger, international engineering organisation serving thousands of care professionals every day. This role is dedicated to a PCS product, working closely with our UK product engineering teams.

**What you will work on**


As Engineering Manager, you will build and lead a new team of 6 engineers in India delivering a PCS product, working closely with a counterpart engineering team in the UK. You will start hands\-on contributing directly to code for roughly half your time — while establishing team practices, hiring, and delivery rhythm. As the team matures and grows (including a planned second team under your leadership), your contribution will shift from hands\-on coding toward team leadership, coaching and cross\-team coordination.

**Responsibilities**

* Hire, build and lead a new engineering team of 6 in India, growing the team's capability and, over time, a second team under the same remit
* Contribute hands\-on to design, engineering and delivery of features — approximately 50% of your time initially, tapering as the team scales and matures
* Own day\-to\-day team operations — sprint delivery, 1:1s, performance management, hiring and career development
* Work closely with the UK product engineering team to align on delivery scope, priorities and technical direction for the shared PCS product
* Champion continuous delivery, with testing and security embedded in CI/CD pipelines, and promote DevSecOps practices across the team
* Make significant contributions to technical and architectural decisions, keeping systems, standards and practices coherent with the wider PCS engineering organisation
* Identify and remove blockers, process inefficiencies and technical debt proactively
* Be accountable for the full software development lifecycle — from design through to production, monitoring and support
* Foster a learning and mentoring culture; actively coach engineers and help them grow
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, QA and Design to achieve shared product outcomes

**Requirements**

* 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including experience as an Engineering Manager or senior technical lead of a team, with a strong portfolio of C\#/.NET applications
* Deep understanding of the C\#/.NET ecosystem, and experience with cloud platforms (Azure and/or AWS) and cloud\-native development
* Experience with modern DevOps/CI\-CD practices
* Strong understanding of RESTful API design, security (e.g. OWASP API Security) and system architecture at scale
* Proven experience building and leading a team from the ground up — hiring, structuring, and establishing delivery practices for a new team
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience collaborating across distributed or international teams
* Capable and comfortable working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and coaching a team on them
* Good understanding of database technologies, message queues, and data security
* Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills, with a fix\-forward, learning mindset
* Bachelor's/master's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* Experience working with, or managing engineers who use, AI\-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot)

**Bonus points for**

* Experience managing or growing a second team, or scaling an engineering org from one team to several
* Prior experience in healthcare, care or pharmacy technology, or another highly regulated environment
* Experience with cloud migration projects or multi\-cloud environments
* Prior experience in a post\-acquisition or newly integrated engineering organisation
* Hands\-on experience with Blazor (web) and/or Maui (mobile)

title: Java Developer – Java, Microservices, Cloud & Agile
description:
****Job Summary****
 Synechron is seeking a
 **Java Developer** 
 with at least
 **7 years of Java development experience** 
 and proven experience leading a team of Java developers. The role is responsible for developing, maintaining, and delivering scalable Java\-based applications and systems for large enterprise environments. This position will translate business requirements into technical solutions, support high\-quality software delivery, resolve technical issues, and contribute to innovation through modern development practices, microservices architecture, and cloud computing.
   

  

****Required****
**Software Requirements (Required and Preferred)**
* Java: At least 7 years of professional experience developing Java\-based applications and systems.
* Java Development Tools: Experience using standard Java development, testing, debugging, build, and deployment tools.
* Software Development Methodologies: Practical experience with Agile, Scrum, or comparable iterative delivery methodologies.
* Application Development: Experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, maintaining, and supporting enterprise Java applications.
* Version Control and Collaboration Tools: Experience using organization\-approved source control, issue tracking, code review, and collaboration tools.
* Testing Tools: Experience developing and executing unit, integration, and functional tests for Java applications.
* Enterprise Delivery Practices: Experience delivering Java\-based solutions within a large enterprise environment.


****Preferred****
* Java SE 11 or later: Experience developing applications using Java 11 or a later supported version.
* Microservices Technologies: Experience designing and developing microservices\-based applications.
* Cloud Computing Platforms: Practical exposure to cloud\-based application development, deployment, or support.
* Java Frameworks: Experience with commonly used Java application frameworks and libraries relevant to enterprise development.
* Deployment and Automation Tools: Exposure to continuous integration, continuous delivery, containerization, or deployment automation tools.
* Java Development Certification: Advanced certification aligned with Java development, such as a Java SE 11 Developer certification.


****Overall Responsibilities****
* Lead, coordinate, and mentor a team of Java developers while supporting effective collaboration, technical growth, and high\-quality delivery.
* Develop, enhance, maintain, test, and deploy Java\-based applications and systems that meet defined business and technical requirements.
* Design and implement scalable, efficient, maintainable, and supportable Java solutions for large enterprise environments.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical designs, development tasks, implementation plans, and measurable delivery outcomes.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to resolve technical issues, manage dependencies, and support informed engineering decisions.
* Apply software development methodologies, coding standards, testing practices, and documentation requirements throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Troubleshoot application defects, performance issues, integration challenges, and production incidents within agreed timelines.
* Contribute to the adoption of microservices architecture, cloud computing, and other relevant technologies where they support business and operational objectives.
* Review technical designs, code, test results, and implementation plans to identify risks and improve solution quality.
* Promote maintainable solutions that use resources efficiently, reduce avoidable processing, and consider sustainability in application design and cloud usage where applicable.
* Track delivery progress, communicate risks and dependencies, and support continuous improvement across the development team.


****Technical Skills (By Category)****
**Programming Languages**
****Essential****
* At least 7 years of professional experience with Java programming.
* Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming, exception handling, collections, concurrency, and application design principles.
* Experience developing, debugging, testing, and maintaining Java\-based enterprise applications.


****Preferred****
* Experience with Java 11 or later.
* Experience with scripting or additional programming languages used to support automation, integration, or application operations.


**Databases and Data Management**
****Essential****
* Experience integrating Java applications with relational or enterprise data stores.
* Ability to work with application data models, queries, transactions, data validation, and persistence requirements.
* Experience troubleshooting application issues involving data access, consistency, or performance.


****Preferred****
* Experience with both relational and non\-relational databases.
* Familiarity with database performance optimization, indexing, transaction management, and data migration.


**Cloud Technologies**
****Essential****
* Understanding of cloud computing concepts relevant to application development, deployment, scalability, and support.
* Ability to contribute to Java application delivery in cloud\-based or hybrid environments.


****Preferred****
* Hands\-on experience deploying or supporting Java applications on cloud platforms.
* Experience with cloud\-native development, containerized applications, scalable services, monitoring, and resource optimization.


**Frameworks and Libraries**
****Essential****
* Experience using Java frameworks and libraries to develop maintainable enterprise applications.
* Understanding of application layers, service components, dependency management, configuration, and integration patterns.
* Experience designing or supporting scalable application components.


****Preferred****
* Experience developing microservices\-based applications.
* Exposure to frameworks and libraries used for web applications, REST services, dependency injection, persistence, messaging, or distributed systems.
* Experience applying design patterns and principles that improve application maintainability and reuse.


**Development Tools and Methodologies**
****Essential****
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, or comparable software development methodologies.
* Experience with source control, code reviews, defect tracking, build management, testing, deployment, and technical documentation.
* Experience participating in requirements analysis, technical design, development, testing, release, and post\-production support.
* Experience leading or coordinating development activities within a team.


****Preferred****
* Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery practices.
* Exposure to automated build, deployment, quality analysis, monitoring, and containerization tools.
* Experience working with iterative planning, estimation, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement activities.


**Security Protocols**
****Essential****
* Understanding of secure software development practices for Java applications.
* Ability to apply appropriate authentication, authorization, input validation, secure error handling, and protection of sensitive data.
* Awareness of secure API communication, access controls, vulnerability management, and organizational security standards.


****Preferred****
* Experience implementing security controls in microservices or cloud\-based applications.
* Exposure to secure coding assessments, application security testing, encryption practices, and security reviews.


****Experience Requirements****
* At least 7 years of professional experience in Java development.
* Proven experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating a team of Java developers.
* Demonstrated experience developing and delivering Java\-based applications and systems in a large enterprise environment.
* Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions and guiding implementation through development, testing, deployment, and support.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, or comparable software development methodologies.
* Experience with microservices architecture and cloud computing is preferred.
* Experience resolving technical issues, supporting production applications, and meeting delivery timelines.
* Industry or domain experience relevant to the assigned business environment is preferred but not required unless specified for a particular project.
* Candidates may qualify through equivalent professional experience demonstrating comparable Java development expertise, technical leadership, enterprise delivery, and successful implementation outcomes.


**Day\-to\-Day Activities**
* Lead and mentor a team of Java developers, assign or coordinate development activities, review technical work, and support delivery quality.
* Analyze business requirements, participate in design and planning discussions, and translate requirements into Java\-based technical solutions.
* Develop, test, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot Java applications while monitoring delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and technical issues.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to implement new technologies, make decisions within approved technical standards, and deliver maintainable solutions within agreed timelines.


****Qualifications****
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
* At least 7 years of professional experience in Java development, including experience delivering enterprise Java applications and systems.
* Proven experience leading or mentoring Java developers and coordinating technical delivery activities.
* Advanced Java development certification, such as a Java SE 11 Developer certification, is preferred.
* Commitment to continuous professional development through relevant training, technology learning, certification opportunities, and evolving software engineering practices.


**Professional Competencies**
* Apply critical thinking and structured problem\-solving to assess requirements, identify root causes, evaluate trade\-offs, and implement effective technical solutions.
* Provide technical leadership through mentoring, constructive feedback, work coordination, knowledge sharing, and support for team delivery.
* Communicate technical information, delivery progress, risks, decisions, and issues clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Adapt to changing requirements, technologies, delivery priorities, and enterprise constraints while maintaining solution quality.
* Identify practical opportunities to improve application design, development efficiency, automation, scalability, maintainability, and responsible use of technology resources.
* Manage time and priorities across team leadership, requirements analysis, development, testing, issue resolution, stakeholder collaboration, and delivery commitments.
