title: Manager & Scrum Master - Embedded Software Development
description:
Manager \- Software Development
   

  

 Are you passionate about leading agile software teams to deliver innovative solutions while coaching and empowering developers to reach their full potential? Then join us in our mission to pioneer smarter solutions for moving and transforming water, reducing energy consumption, and enhancing quality of life for people.
   

  

 As our new Manager Software Development \& SCRUM Master, you will be managing a software development team while serving as SCRUM Master, driving agile best practices and delivering high\-quality software solutions that support Grundfos's mission of pioneering sustainable water technology. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well\-being, and a sense of belonging.
   

  

 What you will be doing
   

  

 As a key part of the Software Development R\&D team, you'll create impact by Leading agile transformation and software delivery that directly powers Grundfos's next generation of intelligent pump solutions and digital services.
   

  

 Your main responsibilities include:
   

  

* Lead and develop a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement
* Serve as SCRUM Master by facilitating sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, retrospectives, and backlog refinement sessions
* Remove impediments and shield the team from distractions to ensure consistent delivery of sprint commitments
* Collaborate with Product Owners and stakeholders to translate business needs into actionable development priorities
* Coach team members and the broader organization on agile principles, driving maturity in SCRUM practices
* Ensure software quality through code review processes, testing strategies, and adherence to engineering standards


 What makes you a great fit
   

  

 Above all, you are a hands\-on technical leader with a strong agile mindset, capable of balancing people management with SCRUM facilitation and passionate about building high\-performing development teams. We would also imagine that you have:
   

  

* 15\+ years of experience in embedded software development with at least 5 years in a people management role
* Proven experience as a SCRUM Master or agile coach in a professional embedded software development environment
* Strong technical background in modern software engineering practices (e.g., CI/CD, cloud\-based architectures, embedded or application software)
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or equivalent agile certification


 It is a plus if you also:
   

  

* Experience in R\&D or product development within industrial, IoT, or manufacturing domains
* Familiarity with scaled agile frameworks such as SAFe or LeSS
* Experience with DevOps practices and tools for automated build, test, and deployment pipelines


 Why you will love working here
   

  

 We care! Day to day, you can look forward to:
   

  

* A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.
* Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well\-being activities.
* Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering in your community.
* Access to on\-demand training and learning sessions and carefully structured programmes to pursue personal and professional development opportunities.


 We are inclusive! Celebrating and valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds.
   

  

 Are you ready to unlock possibilities at Grundfos? Apply today!

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Company Description**  

Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.


 We’re an award\-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do:

* UK \& Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft \& Oracle partner
* 3300\+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
* 10\+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland \& UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK \& Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW


We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.

 **Job Description**  

As a Scrum Master, you'll bring expertise in Agile methodologies and practices, supporting teams to achieve successful outcomes. You'll facilitate productive and purposeful meetings where every voice is heard and outcomes are clear. You'll help teams work towards sprint goals and objectives, remove obstacles, and support sustainable delivery towards releases.


Your coaching will help teams take responsibility for their processes, and your ability to identify early signs of conflict will help address challenges before they escalate. If you have experience coaching and advising teams, and would like to work in an open, inclusive and diverse culture where ideas and different perspectives are valued, we'd love to hear from you.


Job Responsibilities

* **Ceremonies** – facilitate key Agile ceremonies and planning activities, including daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, sprint retrospectives and release planning, to support collaboration and transparency.
* **Supporting estimation** – guide the team in estimating user stories and tasks, supporting shared understanding and realistic sprint commitments.
* **Removing impediments** – identify and resolve impediments that affect team progress by working with stakeholders and external groups, helping the team remain focused on sprint and release objectives. Represent the team in Scrum of Scrums and other cross\-team coordination meetings where required.
* **Collaborating with Product Owners** – work closely with Product Owners to maintain a prioritised and visible product backlog and support adherence to agreed priorities and scope.
* **Sprint focus** – guide the team in maintaining focus on sprint goals and release deliverables.
* **Team development** – support team development by helping teams address challenges, resolve conflicts, manage interpersonal issues and access development opportunities that strengthen overall effectiveness.
* **Continuous improvement** – facilitate retrospectives and support the team in identifying and implementing improvements to processes and ways of working.
* **Promoting Agile principles and practices** – guide the team in applying Agile frameworks and methodologies, with a focus on quality outcomes and delivery capability.
* **Facilitating readiness for demos and releases** – support preparation for stakeholder demonstrations and releases, ensuring readiness for key milestones.
* **Contributing to the Agile community of practice** – collaborate with other Scrum Masters and Agile practitioners to share knowledge, promote effective practices and strengthen Agile capability across the organisation.

  

**Qualifications**  

Essential Requirements

* 7\+ years of total experience.
* Experience applying Agile methodologies and practices.
* Demonstrated ability to facilitate meetings that are purposeful, engaging and effective.
* Experience working with multiple Scrum teams.
* Experience coaching teams and encouraging responsibility for team processes.
* Ability to identify early signs of team conflict and apply appropriate resolution approaches.
* Ability to operate as both a day\-to\-day coach and adviser.


Desirable Requirements

* Experience representing teams within Scrum of Scrums or similar cross\-team forums.
* Experience contributing to Agile communities of practice.
* Experience supporting organisational Agile capability development.

  

**Additional Information**  

Why Version 1?


 At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance\-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression \& mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance \& Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
* Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards \& ‘Call\-Out’ platform.
* Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.


And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.


Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer.


We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.


We want every candidate to have a positive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process, please contact your recruiter at Version 1\. We will consider all requests carefully, respectfully and confidentially.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Date live: 09/08/2026


Business Area: Corporate Digital Banking


Area of Expertise: Change


Contract: Permanent


Reference Code: JR\-0000123934


  
Join us as a Scrum Master at Barclays, where you will drive agile delivery excellence across cross\-functional teams, enabling the successful delivery of strategic business and technology outcomes. You will facilitate Agile ceremonies, remove impediments, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and work closely with Product Owners, Engineers, Architects, and stakeholders to maximize value delivery and team performance.


To be successful as a Scrum Master, you should have experience with:


* Agile delivery leadership within Scrum and/or SAFe environments
* Facilitating Agile ceremonies and driving continuous improvement
* Managing dependencies, risks, impediments, and stakeholder engagement
* Agile tooling such as Jira, Confluence, and reporting dashboards

Some other highly valued skills may include:


* SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), CSM, PSM or equivalent Agile certification
* Experience supporting large\-scale transformation and change initiatives
* Data\-driven delivery management using metrics and KPIs
* Financial Services, Payments, Banking, or Regulatory programme experience

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific Agile delivery and stakeholder management skills.


The role is based out of Pune, India.


**Purpose of the role**


Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.


**Accountabilities**


1\.Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
  

2\.Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
  

3\.Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
  

4\.Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
  

5\.Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
  

6\.Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
  

7\.Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable  

  



**Assistant Vice President Expectations**


To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
  

Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
  

If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
  

OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
  

Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
  

Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
  

Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
  

Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
  

Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
  

Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
  

Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
  

Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

  

  

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

description:

 Radancy is the global leader in talent acquisition software, helping employers attract and hire the right talent through AI\-powered recruiting technology, data\-driven insights, and world\-class candidate experiences. Our platform enables organizations to streamline hiring, strengthen employer branding, and drive measurable recruitment outcomes at scale.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an Agile Project Manager in Radancy's Product Engineering group, you will oversee the project management duties for software development projects from initiation through release, delivering new and enhanced products to our client base. The Agile Project Manager must be able to harness a distributed and multi\-functional team covering digital development in all its forms (design, IXD, content, UI development, engineering and quality assurance) and can facilitate dialogue between developers and stakeholders. Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they meet every one of the qualifications in a job description. Our top priority is finding the best candidate for the job and if you are interested in the position, we would encourage you to apply, even if you don’t believe you meet every one of the skills.
   

  

**What does a great Agile Project Manager do?**
* Serve as Project Manager for software/web development of new or enhanced products using agile methodology
* As Scrum Master, you will manage the processes for information exchange with the Agile teams
* Collaborate with globally distributed teams of product managers, developers, and QA testers to resource, define, and schedule activities required to develop and launch new software
* Define and enforce best project management practices
* Coordinate all production releases including weekly maintenance releases
* Provide management\-level reporting on project status, risks and mitigation strategies
* Administration of JIRA (boards, projects, users and permissions)
* Send out release notes communication to marketing/sales following releases


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree (ideally in Business or Computer Science)
* 1\+ years of experience as a scrum master in a software development environment with a preference including experience with varied Agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban, XP)
* Experience managing projects among a distributed team spanning different geographies and diverse cultures
* Understanding of web development and associated technologies, and able to follow technical discussions and bridge communications between stakeholders and developers
* Scrum Master certification (CSM or PSM) desirable
* Excellent interpersonal communications, must have the ability to help product managers formulate/articulate a decision on the course of action
* Quick learner, able to work independently with limited supervision
* Self\-motivated, proactive and dependable
* Positive, committed and selfless, willing to pitch in and help others when needed
* Organized, meticulous, patient, able to works effectively under pressure
* Flexible to shifting��business priorities


**Work Location**
* Hybrid Work Model: This is a hybrid position, requiring you to work in the Bengaluru office 3 times per week.


**Company Values:**

title: Scrum Master / Senior Consultant Specialist
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
   

  

 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Lead Agile delivery as Scrum Master across Scrum and/or SAFe teams, coaching on Agile principles, ceremonies, and ways of working.
* Plan and facilitate Sprint (and where applicable PI) events, ensuring goals are clear, realistic, and protected from scope drift.
* Build and maintain integrated delivery plans covering milestones, dependencies, risks, assumptions, constraints, blockers, and critical path.
* Remove impediments proactively by coordinating across engineering, QA, architecture, environments, release management, and third parties/vendors.
* Coordinate sprints, releases, and cross\-team dependencies, keeping delivery aligned to wider programme timelines and outcomes.
* Own delivery tracking and reporting in JIRA and Confluence, including dashboards, sprint metrics, burn\-down/up, velocity trends, RAID, and executive\-ready status reporting.
* Drive delivery to challenging timelines via prioritisation, capacity planning, and risk\-based decision\-making, escalating early when needed.
* Own delivery governance for releases and change: manage ServiceNow CRs, CAB readiness, release notes/communications, test sign\-offs, ITSA/eITSA, and ensure audit\-ready artefacts (evidence, approvals, runbooks, rollback plans).


**To Be Successful, You Will**
* Have proven Scrum Master experience in an Agile delivery environment (Scrum and/or SAFe), with strong coaching and facilitation capability.
* Bring strong planning and dependency management skills, able to connect team\-level execution to programme\-level milestones and critical path.
* Be hands\-on with JIRA and Confluence, able to create meaningful dashboards, maintain RAID, and produce clear, consistent status reporting for senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrate a track record of removing impediments quickly, navigating across engineering, QA, architecture, environments, release/change, and vendors.
* Have release/change governance experience, including ServiceNow CRs, CAB processes, and producing/maintaining evidence for audit and control expectations.
* Show excellent stakeholder management and communication, able to drive alignment and set expectations on scope, schedule, and risk.
* Apply strong delivery discipline through prioritisation, capacity planning, metrics, and early escalation grounded in delivery data.
* Have a continuous improvement mindset, using retrospectives, action tracking, and team health checks to improve flow efficiency, predictability, and collaboration.


 You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
   

  

 www.hsbc.com/careers
   

  

 HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”
   

  

 Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Scrum Master with DevSecOps
description:
**About Birlasoft**
 Birlasoft, a powerhouse where domain expertise, enterprise solutions, and digital technologies converge to redefine business processes. We take pride in our consultative and design thinking approach, driving societal progress by enabling our customers to run businesses with unmatched efficiency and innovation. As part of the CK Birla Group, a multibillion\-dollar enterprise, we boast a 12,500\+ professional team committed to upholding the Group's 162\-year legacy. Our core values prioritize Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiatives, along with Corporate Sustainable Responsibility (CSR) activities, demonstrating our dedication to building inclusive and sustainable communities. Join us in shaping a future where technology seamlessly aligns with purpose.
   

  

 Job Description: Scrum Master with DevSecOps expertise
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* 20–25% Team Oversight \& Coordination: Provide team oversight and coordination, ensuring alignment, timely delivery, effective resource utilization, and adherence to project objectives.
* Agile \& JIRA: Manage JIRA in line with Agile practices, including backlog management, sprint planning, refinement, progress tracking, sprint reviews, and governance.
* Proactive Approach: Proactively identify risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities and drive them through to resolution.
* Strong Technical Expertise: Provide technical support across DevSecOps domains, ensuring operational excellence, SLA compliance, zero P1 incidents, proactive issue resolution, and continuous service improvement.
* DevSecOps Platform Engineering: Design, implement, and govern enterprise DevSecOps platforms leveraging GitHub Enterprise, GHAS, GitHub Copilot Governance, GitHub Actions, SonarQube, Artifact Management, Terraform, Azure, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, and Microsoft Entra B2B/B2C/External Identities.
* Team Coordination: Act as the primary liaison between the Product Owner and the DevSecOps team to ensure effective collaboration, delivery, and operational support.
* Chapter Time – Knowledge \& Practice Sharing (10%): Dedicate 10% of capacity to knowledge sharing, best practices, standardization, technical awareness, and common engineering practices.
* Value\-Added Contribution: Drive DevSecOps standardization, automation, governance, and platform optimization, with a focus on improving security, developer experience, efficiency, scalability, quality, and operational effectiveness.
* Communication \& Stakeholder Management: Demonstrate strong communication, stakeholder engagement, documentation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and business audiences.

title: Manager, Technical Professional Services
description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Manager, Technical Professional Services
   

  

**About Your Role**
 As a Technical Project Manager, you will lead the planning and delivery of complex technology initiatives that support business priorities, operational performance, and client outcomes. You will work across engineering, product, operations, risk, and business teams to align scope, timelines, dependencies, and execution. Your work helps teams deliver solutions with clear accountability, measurable progress, and consistent project outcomes.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of technical projects, including project planning, scope management, milestone tracking, dependency management, and issue resolution
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to define project objectives, document requirements, establish success measures, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle
* Build and maintain integrated project plans, status reporting, risk logs, decision logs, and communication plans for multiple concurrent initiatives
* Coordinate with engineering and product teams to manage technical deliverables, release readiness, testing dependencies, and implementation activities
* Identify project risks, blockers, and resource constraints, and drive mitigation plans with clear owners, timelines, and escalation paths
* Facilitate project meetings, steering updates, and stakeholder reviews to communicate progress, decisions, and changes in scope, schedule, or priority
* Use project management tools and delivery frameworks to track execution, improve transparency, and support consistent project governance across teams
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.


**Experience You'll Need To Have**
* 8\+ years of experience in technical project management delivering software, platform, infrastructure, or enterprise technology initiatives across cross\-functional teams
* 8\+ years of experience building and maintaining project plans, managing risks and dependencies, and driving project execution from initiation through implementation
* Experience using project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or similar platforms for planning, tracking, and reporting
* Experience facilitating project governance, stakeholder communication, and status reporting with technical and business audiences
* Experience managing delivery using Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project methodologies in a technology environment
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.


**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**
* Experience supporting payments, financial technology, banking, or regulated industry initiatives
* Experience coordinating software releases, system integrations, or enterprise change initiatives
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent project delivery certification
* Experience working with data reporting tools to measure project health, delivery trends, and operational outcomes


**How You'll Work**
* This role is on\-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in\-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in\-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.


**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**
* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step\-by\-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).


**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
 Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
   

  

**Note To Agencies**
 Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
   

  

**Warning About Fake Job Posts**
 Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

title: Release Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Be part of something bigger. Decode the future.**
 At Electrolux Group, we’re embarking on a Digital Transformation journey, delivering world\-class Direct\-to\-Consumer (D2C) solutions through our Consumer Direct Interaction Organization (CDI XO). As part of a Delivery team embedded at a Digital Product Organization, we are looking for a skilled Release Manager to join our dynamic team, supporting our growth across Europe, APAC, and the Americas. In this role, you’ll play a critical part in ensuring the quality of our cutting\-edge solutions, all while working in a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment across multiple Agile Release Trains.
   

  

 We operate in a fast\-paced environment where timing is critical. When a timeline is committed, it is essential that we deliver on time. Delays in delivery can have a direct impact on our company targets and overall success, so timely execution and adherence to schedules is a key component of our delivery initiatives.
   

  

 If you have a passion for delivering successful releases, a background in driving release planning and execution for large\-scale E\-Commerce/CRM/ERP/Cloud Native in\-house digital products, thriving in a fast\-paced digital transformation environment, we want you to be a part of our journey.
   

  

 Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.
   

  

**All about the role:**
 Our mission as the Delivery team within CDI XO is to
 *"enable
 **smooth deliveries***
*of high\-quality digital products on
 **time and budget** 
 in CDI XO, providing
 **transparency** 
 to CAs and CDI stakeholders throughout the software delivery life\-cycle."*
 Therefore as a Release Manager within our Digital Product Organization, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring smooth, timely, uneventful releases across multiple Agile Release Trains in a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment.
   

  

 This position is a mix of:
   

  

* Hands\-on technical leader – requiring constant deep dives into systems, developing extensive knowledge of the technology architecture, and ensuring robust release processes.
* People leader – leading and mentoring a team of Release Engineers who manage technology\-specific releases, fostering collaboration and accountability across the delivery pipeline.


 Core Aspects of Release Management in Our Organization:
   

  

* Communication – Ensure transparency by generating clear release notes for any release exposing features to business or consumers.
* Calendar – Maintenance of a consolidated up\-to\-date release calendar, including freeze periods, enabling proper planning across all product teams.
* Execution – Orchestration of complex technical releases since planning until post go\-live validations, as well as dependency and resource management.
* Operational Efficiency – Continuous exploration of opportunities for automation with Engineering Org to reduce lead time of release execution.
* Governance – Establishment and enforcement of clear guidelines to enable smooth operations and uneventful releases.


**About the CDI Experience Organization:**
 The Consumer Direct Interaction Experience Organization is a Digital Product Organization responsible for delivering tech solutions to our end\-users and consumers across both pre\-purchase and post\-purchase journeys. We are organized in 15\+ digital product areas, providing solutions ranging from Contact Center, E\-commerce, Marketing, and Identity to AI. You will play a key role in ensuring the right sizing, right skillset, and core competency across these product areas.
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
* Perform deep and long\-term planning of a consolidated CDI XO Release calendar by aligning with all application owners expected release windows, blackout periods, taking into considerations business critical periods, such as Black Friday/Christmas.
* Own and manage the release planning, scheduling, and execution across digital product teams.
* Coordinate with Product Managers, Processes Owners, Tech Leads, Engineering Managers and Delivery Leads to ensure alignment on release timelines.
* Lead and mentor Release Engineers, providing guidance on best practices and career development.
* Identify and mitigate risks that could impact delivery schedules or product quality.
* Drive continuous improvement in release processes, ensuring efficiency and predictability.
* Act as the central point of contact for release communications, ensuring stakeholders are informed and aligned.
* Monitor release performance metrics and provide insights to leadership for decision\-making.
* Ensure compliance with organizational standards and governance for all releases.


**Who are you:**
* Proven experience (5\+ years) in Release Management, Delivery Management, or Project Management within digital product organizations.
* Solid experience in driving release planning and execution, preferably in a multiple technology domain such as E\-commerce/CRM/ERP rollouts.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working in a SAFe environment.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability of making multiple tactical/operational decisions on a daily basis.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment where timely execution is critical.
* Experience working with global teams across multiple regions (Europe, APAC, Americas) is a plus.
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and CI/CD pipelines is highly desirable.
* Sporadic need to cover business critical releases out of regular business hours.


**Where you'll be:**
 This is a full\-time position, based in Bangalore, India
   

  

**Benefits Highlights:**
* Flexible work hours and a hybrid work environment
* Discounts on our award\-winning Electrolux products and services
* Family\-friendly benefits
* Extensive learning opportunities and a flexible career path

 The
 **Senior Business Systems Analyst** 
 serves as a critical link between business stakeholders and technical teams.
 **This role is responsible for translating business needs into detailed, testable technical requirements for both user interface (UI) and API development work.**
 In addition to core business analysis responsibilities, this position performs hands\-on quality assurance activities, including test case creation, execution, defect documentation, and validation of system functionality. The ideal candidate is highly detail\-oriented, excels at clarifying ambiguity, and ensures that delivered solutions align precisely with documented requirements.
   

  

 This role operates in a collaborative Agile environment and partners closely with product owners, developers, and QA to ensure successful delivery of high\-quality software solutions.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document functional and non\-functional requirements
* Translate business needs into clear, structured user stories with detailed acceptance criteria
* Create clear and succinct technical requirements for:
+ User Interface (UI) components, workflows, validations, and user interactions
+ API functionality, including request/response structures, data mappings, business rules, and integration requirements

* Develop process flows, use cases, data mappings, and system documentation to support development efforts
* Ensure requirements are complete, testable, and traceable through the development lifecycle
* Facilitate story grooming with engineers and QAs
* Review completed work to confirm alignment with documented requirements
* Collaborate with QA to develop test strategies, test plans, and detailed test cases based on documented requirements
* As needed, execute functional, integration, and regression testing
* Validate UI behavior, data flows, and API responses against defined specifications
* Perform data validation and basic query analysis using SQL to ensure accuracy and completeness
* Support user acceptance testing (UAT) by preparing test scenarios and assisting business users


**What You Will Bring**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Business Systems Analyst or in a hybrid BA/QA role
* Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications for both UI and API development
* Hands\-on experience writing and executing test cases
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, data flows, and system integrations
* Working knowledge of SQL and ability to validate and analyze data
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and requirements documentation tools
* Strong analytical, documentation, and organizational skills, with excellent attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills


**What Will Set You Apart**
* Bachelor's degree in a related field preferred
* Experience in financial services or other regulated environments
* Comfort working closely with developers while maintaining an independent validation perspective
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams
* A proactive approach to identifying requirement gaps and edge cases

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
Esper revolutionizes device management by redefining what it should be: a driver of business growth. With advanced and modern capabilities, automation replaces outdated workflows, re\-provisioning becomes obsolete, and managing by exception transforms efficiency, resulting in increased efficiency, improved ROI, and bolsters security for device fleets of all sizes. Esper has been recognized as number 735 on Inc. Magazine's 2025 5000 fastest\-growing private companies in America, and 133 on the 2024 Deloitte Technology Fast 500\. Some of the world’s most innovative brands, like Google, Doordash, Taco Bell, Clinical ink, SF 49ers, and Intelity, rely on Esper to deliver exceptional device experiences. Esper partners with the leading mobile device hardware manufacturers, solution providers, and distributors globally.
   

  

 We’re looking for a SDE III to join Esper, who will be part of a team building Esper’s flagship product, the Esper Foundation for Android, a custom Android\-based operating system built for enterprises, optimized for dedicated Android devices.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer working with the Esper Foundation team, you will play a crucial role in the development, customization, and enhancement of our Android\-based platforms. You will be responsible for designing and implementing software solutions, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, and driving the technical direction of Foundation.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* xTS Testing: Lead the design, execution, and management of CTS, VTS, and GTS testing to ensure Android compatibility, security, and performance compliance across all Foundation platforms
* Issue Diagnosis \& Resolution: Investigate, analyze, and resolve test failures by collaborating with fellow engineers, ensuring quick resolution and minimal release delays
* Documentation \& Reporting: Maintain detailed documentation of test cases, execution results, and defect analysis to support continuous improvement and accountability
* Development and Customization: Outside of the primary charter of leading our testing and automation efforts, assist with development of the Esper Foundation for Android product at multiple levels of the stack
* Technical Ownership: Complete technical ownership on some of the Foundation components. Also, become the Subject Matter Expert(SME) for the team.


 What we are looking for
   

  

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience
* Experience: 2\-5 years of experience in software development or testing, with a strong focus on Android platform development, AOSP and Android test suites.
* Technical Skills:
* 
+ Strong software engineering fundamentals, including the use of version control systems like Git
+ Proficiency in Java or Kotlin for Android development.
+ Understanding of C/C\+\+ for low\-level programming and system integration.
+ Experience with Android SDK, NDK, and AOSP build systems.
+ Knowledge of Android security architecture and best practices.

* Problem\-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
* Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Team Player: Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with running Android on x86 hardware or on GSIs is a big plus.
* Experience working at third party, open\-source orgs like LineageOS is a big plus.
* Experience working with CTS tests and building CTS\-compliant Android platforms is desired.
* Experience working on Android OS for GMS certified devices is a huge plus.
* Familiarity with Android Enterprise features and device management APIs and/or experience building Android apps and working in the Enterprise space.

As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**EY Technology:**
 Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
   

  

**EY Technology** 
 supports our technology needs through three business units:
   

  

**Client Technology (CT) \-** 
 focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
   

  

**Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) –** 
 EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
   

  

**Information Security (Info Sec) \-** 
 Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The Technical Scrum Lead, Specialist is responsible for driving Agile adoption and execution within technology teams, ensuring efficient sprint execution and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. This role involves facilitating Agile ceremonies, such as sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews and retrospectives, to keep teams aligned and productive.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead cross\-functional agile teams in iterative technology development, ensuring smooth collaboration and adherence to Agile/Scrum principles.
* Coach teams on best practices, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improving agile maturity.
* Work closely with product owners and stakeholders to define, prioritize and align technology\-related outcomes with business goals.
* Identify and proactively remove roadblocks that hinder project progress, ensuring teams have the necessary resources and support.
* Manage stakeholder expectations by maintaining transparency around scope, schedule and budget while effectively addressing concerns.
* Facilitate key agile ceremonies such as daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives to ensure alignment and continuous improvement.
* Assist teams in estimating deliverables, increasing velocity and identifying opportunities for efficiency.
* Maintain product and sprint backlogs, ensuring tasks are documented, prioritized and aligned with evolving business needs.
* Apply agile methodologies to integrate changing customer inputs and business conditions into technology\-related product development.
* Serve as a mentor, thought leader and agile champion, participating in special projects to drive organizational agility.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience, with at least 5 years in Agile project management, Scrum Master roles, or technical leadership in software development.
* Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Strong expertise in Scrum, Kanban and SAFe frameworks, with a deep understanding of Agile principles and best practices.
* Hands\-on experience with JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps and other Agile project management tools.
* Proficiency in coding and technical concepts, including Java, Angular, Node.js, POSTMAN, CUCUMBER, AWS and SQL queries.
* Familiarity with version control and CI/CD tools such as GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, TDD/BDD and monitoring tools like Splunk and Honeycomb.
* Experience in monitoring and refining dashboards, optimizing workflows, and driving continuous process improvements in Agile environments.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship\-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)


**What We Look For**
* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well\-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Engineering Manager - MeanStack
description:
**About the Role:** 




 The Engineering Manager position entails the leadership of MCO global product development teams across the entirety of the software development life cycle. This role focuses on our MEAN stack platform (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular, Node.js) hosted on AWS, with MongoDB Atlas as the primary data layer. Key responsibilities encompass ensuring the quality of team outputs and optimizing customer experiences, along with maintaining strict adherence to coding standards and promoting automation initiatives.
 



 The role involves mentoring and guiding engineers, proactively identifying and mitigating technical risks, and facilitating effective communication between engineering and other stakeholders. The manager oversees deployment processes across AWS infrastructure, monitors system performance, and provides decisive technical leadership during incidents. Ultimately, this role aims to uphold the highest standards of professionalism and innovation in MCO software development practices.
 



**Responsibilities** 




**Agile \& Team Leadership** 



* Own the effectiveness of the Scrum Agile process and adherence to good agile practices for the team.
* Be responsible for the quality of the teams’ outputs and the customer experience of our products.
* Lead product development teams through all stages of the SDLC, from requirements gathering through production deployment on AWS.
* Foster a collaborative and innovative engineering culture focused on delivering high\-quality software products.
* Mentor and coach engineers to foster their technical growth and career development, with emphasis on modern JavaScript/TypeScript best practices.



**Technical Leadership – MEAN Stack \& AWS** 



* Hands\-on participation in all technical activities including architecture and design reviews, code reviews, coding, troubleshooting, and defect triage across the MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular, Node.js).
* Define and enforce coding standards and best practices within the engineering team for TypeScript/JavaScript, Angular component architecture, RESTful API design, and Node.js services.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure high code quality and adherence to engineering standards across the full stack.
* Oversee MongoDB Atlas configuration, schema design, indexing strategies, aggregation pipelines, and data migration processes.
* Drive architecture decisions for AWS services including EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, and related infrastructure.
* Identify technical risks and challenges early in the project lifecycle and propose mitigation strategies, particularly around scalability, security, and cloud cost optimisation.



**Delivery \& Operations** 



* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate product requirements into technical specifications.
* Drive automation in the engineering teams, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform/CloudFormation), and automated testing.
* Drive continuous improvement in development processes and tools to increase efficiency and quality.
* Act as a technical liaison between engineering, product management, and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate with Platform Test teams to ensure thorough testing and validation of software products.
* Oversee deployment and release processes using AWS\-based CI/CD to ensure smooth and reliable product launches.
* Monitor system performance via CloudWatch, application logging, and APM tooling; address technical issues promptly to maintain product stability.
* Provide technical leadership during incidents and outages, facilitating root cause analysis and resolution across the application and infrastructure layers.



**Experiences and Skills** 




**Required** 



* 10\+ years of experience in product development (including up to 3 years in engineering management).
* Strong full\-stack engineering experience with the MEAN stack: MongoDB, Express.js, Angular (2\+), and Node.js in a product development environment.
* Proven experience designing and operating production workloads on AWS, including services such as EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, and RDS/DocumentDB or MongoDB Atlas.
* Hands\-on proficiency with MongoDB Atlas: cluster management, performance tuning, indexing, aggregation framework, change streams, and backup/restore strategies.
* Maintain hands\-on involvement with coding approximately 20% of the time.
* Expertise in architecture and design reviews, system design, code reviews, customer issues, troubleshooting, and defect triage.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to resolve complex distributed\-systems issues.
* Demonstrates resilience and flexibility, consistently adapting while managing priorities with efficiency.
* A strong willingness to learn and a growth mindset.
* Excellent communication and servant\-leadership skills.
* Knowledge and experience of agile development methodology (Scrum, Agile, and Kanban).



**Preferred** 



* Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or CDK).
* Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS ECS/EKS).
* Experience with event\-driven architectures, message queues (SQS, SNS, Kafka), and microservices patterns.
* Background in a product\-driven SaaS or financial services company.



 Architect\-level experience is a plus.

title: Lead Software Release Manager
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Lead Software Release Manager
   

  

**Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Software Release Manager to lead end\-to\-end release planning, scheduling, and orchestration across a portfolio of 7\-8 interconnected software products and platforms. This role is responsible for establishing and maintaining an integrated release calendar that balances product roadmaps, engineering capacity, testing environment availability, customer commitments, regulatory requirements, and cross\-program dependencies.
   

  

 The ideal candidate thrives in complex enterprise environments where multiple teams, systems, and stakeholders must coordinate to successfully deliver high\-quality software releases. This individual will serve as the central point of coordination for release readiness, dependency management, environment planning, and deployment execution.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Release Planning \& Scheduling
   

  

* Own the enterprise release calendar across 7\-8 products and platforms.
* Develop and maintain integrated release schedules accounting for:
* Development milestones
* Integration testing windows
* Pre\-production validation
* Performance and scalability testing
* Production deployment windows
* Customer onboarding and certification timelines
* Coordinate release trains and major program increments across multiple teams.
* Balance competing priorities while optimizing release frequency and stability.


 Dependency Management
   

  

* Identify, document, track, and proactively manage:
* Product\-to\-product dependencies
* Program\-to\-program dependencies
* Infrastructure dependencies
* Vendor and external partner dependencies
* Customer readiness dependencies
* Facilitate dependency review forums and drive cross\-functional alignment.
* Resolve schedule conflicts and escalation issues impacting release delivery.


 Environment \& Capacity Management
   

  

* Govern utilization of critical testing and deployment environments, including:
* Integration environments
* System testing environments
* UAT environments
* Performance testing environments
* Pre\-production environments
* Production environments
* Coordinate environment reservations and conflict resolution across multiple teams.
* Ensure environment readiness, availability, and release sequencing.


 Release Readiness \& Governance
   

  

* Establish release entry and exit criteria.
* Conduct release readiness reviews and go/no\-go assessments.
* Verify completion of:
* Functional testing
* Integration testing
* Regression testing
* Performance testing
* Security validation
* Operational readiness activities
* Ensure change management and release governance processes are followed.


 Stakeholder Coordination
   

  

* Partner closely with:
* Engineering teams
* Product Managers
* Program Managers
* Quality Engineering teams
* Site Reliability Engineering teams
* Infrastructure teams
* Customer delivery teams
* Operations and Support organizations
* Communicate release plans, risks, constraints, and status to both technical and executive audiences.
* Drive alignment across globally distributed teams.


 Risk \& Issue Management
   

  

* Identify schedule, environment, resource, and operational risks early.
* Develop mitigation and contingency plans.
* Lead release war rooms for major deployments.
* Track and drive resolution of release blockers and critical dependencies.


 Metrics \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Define and monitor release management KPIs, including:
* Release predictability
* On\-time delivery
* Deployment success rate
* Environment utilization
* Defect leakage
* Change failure rate
* Continuously improve release planning processes, tooling, and governance.


**All About You**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 8\+ years of experience in software delivery, technical program management, release management, or engineering operations.
* 5\+ years managing enterprise\-scale software releases.
* Experience coordinating releases across multiple products and engineering teams simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of:
* SDLC
* Agile and Scrum methodologies
* DevOps practices
* CI/CD pipelines
* Change and release management processes
* Demonstrated experience managing complex dependency chains and cross\-functional delivery programs.
* Strong project planning, organization, and risk\-management skills.
* Excellent executive communication and stakeholder\-management capabilities.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in large\-scale distributed systems or payment\-processing platforms.
* Experience coordinating releases across globally distributed teams.
* Working knowledge of tools such as:
* Jira
* Azure DevOps
* GitHub Actions
* Jenkins
* XL Release / Digital.ai Release
* Splunk
* Confluence
* PMP, PMI\-ACP, SAFe, ITIL, or DevOps certifications.
* Experience supporting highly regulated or mission\-critical production environments.


 Success Measures
   

  

**A Successful Software Release Manager Will**
* Maintain a synchronized release schedule across 7\-8 products with minimal conflicts.
* Improve release predictability and on\-time delivery.
* Reduce environment contention and resource bottlenecks.
* Ensure all customer, platform, program, and infrastructure dependencies are proactively managed.
* Deliver production releases with high deployment success rates and low operational impact.
* Provide leadership visibility into release health, risks, and readiness.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Scrum Master - AVP
description:

Business Area: Customer Digital and Data


Area of Expertise: Change


Contract: Permanent


Reference Code: JR\-0000119322


  
Join us as a Scrum Master \- AVP at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
To be successful as a Scrum Master \- AVP, you should have experience with:


* Strong understanding of Scaled Agile and Scrum practices.
* Excellent Communication \& Stakeholder Facilitation.
* Familiarity with Agile Tooling (JIRA) \& Reporting Practices.
* Ability to Work Across Multi‑disciplinary, Distributed POD Structures.
* Ability to take e2e accountability of team delivering a quality product increment in every release.
* Ability to provide situational servant leadership to the team.
* Ability to manage complex projects in banking at enterprise scale.

Some other highly valued skills may include:


* Proven experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Delivery Lead.
* Strong understanding of Agile frameworks (Scrum, SAFe).
* Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and coaching teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience managing risks, issues, and dependencies.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.


The role is based out of Pune.


**Purpose of the role**


Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.


**Accountabilities**


1\.Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
  

2\.Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
  

3\.Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
  

4\.Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
  

5\.Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
  

6\.Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
  

7\.Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable  

  



**Assistant Vice President Expectations**


To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
  

Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
  

If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
  

OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
  

Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
  

Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
  

Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
  

Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
  

Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
  

Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
  

Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
  

Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

  

  

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

**Job Description**
 Delivery Coach / Scrum Master — Salesforce (Primary) \& NetSuite (Secondary)
   

  

**Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Delivery Coach / Scrum Master to lead delivery, primarily for our Salesforce team (approximately 90% of the role), with the remaining 10% supporting the NetSuite team. In this role you will act as a servant\-leader, facilitating Scrum ceremonies, coaching the team on Agile (and other) principles, and creating the conditions for high, sustainable delivery. You will remove impediments, protect the team's focus, and foster a culture of transparency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate combines strong facilitation and coaching skills with familiarity with the Salesforce delivery landscape.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Serve as the primary Scrum Master for the Salesforce team (\~90% of the role), facilitating all core Scrum ceremonies.
* Provide Scrum Master support to the NetSuite team as needed (\~10% of the role), coordinating across both workstreams.
* Coach both teams on Agile and Scrum practices, driving continuous improvement.
* Facilitate retrospectives that surface honest insights and produce concrete, tracked improvement actions.
* Identify, track, and remove impediments that block progress across the Salesforce and NetSuite teams.
* Protect the teams from external disruption and help maintain a sustainable pace.
* Partner with product owners to keep backlogs healthy, refined, and well\-prioritised.
* Manage cross\-team dependencies, especially where Salesforce and NetSuite integrate.

* Excellent communication, facilitation, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Effective stakeholder management across technical and business audiences.
* Ability to remove impediments and promote team self\-organisation.
* Proficiency with an Agile work\-tracking tool and delivery reporting.

 Tools \& Systems

* Impediment resolution: blockers identified and resolved in a timely manner.
* Delivery predictability: consistent achievement of sprint commitments and stable flow.
* Cross\-platform coordination: Salesforce/NetSuite dependencies managed smoothly.

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 In a world where data is critical to BCG's success, we are building first\-class, foundational capabilities and products across the firm. Within this vision, LEAP is delivering BCG's new Learning platform to power the firm's learning and development needs.
   

  

 Initially, you’ll work within the Data Product squad to build a custom data product in Snowflake as part of a broader transformation program of BCG’s learning technology. The data product will help enable AI\-driven learning and make learning data accessible to other teams and systems, including, for example, staffing and analytics. When the program has ended, you’ll be part of a Learning squad with RtB as its scope.

* Analyze processes and data needs, contributing to solution design and identifying practical approaches to business problems.
* Coordinate functional, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing to ensure solutions meet business requirements.

* Elicit, document, and validate requirements by engaging multiple stakeholder groups and subject matter experts.
* Write clear, well\-structured user stories and acceptance criteria understandable by both technical and functional colleagues.
* Create, update, and maintain requirements documentation (e.g., PRDs / functional specifications).
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, anticipating questions and translating technical details into plain language.
* Manage and triage support requests in a query management system (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Proactively flag risks and dependencies, keeping learner impact and business value as the priority.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

***Education***
* Bachelor's degree required.
* 5–8 years of experience as a business / systems analyst, ideally supporting or configuring enterprise applications.


**Experience / Knowledge**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5\-7 years of experience with Learning or HR applications.

You will be responsible for re\-engineering core finance processes\-specifically in Budgeting, Forecasting, and Budgetary Control\-and translating those needs into a robust digital architecture. You are not just a functional expert or a developer; you are the bridge that ensures technology serves financial accuracy and operational efficiency.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Project Orchestration: Lead cross\-functional sprints between Finance and IT/GDIA to ensure digital tools are delivered on time and meet functional requirements.
* Process Architecture \& Value Stream Mapping: Lead the end\-to\-end mapping of finance workstreams (Planning, Forecasting, Month\-end Close, and Budget Control). Utilize Value Stream Mapping (VSM) and process flow charting to identify bottlenecks and "friction points," designing future state architectures that eliminate manual intervention.
* The Strategic Bridge: Act as the primary translator between Finance stakeholders and IT/Data Engineering teams. Connect the dots between business requirements and technical execution, ensuring that automated solutions solve real\-world financial pain points.
* Systems \& Data Integration: Optimize and integrate finance workflows within SAP S/4HANA and Oracle Essbase environments. Ensure that data flows seamlessly between ERP systems, process workflows, and reporting layers.
* Solution Design \& Automation: Develop and prototype efficiency tools like Data Form, the MS Power Platform (Power Automate/Apps), or Visualization tools (e.g. Power BI). Identify the "right tool for the job" to improve process velocity and data integrity.
* Agentic AI \& Innovation: Identify use cases for Agentic AI and LLMs to handle cognitive finance tasks, such as automated variance analysis, complex reconciliations, and predictive forecasting.
* Data Strategy \& Lineage: Oversee the migration of finance data into Data Lakes/EDP. Ensure a "single source of truth" by maintaining strict data lineage and integrity across all automated reporting outputs.
* Digital Capability \& Citizen Development: Serve as a Lead Citizen Developer and "AI Evangelist" for the Finance team. Design and deliver hands\-on training sessions to upskill colleagues on "last\-mile" technologies, including Generative AI/LLM prompt engineering, Power Platform (Power Automate/Apps), and data visualization. Your goal is to foster a culture of technical curiosity and empower the broader finance organization to build their own automated micro\-solutions.

* Methodology: Proven experience in Lean Six Sigma tools, specifically VSM and bottleneck analysis.
