title: Senior Scrum Master (Cyber)
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
   

  

 Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
   

  

 Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The
 **D\&T Scrum Manter (Cyber Security / DTIS)** 
 is responsible for the
 **end\-to\-end delivery of cyber security, information security, risk reduction and compliance initiatives** 
 within Haleon's
 **Digital \& Technology Information Security (DTIS)** 
 organisation.
   

  

*The Scrum Manter is responsible for driving governance, planning, reporting and operational oversight across Cyber Security and Information Security initiatives within the Run and Maintain portfolio. This includes initiatives such as Identity \& Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Security Operations, Vulnerability Management, Data Protection, Security Compliance, Cloud Security and Cyber Risk Remediation programs. The role ensures delivery predictability, stakeholder transparency, portfolio control and continuous improvement across DTIS initiatives.*
 The role ensures projects are delivered with
 **discipline, transparency and predictability** 
 , operating within established delivery frameworks, cyber security governance standards, risk management processes and portfolio controls. Working closely with business stakeholders, DTIS teams, delivery partners and suppliers, the Scrum Manter maintains clear ownership of scope, plans, risks and security outcomes.
   

  

 This role is suited to an experienced delivery professional who is comfortable operating in
 **complex, enterprise cyber security environments** 
 , managing multiple stakeholders and suppliers, and providing clear, reliable insight throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 To deliver Cyber Security and DTIS projects
 **safely and predictably** 
 , ensuring agreed business and security outcomes are achieved by applying standard delivery frameworks, proactively managing cyber risks and dependencies, and maintaining effective communication with stakeholders and leadership.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
 The D\&T Scrum Manter is accountable for:
   

  

* Successful end\-to\-end delivery of assigned Cyber Security and DTIS projects.
* Consistent application of DTIS governance, risk management and delivery frameworks.
* Effective management of scope, plans, cyber risks, issues and dependencies.
* Clear and timely reporting of project status, cyber risk posture and key decisions.
* Strong stakeholder, vendor and security partner management.
* Maintaining focus on agreed business, compliance and security outcomes.
* Supporting the reduction of cyber risk through effective delivery of security remediation initiatives.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Project Delivery \& Execution
* Own the delivery of assigned Cyber Security and DTIS projects from initiation through closure.
* Deliver security initiatives including Identity \& Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Vulnerability Management, Data Protection, Security Operations, Cloud Security and Infrastructure Security.
* Ensure projects deliver agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, security controls and business outcomes.
* Apply standard D\&T delivery approaches (Waterfall, Agile or Hybrid as appropriate).
* Planning \& Control
* Develop and maintain robust project plans, including milestones, dependencies and critical paths.
* Coordinate delivery activities across security, infrastructure, application and business teams.
* Track remediation commitments and ensure timely closure of security actions.
* Manage project changes in a controlled and transparent manner.
* Risk, Issue \& Dependency Management
* Proactively identify, manage and escalate cyber security risks, issues and dependencies.
* Coordinate remediation of findings resulting from security assessments, audits, penetration testing and compliance reviews.
* Ensure mitigation actions are clearly defined, owned and tracked to closure.
* Maintain an accurate view of project health, cyber risk exposure and delivery confidence at all times.
* Stakeholder Management \& Communication
* Act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across business, DTIS, Risk, Privacy, Infrastructure, Application teams and suppliers.
* Provide clear, honest and timely communication regarding project status, cyber risks, remediation progress, decisions and impacts.
* Facilitate governance, steering committee and cyber risk review meetings.
* Manage expectations and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
* Financial \& Resource Management (Project Level)
* Manage project budgets, forecasts and financial controls within delegated authority.
* Work with Finance partners to provide accurate financial reporting and visibility of variances.
* Ensure project resources, security SMEs and technical teams are planned and utilised effectively.
* Supplier \& Third\-Party Management
* Manage delivery contributions from third\-party security vendors, managed security service providers (MSSPs) and implementation partners.
* Ensure suppliers deliver to agreed timelines, quality, security and contractual requirements.
* Escalate supplier performance issues through appropriate governance channels.
* Governance \& Reporting
* Operate within established cyber security governance frameworks, ensuring all required artefacts and controls are maintained.
* Provide accurate, decision\-oriented reporting into DTIS leadership, portfolio, assurance and risk forums.
* Support internal audits, external audits, compliance assessments and stage\-gate reviews.
* Track and report cyber risk reduction and remediation metrics.
* Outcomes, Adoption \& Handover
* Maintain focus on agreed business, security and compliance outcomes throughout delivery.
* Support operational transition and handover activities to Security Operations and support teams.
* Contribute to benefits realisation and cyber risk reduction tracking.
* Continuous Improvement \& Professional Standards
* Apply lessons learned and cyber security best practices to improve delivery effectiveness.
* Contribute positively to DTIS delivery standards, governance maturity and ways of working.
* Demonstrate accountability, professionalism and strong delivery discipline.
* Promote a culture of security awareness and risk\-based decision making.


**What Good Looks Like**
* Cyber Security and DTIS projects are delivered with few surprises and clear delivery confidence.
* Security risks, vulnerabilities and audit findings are identified early and remediated proactively.
* Stakeholders have clear visibility of project progress, security posture and remediation status.
* Cyber governance processes are followed consistently and professionally.
* Security controls are successfully implemented and adopted.
* Business, compliance and security outcomes are achieved.
* The Scrum Manter is seen as reliable, organised and accountable.


**Essential**
**Qualifications \& Skills**
* 8 – 13 years of experience delivering projects in Cyber Security, Information Security, Technology Risk, Digital or Technology environments.
* Strong understanding of cyber security domains including:
+ Identity \& Access Management (IAM)
+ Privileged Access Management (PAM)
+ Vulnerability Management
+ Security Operations (SOC)
+ Endpoint Security
+ Network Security
+ Data Protection
+ Cloud Security

* Experience managing security remediation programs arising from audits, penetration testing and risk assessments.
* Strong understanding of cyber risk management, security governance and compliance requirements.
* Experience managing risks, dependencies and stakeholder expectations in complex environments.
* Strong planning, organisational and communication skills.
* Comfortable working in global, matrixed and highly regulated environments.


**Preferred**
* Experience operating within enterprise cyber security governance and portfolio frameworks.
* Experience working with Security Operations Centres (SOC) and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs).
* Exposure to security frameworks including ISO 27001, NIST Cyber Security Framework, CIS Controls and GDPR/Data Privacy requirements.
* Experience delivering cloud security initiatives across Azure, AWS or GCP environments.
* Experience managing third\-party suppliers and security technology vendors.
* Relevant delivery certifications (PRINCE2, PMP, Agile Practitioner or equivalent).
* Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CCSP or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor.


**Job Posting End Date**
 2026\-09\-26
   

  

**Equal Opportunities**
 Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
   

  

 During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
   

  

 The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

title: Senior Scrum Master (CTO)
description:

 Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The
 **D\&T Scrum Manter \- CTO Infrastructure \& Network Services** 
 is responsible for the
 **end\-to\-end delivery of technology projects** 
 within Haleon's
 **Digital \& Technology (D\&T)** 
 organisation.
   

  

*The Scrum Manter is responsible for driving governance, planning, reporting and operational oversight across Chief Technology Office (CTO) Infrastructure and Network initiatives within the Run and Maintain portfolio. This includes Data Center Modernization, Network Transformation, Cloud Infrastructure, Server \& Storage Services, End User Computing, Enterprise Connectivity, WAN/LAN Refresh, SD\-WAN, Network Security, Unified Communications, Infrastructure Resilience, and Disaster Recovery programs. The role ensures delivery predictability, operational stability, infrastructure reliability, and continuous improvement across enterprise technology services.*
 The role ensures projects are delivered with
 **discipline, transparency and predictability** 
 , operating within established delivery frameworks, governance standards and portfolio processes. Working closely with business stakeholders, delivery partners and cross\-functional D\&T teams, the Scrum Manter maintains clear ownership of scope, plans, risks and outcomes.
   

  

 This role is suited to an experienced delivery professional who is comfortable operating in
 **structured, enterprise delivery environments** 
 , managing multiple stakeholders and suppliers, and providing clear, reliable insight throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

**Role purpose**
 To deliver D\&T Infrastructure and Network projects
 **safely and predictably** 
 , ensuring agreed outcomes are achieved by applying standard delivery frameworks, managing risks and dependencies proactively, and maintaining clear communication with stakeholders and leadership.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
 The D\&T Scrum Manter is accountable for:
   

  

* Successful end\-to\-end delivery of assigned D\&T projects.
* Consistent application of D\&T delivery frameworks and governance.
* Effective management of scope, plans, risks, issues and dependencies.
* Clear, timely reporting of project status, risks and decisions.
* Strong stakeholder and supplier management.
* Maintaining focus on agreed business outcomes.
* Successful delivery of Infrastructure and Network transformation initiatives.
* Management of enterprise infrastructure lifecycle and modernization programs.
* Delivery of network, cloud, hosting and workplace technology projects.
* Effective management of technical risks, operational dependencies and service impacts.
* Strong collaboration with Architecture, Engineering, Operations and Service Management teams.
* Supporting operational resilience, availability and business continuity objectives.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Project Delivery \& Execution
* Own the delivery of assigned projects from initiation through to closure.
* Ensure projects deliver agreed scope, timelines, quality standards and outcomes.
* Apply standard D\&T delivery approaches (Waterfall, Agile or Hybrid as appropriate).
* Lead delivery of infrastructure modernization initiatives including compute, storage, virtualization, backup and disaster recovery capabilities.
* Manage technology refresh programs involving servers, operating systems, databases and enterprise platforms.
* Coordinate infrastructure migrations, datacenter exits, cloud adoption and application hosting transformations.
* Ensure infrastructure projects comply with architecture, security and operational standards.
* Planning \& Control
* Develop and maintain robust project plans, including milestones, dependencies and critical paths.
* Track progress against plan and take corrective action where deviations occur.
* Manage change in a controlled and transparent way.
* Coordinate delivery plans across infrastructure, network, cloud and service management teams.
* Manage interdependencies across multiple technology towers and suppliers.
* Risk, Issue \& Dependency Management
* Proactively identify, manage and escalate project risks, issues and dependencies.
* Ensure mitigation actions are clearly defined, owned and tracked to closure.
* Maintain an accurate view of project health and delivery confidence at all times.
* Manage infrastructure, network and cloud\-related delivery risks.
* Drive proactive remediation of service, resilience and operational risks.
* Stakeholder Management \& Communication
* Act as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders across business, D\&T and suppliers.
* Provide clear, honest and timely communication on progress, risks, decisions and impacts.
* Manage expectations and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
* Partner closely with Infrastructure Engineering, Network Services, Cloud Operations and Enterprise Architecture teams.
* Financial \& Resource Management (Project Level)
* Manage project budgets, forecasts and financial controls within delegated authority.
* Work with Finance partners to provide accurate financial reporting and early visibility of variances.
* Ensure project resources and capacity are planned and used effectively.
* Manage infrastructure vendor budgets and technology refresh investments.
* Supplier \& Third\-Party Management
* Manage delivery contributions from third\-party suppliers within the project scope.
* Ensure suppliers deliver to agreed timelines, quality and contractual expectations.
* Escalate supplier performance or dependency issues through appropriate governance forums.
* Manage infrastructure delivery partners, telecommunications providers, cloud vendors and managed service providers.
* Governance \& Reporting
* Operate within established delivery governance, ensuring all required artefacts and controls are maintained.
* Provide accurate, decision\-oriented reporting into portfolio, performance and assurance forums.
* Support reviews, stage gates and audits as required.
* Report on infrastructure modernization, cloud migration and network transformation progress.
* Outcomes, Adoption \& Handover
* Maintain focus on agreed business outcomes throughout delivery.
* Support transition, handover and closure activities to enable successful adoption and ongoing ownership.
* Contribute to benefits realisation tracking where applicable.
* Ensure operational readiness, support model alignment and service transition activities are successfully completed.
* Continuous Improvement \& Professional Standards
* Apply lessons learned and best practice to improve delivery effectiveness.
* Contribute positively to D\&T delivery standards, ways of working and capability maturity.
* Demonstrate accountability, professionalism and strong delivery discipline.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across infrastructure and network services.


**Infrastructure \& Network Specific Responsibilities**
**Network \& Connectivity Programs**
* Deliver enterprise network initiatives covering LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, SD\-WAN, DNS, DHCP and IPAM services.
* Manage global network transformation and connectivity projects across manufacturing, office and remote locations.
* Coordinate network upgrades, site migrations, bandwidth optimization and connectivity improvements.
* Ensure high availability, performance and resilience of enterprise network services.


**Cloud Infrastructure Management**
* Support cloud transformation initiatives across Azure, AWS and hybrid\-cloud environments.
* Coordinate cloud onboarding, migration and infrastructure optimization projects.
* Work closely with Cloud Engineering and Architecture teams to ensure scalable and secure deployments.


**Data Centre \& Platform Services**
* Manage datacenter consolidation, infrastructure refresh and platform migration initiatives.
* Coordinate implementation of storage, backup, virtualization and disaster recovery solutions.
* Support capacity planning and infrastructure lifecycle management activities.


**Service Reliability \& Operational Excellence**
* Drive initiatives focused on availability, reliability, resilience and operational maturity.
* Coordinate remediation of recurring incidents and technical debt reduction activities.
* Support business continuity and disaster recovery testing programs.


**What Good Looks Like**
* Projects are delivered with few surprises and clear delivery confidence.
* Risks and issues are identified early and managed proactively.
* Stakeholders have a clear understanding of progress, decisions and next steps.
* Delivery governance is followed consistently and professionally.
* Outcomes are achieved and transitions are well managed.
* The Scrum Manter is seen as reliable, organised and accountable.
* Infrastructure and network projects are delivered on time with minimal business disruption.
* Enterprise platforms maintain high availability and operational stability.
* Network performance, reliability and user experience improve continuously.
* Infrastructure risks and service dependencies are managed proactively.
* Cloud and infrastructure migrations are completed successfully with controlled impact.
* Stakeholders have clear visibility of project progress, costs, risks and operational outcomes.
* Service resilience and disaster recovery capabilities meet business expectations.


**Essential**
**Qualifications \& Skills**
* 8 – 13 years of demonstrated experience delivering projects in Digital, Technology, Infrastructure, Network, Cloud or Enterprise Technology environments.
* Strong understanding of structured delivery approaches (Waterfall, Agile or Hybrid).
* Experience managing risks, dependencies and stakeholder expectations.
* Strong planning, organisational and communication skills.
* Comfortable working in complex, matrixed environments.
* Demonstrated experience delivering Infrastructure, Network, Cloud or Enterprise Technology projects.
* Strong understanding of:
+ Enterprise Infrastructure Services
+ Data Center Operations
+ Cloud Infrastructure (Azure, AWS)
+ Servers, Storage and Virtualization
+ Network Services (LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi)
+ SD\-WAN and Enterprise Connectivity
+ Unified Communications
+ Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity
+ IT Service Management (ITIL)
+ Infrastructure Lifecycle Management

* Experience managing infrastructure transformation and migration programs.
* Strong stakeholder, supplier and operational risk management skills.
* Experience working within global, matrixed environments.


**Preferred**
* Experience operating within enterprise portfolio and governance frameworks.
* Exposure to regulated, operational or large\-scale environments.
* Experience managing third\-party suppliers.
* Experience delivering large\-scale network transformation initiatives.
* Experience supporting cloud migration and hybrid\-cloud environments.
* Familiarity with Cisco, Arista, Palo Alto, F5, VMware, Microsoft Azure and AWS technologies.
* Experience managing datacenter migration or consolidation programs.
* Understanding of network security, infrastructure resilience and operational excellence practices.
* Experience operating within ITIL\-based service organizations.

It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.

description:

 AB InBev GCC was incorporated in 2014 as a strategic partner for Anheuser\-Busch InBev. The centre leverages the power of data and analytics to drive growth for critical business functions such as operations, finance, people, and technology. The teams are transforming Operations through Tech and Analytics.
 



  





*Do You Dream Big?* 




  





*We Need You.* 




  





**Job Title: Senior Manager, Gen AI Martech** 




  





**Reporting to: Director** 




  





**PURPOSE OF ROLE** 




  





 To program manage the delivery, scaling and adoption of enterprise AI intelligence products that can translate business requirements into trusted insights and actionable recommendations for business leaders. The role bridges stakeholders, product, data, analytics, and technology teams to define use cases, align roadmaps, implement features, and ensure the products create measurable business impact.
 



  





**KEY TASKS AND ACCOUNTABILITIES** 




  




* Own end\-to\-end program management for conversational AI intelligence products, from intake and prioritization through delivery, launch, adoption, and performance tracking.

 3\. BUSINESS ENVIRONMENT
 



  





**Main Characteristics:** 




 This role operates in a fast\-moving AI product environment where business teams need practical intelligence products that improve decision\-making, automate insight access, and create repeatable ways of working. The role requires strong program discipline, stakeholder management, product fluency, and enough technical understanding to partner effectively with data and engineering teams.
 



  





 Geographical Scope: Global / Zone scope depending on product portfolio and deployment roadmap.

 Business stakeholders and functional leaders who sponsor use cases and define adoption needs.
 



 Product leaders and product managers responsible for roadmap, prioritization, user experience, and release planning.
 



 Data science, data engineering, analytics engineering, platform, architecture, security, and privacy teams responsible for implementation and governance.
 



 Analytics, insights, commercial, revenue management, marketing, operations, and transformation teams as end users and adoption partners.
 



 External technology or implementation partners where needed to accelerate delivery while protecting product ownership and avoiding vendor lock\-in.
 



  





**QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, SKILLS** 




 Please list the following requirements
 



  





**Level of educational attainment required:** 



* BS degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data/Analytics, Business, or related field. MBA, Masters degree, product management certification, or agile/program management certification preferred.

Experience with AI, GenAI, conversational products, analytics products, data platforms, or digital transformation strongly preferred. CPG or enterprise\-scale technology experience is a plus.

**Goal**

 Optimizing business operations

 IT leadership

 Entrepreneurship
 



 Delivering competitive advantage

We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.
   

  

 As a member of RSM’s Application Development and Integration (AppDev) team, you will be key to helping our clients along the digital transformation journey with advanced software enhancements and integrations. The AppDev team is responsible for designing, development, and deploying those solutions in a way which provides the maximum value to our clients while also ensuring that the delivered approach will be supportable in the future.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead client engagements from discovery through delivery, acting as the primary technical advisor and trusted partner in defining solutions that maximize ROI
* Architect scalable, maintainable software solutions across web and mobile platforms, ensuring quality standards and technical excellence throughout the development lifecycle
* Manage and mentor development teams through agile delivery, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, task delegation, and code reviews
* Drive business development activities including proposal creation, solution estimates, technical discovery calls, and presentations to prospective clients
* Facilitate stakeholder alignment through effective meeting leadership with both clients and internal teams, translating technical concepts for diverse audiences


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience building custom web and mobile applications using Microsoft .NET, modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Vue, or Angular), and SQL Server
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage client relationships and drive technical conversations with business stakeholders
* Strong communication, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills with an entrepreneurial mindset
* Travel expectations: Less than 10%


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Deep understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and DevOps practices
* Experience with cloud platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure, including architecture and deployment strategies
* Proven track record participating in business development activities such as proposal writing, effort estimation, and client presentations
* Expertise in web service architectures, API design patterns, and system integration approaches
* Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and evaluate new technologies and frameworks
* Experience with Agile/Scrum ceremonies and practices in client\-facing environments


 At RSM, we offer a competitive benefits and compensation package for all our people. We offer flexibility in your schedule, empowering you to balance life’s demands, while also maintaining your ability to serve clients. Learn more about our total rewards at https://rsmus.com/careers/india.html.

title: Software Engineering Senior Manager - Payments/Support
description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Software Engineering Senior Manager

 **In this role, you will:**

* Manage, coach, and develop a team or teams of experienced engineers and engineering managers in roles with moderate complexity and risk, responsible for building high quality capabilities with modern technology
* Ensure adherence to the Banking Platform Architecture, and meeting non\-functional requirements with each release
* Partner with, engage and influence architects and experienced engineers to incorporate Wells Fargo Technology technical strategies, while understanding next generation domain architecture and enable application migration paths to target architecture; for example cloud readiness, application modernization, data strategy
* Function as the technical representative for the product during cross\-team collaborative efforts and planning
* Identify and recommend opportunities for driving escalated resolution of technology roadblocks including code, build and deployment while also managing overall software development cycle and security standards
* Determine appropriate strategy and actions to act as an escalation partner for scrum masters and the teams to meet moderate to high risk deliverables and help remove impediments, obstacles, and friction while encouraging constant learning, experimentation, and continual improvement
* Build engineering skills side\-by\-side in the codebase, conduct peer reviews to evaluate quality and solution alignment to technical direction, and guide design, as needed
* Interpret, develop and ensure security, stability, and scalability within functions of technology with moderate complexity, as well as identify, manage and mitigate technology and enterprise risk
* Collaborate with, partner with and influence Product Managers/Product Owners to drive user satisfaction, influence technology requirements and priorities in the product roadmap, promote innovative and intelligent solutions, generate corporate value and articulate technical strategy while being a solid advocate of agile and DevOps practices
* Interact directly with third party vendors and technology service providers
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources to ensure commitments are met and align with strategic objectives in technology engineering
* Hire, build and guide a culture of talent development to have the skills required to effectively design and deliver innovative solutions for product areas and products to meet business objectives and strategy, as well as conduct performance management for engineers and managers

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 7\+ years of Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 3\+ years of management or leadership experience

 **Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience in Software Engineering, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* Management or leadership experience
* Expertise US domestic payments
* Expertise in building complex and 24x7 available payment solutions
* Good hands on with latest technology stack
* Have exposure in developing scalable solutions on cloud platforms
* Exposure in handling platforms and L2/L3 support
* Expertise with best engineering practices
* We are looking for strong tech profile in java, kafka, mongo, envent\-driven\-architecture with design \& solutioning background, and mandatory payments domain.
* Good understanding on US Domestic \& Cross boarder payments
* Must have worked on one or more of the payment rails Wires, ACH, Real Time Payments, Zelle, Card
* Fair understanding on ISO 20022 payment message specs
* Knowledge on SWIFT cross boarder payments
* Knowledge on payment regulations like OFAC, Dodd\-Frank, SEPA etc..
* Strong hold on NFRs in building resilient \& scalable payment solutions

 **Job Expectations:**

* Lead couple of scrums on end\-to\-end delivery
* Having collaboration with US business and Tech stake holders
* Handling dependencies with different tech teams and partners
* Leading high performing teams
* Ensuring application resiliency and platform stability for critical 24/7 payments systems

**Posting End Date:**


17 Sep 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**


Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.


Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. title: SyteLine Functional Consultant, Principal
description:

o Receiving and supplier processes

o Engineering Change Management  

o Product structures  

o Revision management  

o Engineering data### **Basic Qualifications:**

* Experience working on at least one complete SyteLine implementation or major upgrade.
* Strong requirement\-gathering and business\-analysis skills.
* Ability to prepare functional specifications and solution\-design documents.
* Experience with ERP testing methodologies and UAT management.
* Good understanding of ERP integrations and interfaces.

title: Senior Scrum Master
description:
Senior Scrum Master
As the **Senior Scrum Master – Content \& Publication (Retail/E\-commerce)**, you will play a crucial role in helping the team to deliver high\-impact projects that enhance our retail and e\-commerce. You will be responsible for guiding multiple scrum teams, ensuring effective agile practices, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. You will work closely with product owners, development teams, technology \& leadership to ensure that our Data \& Analytics solutions meet business needs and drive operational efficiency.

 **You will:**

* **Scrum Operations:** Setting up the Scrum structure including the JIRA boards, labelling, swim lanes, effort estimates, prioritization, performance, documentation management, testing, deployment, etc.
* **Facilitate Scrum Events:** Lead daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring teams are aligned and focused on delivering high\-quality products.
* **Guide Agile Practices:** Mentor and coach scrum teams on agile methodologies, fostering a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and continuous improvement.
* **Remove Impediments:** Identify and resolve obstacles that may hinder the team’s progress, escalating issues when necessary to maintain momentum.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, and other teams to understand requirements, manage expectations, and ensure clear communication of project status and timelines.
* **Performance Tracking:** Monitor team performance using agile metrics and KPIs, such as velocity, burndown charts, and cycle time, to provide insights and drive improvement.
* **Improvements:** Continuously assess and enhance agile processes and practices within the teams, leveraging feedback and lessons learned to optimize delivery based on the retrospective team's throughput \& operational performance.
* **Risk Management:** Proactively identify potential risks and dependencies, working with the team and stakeholders to mitigate them and ensure successful project delivery.
* **Process Management:** Define, own and drive the processes for new project intake, incident / breakdowns, small scale upgrades, etc. and translating them into Scrum operations.
* **Communications:** Lead the engagement, alignment \& integration with the larger portfolio \& project management office along with enterprise communications about Data \& Analytics project statuses, business impact, challenges, risks, dependencies, etc. for visibility \& transparency.
* **Miscellaneous:** Conducting \& coordinating online fun events and celebrating small/big successes/team's accomplishments for enabling greater collaboration among the team members across the globe.
* Sending newsletters for recognition, celebrating small/big successes/team's accomplishments, etc.
* **(Optional):** Coordinate \& conduct online fun events for enabling greater collaborations among the team members across the globe.

  



**You have:**

* **Experience:** Minimum of 7–10 years of experience as a Scrum Master \& Delivery Manager, with at least 2 years in a senior role, preferably within the Data \& Analytics function in retail, or e\-commerce domain.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. A master’s degree is a plus.
* **Certifications:** Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM). Advanced certifications such as SAFe Scrum Master or Certified Agile Coach are highly desirable.
* **Agile Expertise:** Deep understanding of agile principles, frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, etc.), and best practices, with a proven track record of successful agile implementations.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels.
* **Problem\-Solving:** Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying issues and implementing solutions.
* **Leadership:** Proven ability to lead and inspire teams, driving a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.
* **(Strong plus though not mandatory) Functional Understanding:** Deep understanding of Data \& Analytics functions particularly within the retail or e\-commerce industry.

 **Why vidaXL**

  

vidaXL is a major player in the ever\-growing world of e\-commerce. Since our foundation in 2006, we've expanded our global reach, serving millions of customers with a vast selection of products for every aspect of their lives. Our bold and down\-to\-earth approach sets us apart. We embrace challenges, take chances, and try new things every day, all with the goal of providing the best possible experience for our customers.

  

We believe in our people, and we love to invest in their personal growth. We offer the freedom to seize opportunities, thrive, and grow alongside a global e\-commerce leader.

  

Join us to growXL!

We look forward to your application! For more information, contact our Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist : Vineeth Kumar

  

Your privacy is important to us! For more information, visit: Privacy and cookie statement \| vidaXL

title: Engineering Manager-NetSuite
description:
**About MISUMI Americas**
 MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
   

  

 What’s in it for you?
   

  

**Opportunity To Unlock Your Creativity**
 Think of all the times you were held back from trying new ideas because you were boxed in by bureaucratic legacy processes or old school tactics. Having a growth mindset is deeply ingrained into our company culture since day 1 so Fictiv is an environment where you have the creative liberty and support of the team to try big bold ideas to achieve our sales and customer goals.
   

  

**Opportunity To Grow Your Career**
 There are plenty of jobs out there. The question is whether any of them will help you grow in your career? Will you be challenged by teammates to achieve your potential? Or are they roles that will ask you to do more of what you've already mastered. At Fictiv, you'll be surrounded by supportive teammates who will push you to be your best through their curiosity and passion.
   

  

 Impact In This Role
   

  

 Fictiv is seeking a hands\-on, deeply technical Engineering Manager to lead our NetSuite team. This is not a purely people\-management role. The right candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering leadership and technical craft — someone who can jump into the code to debug a complex issue, write a detailed technical design document, and then step back to coach an engineer on how to approach the problem differently.
   

  

 Our NetSuite environment supports a complex, multi\-subsidiary OneWorld deployment spanning multiple regions globally, serving a make\-to\-order custom manufacturing operation across multiple industries. The Engineering Manager will set the technical bar for the team, drive architectural decisions, and build the processes and practices that allow the engineering team to deliver at high quality and velocity.
   

  

 This role reports to the Sr Director of Engineering, IT Systems.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
**Hands\-On Technical Leadership**
* Actively participate in technical work alongside the team — reviewing, and debugging code as needed to unblock engineers, validate approaches, or accelerate critical deliveries.
* Author and own technical design documents (TDDs) for significant platform changes, new integrations, and architectural decisions, covering solution design, data flow, error handling, performance considerations, and trade\-offs.
* Lead architecture reviews for new features, customizations, and integrations, ensuring decisions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with NetSuite best practices.
* Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews — holding the team to a high and consistent engineering standard.
* Set standards for development and customization work, including guidelines for SuiteScript patterns, SuiteFlow design, custom record architecture, and integration approaches.
* Review and provide technical direction on team deliverables.
* Maintain a deep, current understanding of NetSuite capabilities and stay informed on upcoming release changes that may impact the business.
* Lead technical evaluation of new NetSuite modules, third\-party tools, and integration platforms, producing structured analysis comparing options on capability, cost, risk, and architectural fit.
* Drive proactive identification and remediation of technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and architectural risks before they affect business operations.


**Development \& Deployment Practices**
* Own and continuously improve the team's software development lifecycle, from requirements intake through design, development, testing, deployment, and post\-release monitoring.
* Mature the team's CI/CD pipeline built on SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF) and GitHub Actions, improving reliability, test coverage, deployment speed, and rollback capability across QA, Staging, and Production environments.
* Build efficient, repeatable engineering workflows that reduce manual work, minimize deployment risk, and enable the team to ship with confidence.
* Establish clear incident response practices for production issues, including on\-call expectations, severity classification, root cause analysis, and post\-mortem documentation.
* Champion the use of tooling, automation, and documentation to reduce knowledge silos and accelerate onboarding of new team members.


**Project Management**
* Manage the engineering team's project portfolio, balancing implementation work, enhancements, integrations, and technical debt reduction.
* Lead project planning and estimation for initiatives, working with stakeholders to define scope, timelines, deliverables, and success criteria.
* Coordinate dependencies across concurrent projects and ensure resources are appropriately allocated to meet commitments.
* Partner with business stakeholders and the Director of Engineering to prioritize work, communicate progress, manage scope changes, and escalate risks.
* Own delivery accountability for projects, tracking progress against milestones and ensuring the team ships on schedule with quality.
* Conduct project retrospectives to identify lessons learned and continuously improve the team's delivery practices.


**Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Alignment**
* Own the technical architecture of NetSuite across all subsidiaries, ensuring the system is structured to support complex manufacturing workflows including multi\-vendor BOMs, intercompany fulfillment, transfer order processing, and landed cost management.
* Serve as the engineering point of contact for business stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Quality functions.
* Translate complex business requirements into clearly scoped technical solutions, and communicate technical constraints and trade\-offs back to stakeholders in accessible terms.
* Partner with regional operations leads across multiple geographies to understand localized system requirements and ensure solutions work across all subsidiaries.
* Collaborate with executive leadership to communicate system health, roadmap progress, and technology investment decisions.
* Act as the engineering escalation point for critical system issues, coordinating resolution across the team, NetSuite support, and business stakeholders.


**People Leadership \& Team Development**
* Lead, mentor, and grow the NetSuite engineering team, building individual capability while raising the collective technical bar.
* Actively participate in hiring for technical depth and team fit, structured onboarding, performance management, career development planning.
* Conduct meaningful 1:1s, provide regular and specific feedback, and create growth paths for engineers to develop expertise across NetSuite administration, scripting, and integration development.
* Run knowledge transfer sessions, technical workshops, and internal documentation efforts to ensure knowledge is distributed across the team.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, continuous learning, and shared ownership of quality.


 Desired Traits
   

  

* 12\+ years of experience working in NetSuite, with at least 3 years in a formal engineering management or senior technical lead role responsible for a team.
* In\-depth knowledge of NetSuite modules such as GL, Order to Cash, Inventory, AP, AR, Billing, Purchasing, Revenue Recognition, Asset Management
* Deep expertise in NetSuite OneWorld including multi\-subsidiary setup, intercompany framework, global financial consolidation, and cross\-subsidiary order fulfillment.
* Strong understanding of business processes like Engineering Change Orders, Transfer Order Processing
* Proficiency in NetSuite configuration, customization, and scripting
* Knowledge of system integrations and data migration.
* Familiarity with PLM systems like Arena
* Proven ability to write production\-quality code and review complex scripts with a critical eye for performance, maintainability, and correctness.
* Experience authoring technical design documents and leading architecture reviews for significant NetSuite customizations, integrations, or module implementations.
* Familiarity with middleware and integration platforms used to connect NetSuite with external systems such as PLM, Salesforce
* NetSuite certifications such as SuiteFoundation, Administrator, or other relevant certifications, are preferred.
* Ability to work independently, handle multiple tasks, and adapt to changing priorities.
* Familiarity with Agile Software Development, Jira, Git
* Demonstrated track record of improving team development and deployment practices — including testing discipline, code review culture, and release management.
* Experience managing and growing engineering teams.
* Strong cross\-functional communication skills, including the ability to present architectural decisions and technical trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders and executive leadership.


**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**
 We’re actively seeking teammates who:
   

  

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates


 We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start\-ups.
   

  

**Our Culture**
**Who We Are**
 Led by two pioneering co\-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S., creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500\.
   

  

**How We Work**
* We move Blitzy Fast: Time is both our company’s and our clients’ most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally.
* Championship Mindset: We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in\-person, and remaining focused on the mission.
* Passion for Invention: We’re pushing the frontier of what’s possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration.
* We Work for the Customer: We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships.
* We believe in being ‘everyday athletes’: taking care of ourselves so we can bring our best minds to work. We promote great sleep, movement, and restorative activities for optimal mental performance. It makes for a happier and more productive team.


**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Pune HQ2 team and work at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI and complex enterprise software. You'll embed directly with customer engineering teams, writing production code, architecting solutions, and helping customers transform how they build software with Blitzy.
   

  

 This isn't a traditional solutions engineering role. We're looking for a hands\-on engineer who thrives in ambiguous environments and is equally comfortable debugging integrations, building Java/Spring Boot services, participating in sprint planning, or whiteboarding architecture with a CTO.
   

  

 The role centers on our Java/Spring Boot enterprise stack, spanning REST services, event\-driven microservices, integrations, and production operations. You'll work closely with US\-based engineering and customer teams, with regular time zone overlap for collaboration and handoffs.
   

  

 You'll also influence our product roadmap through direct customer feedback, identifying new use cases and technical challenges that shape Blitzy's evolution. High performers may have opportunities to visit our Cambridge, MA headquarters and transition into core product or platform engineering as we scale.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Deploy Blitzy into complex enterprise environments, navigating technical constraints and translating customer business goals into practical technical solutions
* Embed with customer teams during critical implementations, partnering with engineering leaders on sprint planning, architecture reviews, technical decisions, and production deployments
* Build production\-quality integrations, services, and extensions using Java 17 and Spring Boot 3\.x, including Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, and Actuator
* Build and evolve REST APIs using a contract\-first approach with OpenAPI/Swagger, with data persistence through PostgreSQL, Hibernate/JPA, and Liquibase
* Package and deploy containerized services with Docker and manage dependencies through Maven, including BOMs and multi\-module projects
* Develop custom solutions, reusable patterns, scripts, and tools that accelerate customer adoption and demonstrate Blitzy’s capabilities in enterprise environments
* Debug complex issues spanning customer infrastructure, integrations, microservices, and the Blitzy platform, supporting production operations, health checks, metrics, and configuration management
* Drive successful POCs and technical demonstrations that showcase advanced use cases, deliver measurable value, and expand into enterprise\-wide deployments
* Maintain high standards for testing, code quality, performance, and observability using JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, JMeter, Git, Logback/SLF4J, SpotBugs, and SonarQube
* Identify recurring customer needs, technical patterns, and expansion opportunities that inform product priorities and enterprise adoption
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate field experience into platform improvements, technical documentation, reusable best practices, and contributions to the core product


**Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production code in enterprise environments
* Deep hands\-on expertise with Java 17, Spring Boot 3\.x, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA, and Actuator
* Strong experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, PostgreSQL, Liquibase, Maven, Docker, and modern testing practices including JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, and JMeter
* Experience building and operating microservices with CI/CD, cloud architecture, observability, production monitoring, and tools such as Micrometer, Dynatrace, SpotBugs, and SonarQube
* Knowledge of enterprise modernization and distributed systems, including Java 8 → Java 17 upgrades, monolith → microservices migrations, Kafka, Avro, Schema Registry, caching, and resilience patterns
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum and modern software development practices, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to audiences ranging from interns to CTOs
* Experience in customer\-facing engineering, developer tools, AI/ML, or enterprise modernization is a plus, along with technical thought leadership through blogs, talks, or open\-source contributions
* Passion for AI\-powered software development and willingness to work in person from Pune, India, with overlap for US\-based teams


**U.S. GenAI Startup, Pune Office, Private Limited Company**
*Full Time Employment directly to our Private Limited Company. We are committed to an enduring and robust presence in Pune. Our goal is to enable you to have a long enduring career at Blitzy with opportunity for advancement throughout your career at the company. If you want a role you can turn into a career, read on! If you are looking for a short term arrangement, we recommend you look elsewhere!*
*Blitzy is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe different perspectives make us stronger.*

title: Senior Scrum Master
description:
### **Job Summary**



Servant leader and coach to a cross\-functional agile team, ensuring all activities use the principles and frameworks of Agile (e.g., Scrum, Kanban and Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)) to deliver solutions.


### **Key Responsibilities**



Establishes lean/agile leadership, supports the Product Owner, and promotes quality practices; Skilled at Scrum practices of estimation and prioritization using agile techniques. Guides and coaches team members on agile practices \& provides developmental feedback to team members using a servant leadership style and leading by example. Fosters an environment of mutual respect and cooperation, transparency, and autonomy; facilitates getting the work done without coercion, assigning, or dictating the work. Drives adoption of agile reducing the gap between agile theory and practice; drives continuous improvement. Establishes key metrics and monitors agile metrics that impact value driven delivery and indicate potential problems; Ensures all solution documentation is complete (Definition of Done). Establishes and communicates team progress and goals using program boards, burn\-up, burn\-down or other methods. Supports team rules and norms and protects the team from outside interference; removes impediments for the team or finds the right personnel to remove impediments. Maintain strong relationships to deliver business value using relevant Business Relationship Management practices.


**Competencies:**



Business insight \- Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals.



Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.



Global perspective \- Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.



Manages conflict \- Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.



Agile Systems Thinking \- Embraces a holistic approach to analysis that focuses on the way that a system's constituent parts interrelate and how systems work over time and within the context of larger systems to ensure the economic success of the solution.



Building High Performance Teams \- Identifies and applies critical skills and Lean\-Agile principles and practices in the creation of high\-performing Agile teams to construct high\-quality, well designed technical solutions.



Continuous Delivery Pipeline \- Implements the workflows, activities, and automation by providing the enterprise with the capability to shepherd a new piece of functionality all the way from ideation to an on\-demand release of value to the end user.



DevOps and Release on Demand \- Implements DevOps and a continuous delivery pipeline by providing the enterprise with the capability to release value, in whole or in part, at any time necessary to meet market and customer demand.



Lean Agile and SAFe Mindset \- Advocates for and leads others in the concepts of the Agile Manifesto and Lean thinking in support of adopting and applying the 9 SAFe principles and practices for the organization.



Planning and Managing Ceremonies \- Plans, schedules, and leads ceremonies that create a cadence for the team to maximize productivity, promote collaboration, maintain transparency, and inspect and adapt so the team can continuously learn and improve.



Release Planning \- Plans and manages the release of capabilities, features or products using inputs from the prioritized roadmap, planning, available resources and skills to communicate expected availability and releases of capability.



Project Management \- Establishes and maintains the balance of scope, schedule and resources for a temporary effort (a “project”). Ensures results/impact from temporary effort are fully realized as possible.



Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.


**Education, Licenses, Certifications:**



College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. Agile Certification (Certified Scrum Master \- CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM) or Safe Scrum Master Certification (SSM) are preferred. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.


### **Experience**



Experience working in a software development organization and in an Agile environment as a scrum master demonstrating knowledge and practical experience of the Lean methodology, principles and tools are preferred.


### **Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in Agile delivery, project management, or Scrum Master roles.
* 5\+ years of experience facilitating Agile teams in enterprise environments.
* Strong understanding of Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, and Agile delivery practices.
* Experience supporting Data, Analytics, BI, or Digital Transformation initiatives.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams.


**Role**


* Facilitates Scrum ceremonies
* Coaches teams on Agile practices
* Removes impediments
* Supports backlog readiness and team effectiveness
* Tracks Agile metrics and team health
* Drives continuous improvement initiatives
* Focused primarily on team\-level Agile execution


**\_****\_****\_****\_****\_****\_****\_****\_**


**Good to have Qualifications**


* Supply Chain Analytics domain experience.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence or similar Agile tools.
* Good to have knowledge of Power BI, Snowflake, Data Warehousing, or Analytics platforms.
* Experience with vendor and supplier management.
* Exposure to budgeting, resource forecasting, and delivery governance.
* Project Management experience in complex enterprise environments.

**Certifications Preferred**

 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 We are seeking an experienced and passionate Scrum Master to be the agile leader and performance coach for our engineering development teams. In this role, you will champion a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and predictable delivery. You will be the hands\-on partner to your teams, empowering them to deliver high\-quality, valuable software while fostering an environment where they can do their best work. If you are passionate about building teams that are both happy 
 *and* 
 high\-performing, and you thrive on guiding people to achieve tangible results, this is the role for you.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 



* Empower the team to run their own team ceremonies by providing the necessary support, tools, and guidance. Acting as a supportive figure to ensure meetings become team\-led, productive, and value\-driven.
* ensuring they are engaging, productive, and focused on delivering value.
* Act as a subject matter expert on lean and agile principles, ensuring the team to develop, own, and refine an effective process that consistently delivers value based on the chosen frameworks principles and practices.
* Promote transparency by maintaining clear reporting and visible Agile dashboards (e.g., burn\-down charts, flow metrics), making the team's progress and challenges understood by all.
* Coach the team towards greater self\-organization, cross\-functional collaboration, and a strong sense of ownership for their outcomes.
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement, guiding the team to use metrics to identify and solve bottlenecks or delays in their workflow
* Partner closely with the Product Owner to ensure the product backlog is healthy, well\-groomed, and prioritized to deliver maximum business value.
* Proactively identify, track, and relentlessly remove impediments and risks that are impacting the team's progress, protecting their flow and productivity.
* Act as a key collaborative partner to the Agile Delivery Manager (ADM), providing on\-the\-ground visibility into team\-level risks and working together to resolve systemic, domain\-level blockers.
* Facilitate productive communication and collaboration between the team and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment and clear expectations.



**Your Qualifications** 



* Proven Experience: 3\+ years of dedicated experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach in a software development environment, with a track record of improving team performance and health.
* Deep Agile Knowledge: Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent certification is required. You have a deep understanding of the principles behind Scrum, Kanban, and other agile methodologies, and you know when and how to apply them to get results.
* A Coach's Mindset: You don't just facilitate; you coach. You have demonstrable experience mentoring teams and individuals to foster self\-organization and a growth mindset. You are an empathetic listener and a powerful question\-asker.
* Data\-Driven Facilitator: You are comfortable using agile metrics not as a report card, but as a tool to help teams have insightful conversations and drive their own improvement.
* Exceptional Communicator: You have excellent moderation, facilitation, and conflict\-resolution skills. You can communicate complex topics clearly and effectively to a variety of audiences, from engineering teams to stakeholders.
* Technical Fluency: You are proficient with agile project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence).



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

title: Product Delivery Manager - Moveworks
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Moveworks)**
**Role Overview:**
 The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end\-to\-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high\-quality business outcomes.
   

  

 As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
   

  

 The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy \& Lifecycle Management:**
* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.


**Stakeholder Management:**
* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers


**Product backlog and Planning:**
* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long\-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).


**Delivery Management:**
* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go\-live


**Governance and Continuous improvement:**
* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.


**Innovation and Platform enablement:**
* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.


**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Strong understanding of the Move works platform, including enterprise search, conversational AI, natural language understanding (NLU), employee support automation, and AI\-driven workflow orchestration.
* Knowledge of Move works integration capabilities with ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Slack, HR systems, identity platforms, and enterprise applications
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self\-service adoption strategies.
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification


**What are we looking for?**
* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem\-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of ServiceNow applications (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD).


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
