title: Manager - Client Reporting Solutions
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 Job Type: Permanent
   

  

 Application Deadline: 18 September 2026
   

  

**Job Description**
**Title** 
 Manager \- Client Reporting Solutions
   

  

**Department** 
 Global Client Reporting \- Client Servicing Platfrom
   

  

**Location** 
 Gurugram / Bengaluru
   

  

**Reports To** 
 Director \- Client Reporting Solutions
   

  

**Level** 
 5
   

  

**Introduction**
 We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
   

  

**About Your Team**
 Global Client Reporting produces high\-quality financial and investment reports that provide clients with clear insight into fund performance, composition, and strategy. Our ambition is to deliver a reporting experience that is Client\-centric, Efficient \& Scalable and Insight\-driven; enabled by centralised reporting SMEs.
   

  

 We operate as a single global team with a diverse talent base, united by our commitment to excellence and continuous improvement.
   

  

**About Your Role**
 We are looking for a proactive and techno\-functional
 **Manager – Client Reporting Solutions** 
 to balance Business\-as\-Usual (BAU) delivery with end\-to\-end business, change and delivery process optimization. Working across business, operations, and technology teams, you will identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and transform processes by leveraging data, AI, automation, and process reengineering.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines an agile mindset with strong analytical, project management, and stakeholder management skills to translate business needs into practical solutions. You will lead change initiatives from solution design through implementation and UAT while strengthening governance, reporting, risk management, and operational capability to deliver sustainable business outcomes and continuous improvement.
   

  

**About You**
 The successful candidate will be expected to perform the primary duties associated with this role. The responsibilities outlined below are provided as a high\-level guide and may evolve over time to meet business and operational requirements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Business Process Transformation**
* Drive end\-to\-end business and delivery process optimization through simplification, standardization, process reengineering, and automation.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, scalability, and client outcomes by leveraging AI, digital solutions, and data\-driven insights.
* Partner with business and technology teams to design and implement sustainable process improvements and operating models.


**Business Operations, Client Reporting \& Insights**
* Manage BAU delivery to meet service levels, quality standards, and business objectives.
* Design, enhance, and deliver reporting solutions aligned to business and client requirements.
* Analyse reporting requirements, assess operational impacts, and recommend scalable reporting and process solutions.
* Develop dashboards, KPIs, and performance insights to support decision\-making and continuous improvement.
* Monitor operational performance and drive timely resolution of issues.


**Governance, Risk \& Data Management**
* Support governance through business reviews, performance reporting, and action tracking.
* Ensure robust data quality, reporting integrity, and compliance with governance standards.
* Identify operational risks, issues, and dependencies, driving mitigation plans and control improvements.


**Project Delivery \& Change**
* Lead or support cross\-functional business transformation initiatives from planning through implementation.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test planning, execution, defect management, and business sign\-off.
* Apply Agile/SAFe principles to deliver change effectively and support successful business adoption.


**Capability Building \& Stakeholder Management**
* Develop process documentation, standards, and knowledge assets to support operational excellence.
* Build team capability through coaching, knowledge sharing, and adoption of new tools, technologies, and ways of working.
* Build effective relationships with business, technology, operations, and client stakeholders through clear communication, governance, and executive reporting.


**Skills \& Competencies**
**Technical Expertise**
* AI\-enabled productivity tools and technology adoption.
* Business process improvement, optimisation, and digital transformation.
* Financial instruments, Mutual funds, Fund Accounting and Reporting domain expertise
* Techno\-functional solution design and delivery.
* Change management, operations excellence and continuous improvement frameworks.
* Agile/SAFe methodologies and User Acceptance Testing (UAT); JIRA use expertise.
* Client Reporting, business analytics and data governance.
* Issue and quality management.


**Professional Attributes**
* Experience working within global, cross\-functional environments.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.
* Effective executive communication and presentation capabilities.
* Proven ability to collaborate and influence across teams.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Proactive, results\-oriented, and committed to continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities with attention to detail.
* High degree of ownership, accountability, and execution discipline.
* Capable of driving alignment and managing change across stakeholders.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Degree in Engineering, Technology, Finance or a related discipline. MBA with Engineering background preferred.
* 8–12 years of experience in Business Operations, Service Delivery or Business Transformation in Fund Administration / Asset Management / Investment Banking domain .
* Certification in NCFM, Agile, SAFe, PMP, PRINCE2, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt preferred.
* Active use of AI\-enabled productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Power Automate, or similar technologies.


**Feel rewarded**
 For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.
   

  

 For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

title: Talent Acquisition Agile Squad Lead
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.



This Position reports to:



Talent Acquisition Manager Process Autom \#\#\#


**Your role and responsibilities**



As the Talent Acquisition Agile Squad Lead for Automation \& Engineering, you will guide a cross\-functional recruiting squad using agile principles to accelerate the hiring of critical engineering, technology and digital talent across Operations Centre, for Automation Business Area in India.



Working closely with Hiring Managers and Business Leaders, you will organize recruitment into focused sprints, prioritize hiring backlogs based on business\-critical needs, and enable the recruiting squad to deliver high\-quality talent through agile ways of working. This role is suited for an experienced agile practitioner who can coach teams while driving execution.



The work model for the role is: **\#LI\-Onsite**


### **Key Responsibilities**


**Agile Recruitment Delivery**


* Partner with Business Leaders, Engineering Managers, and Hiring Managers to prioritize hiring backlogs based on project criticality, customer commitments, and business impact.
* Lead sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Identify bottlenecks across sourcing, assessment, interview scheduling, and offer management, driving continuous improvement.
* Translate hiring requirements across India Operations Center, focusing on Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, Operations Centers, Digital Engineering, and Industrial Software into clear recruitment priorities and sourcing strategies.
* Partner with hiring managers to streamline technical assessments and interview processes while maintaining quality and improving candidate experience.
* Reduce hiring cycle time and improve conversion across engineering talent pipelines.
* Track and report recruitment metrics including not limited to Time\-to\-Hire, Hiring Velocity, Pipeline Health, Offer Acceptance Rate, Candidate Experience, and Quality of Hire.
* Use recruitment analytics to optimize sprint planning, sourcing effectiveness, and team capacity.
* Act as a strategic recruitment partner to business Stakeholders by aligning hiring priorities, managing changing requirements, providing market insights and recruitment updates, and delivering proactive solutions while ensuring a consistent candidate experience throughout the recruitment and offer process.


**Qualifications \& Requirements**


* Minimum 10\&\#43; years of Talent Acquisition experience with demonstrated success in Engineering, Automation, Manufacturing or Industrial Technology recruitment.
* Experience recruiting niche engineering talent across automation, electrical, instrumentation, commissioning, digital, or industrial software domains.
* Mandatory 2\&\#43; years of experience working in an Agile environment as an Agile Squad Lead, Scrum Master, Agile Coach, or Recruitment Lead driving agile delivery practices.
* Experience using ATS platforms (e.g., Workday) and leveraging recruitment analytics to improve hiring outcomes. Comfortable using dashboards and recruitment metrics to support data\-driven decision\-making.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing capabilities across HR and business leadership.
* Prior experience in coaching hiring managers, recruiters, sourcing specialists, and coordinators on agile recruitment practices, leadership, and cross\-functional collaboration. Fostering accountability, transparency, and continuous learning


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.



Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Sr Scrum Master
description:
Job Summary: Servant leader and coach to a cross-functional agile team, ensuring all activities use the principles and frameworks of Agile (e. g. , Scrum, Kanban and Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)) to deliver solutions. Key Responsibilities: Establishes lean/agile leadership, supports the Product Owner, and promotes quality practices; Skilled at Scrum practices of estimation and prioritization using agile techniques. Guides and coaches team members on agile practices provides developmental feedback to team members using a servant leadership style and leading by example. Fosters an environment of mutual respect and cooperation, transparency, and autonomy; facilitates getting the work done without coercion, assigning, or dictating the work. Drives adoption of agile reducing the gap between agile theory and practice; drives continuous improvement. Establishes key metrics and monitors agile metrics that impact value driven delivery and indicate potential problems; Ensures all solution documentation is complete (Definition of Done). Establishes and communicates team progress and goals using program boards, burn-up, burn-down or other methods. Supports team rules and norms and protects the team from outside interference; removes impediments for the team or finds the right personnel to remove impediments. Maintain strong relationships to deliver business value using relevant Business Relationship Management practices. Required Qualifications 
 - Bachelors degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field. 
 - 8+ years of experience in Agile delivery, project management, or Scrum Master roles. 
 - 5+ years of experience facilitating Agile teams in enterprise environments. 
 - Strong understanding of Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, and Agile delivery practices. 
 - Experience supporting Data, Analytics, BI, or Digital Transformation initiatives. 
 - Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Experience working with globally distributed teams. Role Facilitates Scrum ceremonies Coaches teams on Agile practices Removes impediments Supports backlog readiness and team effectiveness Tracks Agile metrics and team health Drives continuous improvement initiatives Focused primarily on team-level Agile execution Good to have Qualifications 
 - Supply Chain Analytics domain experience. 
 - Experience with Jira, Confluence or similar Agile tools. 
 - Good to have knowledge of Power BI, Snowflake, Data Warehousing, or Analytics platforms. 
 - Experience with vendor and supplier management. 
 - Exposure to budgeting, resource forecasting, and delivery governance. 
 - Project Management experience in complex enterprise environments. 
 
 Certifications Preferred 
 - Certified Scrum Master (CSM) 
 - SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) 
 - SAFe Practitioner (SP) 
 - PMI-ACP or equivalent Agile certifications 
 Competencies: 
 Business insight - Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization s goals. 
 
 Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences. 
 
 Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens. 
 
 Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise. 
 
 Agile Systems Thinking - Embraces a holistic approach to analysis that focuses on the way that a systems constituent parts interrelate and how systems work over time and within the context of larger systems to ensure the economic success of the solution. 
 
 Building High Performance Teams - Identifies and applies critical skills and Lean-Agile principles and practices in the creation of high-performing Agile teams to construct high-quality, well designed technical solutions. 
 
 Continuous Delivery Pipeline - Implements the workflows, activities, and automation by providing the enterprise with the capability to shepherd a new piece of functionality all the way from ideation to an on-demand release of value to the end user. 
 
 DevOps and Release on Demand - Implements DevOps and a continuous delivery pipeline by providing the enterprise with the capability to release value, in whole or in part, at any time necessary to meet market and customer demand. 
 
 Lean Agile and SAFe Mindset - Advocates for and leads others in the concepts of the Agile Manifesto and Lean thinking in support of adopting and applying the 9 SAFe principles and practices for the organization. 
 
 Planning and Managing Ceremonies - Plans, schedules, and leads ceremonies that create a cadence for the team to maximize productivity, promote collaboration, maintain transparency, and inspect and adapt so the team can continuously learn and improve. 
 
 Release Planning - Plans and manages the release of capabilities, features or products using inputs from the prioritized roadmap, planning, available resources and skills to communicate expected availability and releases of capability. 
 
 Project Management - Establishes and maintains the balance of scope, schedule and resources for a temporary effort (a project ). Ensures results/impact from temporary effort are fully realized as possible. 
 
 Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization. 
 
 Education, Licenses, Certifications: 
 College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. Agile Certification (Certified Scrum Master - CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM) or Safe Scrum Master Certification (SSM) are preferred. The role guides teams on tooling and best practices, provides hands\-on leadership across automation design, implementation, and continuous improvement, and drives measurable improvements in delivery throughput, manual testing reduction, and release stability.

Partner with engineering teams to improve service testability and coverage. Establish consistent standards for test design, traceability, defect triage, and execution reporting. Provide clear, actionable insights on test results, risk, and release readiness. Work closely with application teams, platform partners, and QA colleagues to align on automation goals, unblock delivery issues, and coach teams toward sustainable quality practices. Works closely with developers and stakeholders for defect management, test coverage, and release readiness. Partners with engineering teams to improve service testability and coverage, especially for API and g RPC validation. Engages with business analysts, product owners, and project managers to ensure QA involvement early in the project lifecycle.

**Authorities/Decision Rights**

**Job Dimensions**
 Enterprise\-wide impact across the DI\& A portfolio. Responsible for QA automation strategy, delivery, and continuous improvement across multiple projects and releases. Directly manages QA team members and oversees their daily activities, task allocation, and performance. Influences quality practices and standards across delivery teams and platform partners. Measures include delivery throughput, manual testing reduction, release stability, and quality outcomes.

 7\+ years of experience in QA and 4\+ years as a QA lead across complex enterprise delivery portfolios. Hands\-on expertise with Python, Robot Framework, Playwright and/or Selenium for automation. Experience in building and maintaining scalable automated test suites. Strong knowledge of CI/CD and integrating automated testing into Azure Dev Ops pipelines. Ability to implement lightweight governance (standards, controls, reporting) to improve quality consistency. Excellent communication skills with both technical and non\-technical partners; able to influence without authority. Proactive in identifying risks, inefficiencies, and quality gaps, and taking ownership to resolve them.
   

  

**Good To Have Skills**
 Service/API testing capability: Exposure to Java\-based g RPC tooling is a plus. AI driven development. Capital Markets domain experience.

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Overview**
 Agile Project Manager / Scrum Master
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced Agile Project Manager / Scrum Master to lead and coach one or more cross\-functional teams in delivering highquality products. You will own the health of the Agile process — facilitating ceremonies, removing impediments, and protecting the team's focus —

 servant\-leadership with practical project management.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Agile Facilitation \& Coaching
   

  

 Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
   

  

 Coach the team and the wider organization on Agile and Scrum principles, helping teams mature toward self\-organization and
   

  

 continuous improvement.
   

  

 Foster a collaborative, transparent, and psychologically safe team culture.
   

  

 Delivery \& Project Management
   

  

 Drive on\-time, on\-scope delivery across sprints and releases, tracking progress against commitments.
   

  

 Maintain and communicate delivery metrics (velocity, burndown/burnup, cycle time, throughput) and use them to forecast and
   

  

 improve.
   

  

 Manage dependencies, risks, and issues across teams; escalate and resolve blockers quickly.
   

  

 Coordinate planning across multiple teams or workstreams where needed (e.g., PI planning, scrum\-of\-scrums).

 Partner with Product Owners to keep the backlog refined, prioritized, and ready for delivery.
   

  

 Provide clear, regular status reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
   

  

 Manage expectations around scope, timeline, and trade\-offs, and communicate changes proactively.
   

  

 Continuous Improvement
   

  

 Identify process bottlenecks and lead initiatives to improve team efficiency and product quality.
   

  

 Champion engineering and delivery best practices in collaboration with technical leads.
   

  

 Track and act on retrospective outcomes to drive measurable improvement over time.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
   

  

 4\+ years of overall experience as a Project Manager, Scrum Master, or Agile delivery lead.
   

  

 Strong working knowledge of Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban) and scaling approaches (SAFe, LeSS, or similar).
   

  

 Proven ability to manage and deliver software projects with cross\-functional teams.
   

  

 Excellent facilitation, communication, conflict\-resolution, and stakeholder\-management skills.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with Agile tooling such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Certified ScrumMaster (CSM / PSM I or II), SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), or PMI\-ACP certification.
   

  

 PMP certification or equivalent traditional project\-management experience.
   

  

 Background in software development or a closely related technical domain.
   

  

 Experience coaching distributed or multi\-team environments.
   

  

 Core Competencies
   

  

 Servant leadership — puts the team first and leads by enabling others.
   

  

 Organization — keeps complex, multi\-stream work on track without losing detail.
   

  

 Communication — translates clearly between technical teams and business stakeholders.
   

  

 Problem\-solving — anticipates risks and removes obstacles before they slow delivery.
   

  

 Adaptability — adjusts approach to fit the team's maturity and the project's needs.
   

  

 This is a customizable template. Adjust the responsibilities, years of experience, certifications, and competencies to match your
   

  

 organization's seniority level, industry, and team structure.

title: Scrum Master
description:
GURGAON, IN, 122001
  
  

...
  
  

At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
  
  

Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25\-year\-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
  
  

While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia\-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America
  
  

Position Overview
  
  

The key purpose of the SCRUM Master is to reinforce and refine agile/scrum ways of working and business processes throughout project life cycles within the Data, Analytics, and Automation team. This role is responsible for ensuring each delivery team runs efficient sprint planning meetings, facilitates sprint retrospectives, and works closely with the Director of Enterprise Digital Transformation \& Value Realization. This role operates at the heart of the DAA team, maximizing the project prioritization efficiency and ensuring timely development and management of data\-related solutions to deliver value in line with the business’s strategy. This role involves a combination of Scrum management experience, business acumen, technical knowledge, and leadership skills
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Agile Delivery \& Execution
  
  

Facilitate effective Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, backlog refinement and other Agile ceremonies.
  
Partner with Product Owners to ensure backlogs are appropriately prioritized, refined, and ready for execution.
  
Establish and maintain delivery rhythms that enable teams to meet Sprint and release commitments.
  
Monitor progress, identify delivery risks and proactively address issues before they impact business outcomes
  
Ensure teams maintain appropriate Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, and quality standards.
  
Track delivery against milestones, commitments, capacity, and dependencies.
  
Help teams translate strategic priorities into actionable increments of work.
  
Protect the team from unnecessary disruption while maintaining transparency with stakeholders.
  
  

Team Coaching \& Agile Ways of Working
  
  

Serve as a servant leader and Agile coach, helping teams become increasingly self\-organizing, accountable, and high performing.
  
Coach team members, Product Owners and stakeholders on Agile principles, Scrum practices and effective collaboration.
  
Identify behaviors, processes or organizational conditions that inhibit team performance and work with leaders to address them.
  
Foster an environment of psychological safety, transparency, accountability, and constructive challenge.
  
Facilitate healthy conflict resolution and improve team communication and collaboration.
  
Adapt Agile practices to the needs and maturity of the team while maintaining the principles of Agile.
  
Mentor less\-experienced team members and contribute to the broader Agile community of practice
  
  

Stakeholder \& Dependency Management
  
  

Establish strong relationships with Product Owners, business leaders, technology teams and other key stakeholders.
  
Identify and actively manage cross\-team, functional and organizational dependencies.
  
Surface impediments that require leadership intervention and drive them toward resolution.
  
Provide clear, concise visibility into delivery status, risks, issues, dependencies and decisions.
  
Facilitate alignment between business priorities and team execution.
  
Coordinate with other Scrum Masters, Program Managers and Product Managers where work spans multiple Agile teams.
  
Help stakeholders understand Agile delivery models, expectations, trade\-offs and appropriate engagement points
  
  

Continuous Improvement \& Performance Management
  
  

Use retrospectives, delivery metrics and team feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
  
Establish meaningful Agile metrics such as velocity trends, cycle time, throughput, predictability, Sprint completion and impediment aging.
  
Analyze delivery data to identify patterns and recommend actionable improvements.
  
Lead teams in developing and executing measurable improvement actions.
  
Continuously assess team maturity and adapt coaching approaches accordingly.
  
Promote experimentation and learning rather than rigid adherence to process.
  
Identify systemic issues that extend beyond the team and escalate them appropriately
  
  

Agile Governance, Planning \& Organizational Enablement
  
  

Support quarterly and release planning activities and provide delivery insights to program and portfolio leadership.
  
Contribute to Agile governance and enterprise delivery standards.
  
Ensure appropriate visibility and documentation of commitments, risks, dependencies and outcomes.
  
Partner with leadership to improve organizational Agile maturity and remove systemic barriers to effective delivery.
  
Participate in Agile transformation initiatives, communities of practice and methodology improvements.
  
Help establish scalable Agile practices across multiple delivery teams and programs.
  
Ensure Agile execution remains connected to measurable business value rather than process compliance alone
  
  

Secondary Responsibilities
  
  

Ability to identify opportunities for continuous improvement, develop CI project goals, and drive team efficiency by applying the discipline of planning, organizing, and managing resources to bring about successful project completion
  
  

Required Qualifications
  
  

Level of Education and Discipline\- Bachelors in business, project management, Data Analytics, Data Science, Business Information Technology or related field
  
  

Experience \- functional/industry/commercial knowledge, business acumen
  
  

6–8 years of experience in Agile delivery, Scrum Master, Program Management, Product Management, Technology or Digital Transformation roles.
  
Demonstrated experience serving as a Scrum Master for complex, cross\-functional Agile teams.
  
Strong understanding of Scrum, Kanban and broader Agile principles.
  
Experience working with Product Owners, technology teams, business stakeholders and senior leadership.
  
Proven ability to remove organizational impediments and manage complex dependencies
  
Strong facilitation, coaching, conflict\-resolution and stakeholder\-management skills.
  
Experience using Agile delivery metrics and tools, specifically Azure DevOps or equivalent platforms.
  
Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, global enterprise environment.
  
Strong written, verbal and executive communication skills. Demonstrated ability to proactively solve problems and multi\-task.
  
Learn and execute continuous improvement initiatives to improve systems and ways of working.
  
  

Interpersonal Skills \- leadership, interactions, communication, influence
  
  

Work closely with functional leadership teams.
  
Ability to manage up and mentor peers
  
Maintain a sense of urgency to meet scheduling plans and customer requirements.
  
Ability to use a systemic approach and tools to identify and drive business value.
  
  

Other Skills and HPO Competencies
  
  

Business acumen.
  
Strong business perspective; able to merge business questions/needs with available data to provide data\-driven insights
  
  

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

Certification and/or Licenses\- Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), SAFe Scrum Master or equivalent.
  
  

Experience \- functional/industry/commercial knowledge, business acumen\-
  
  

Experience with Agile at Scale, SAFe or other enterprise Agile frameworks.
  
Experience supporting digital transformation, data/analytics, technology or product development.
  
Experience managing multiple interconnected Agile teams or complex programs.
  
Experience coaching organizations transitioning from traditional project delivery to Agile product\-oriented delivery.
  
  

Dimension
  
  

Facilitate agile ways of working for a global team of \~50 operating across India, EMEA, and the US
  
  

At McCormick, we have over a 100\-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value
  
  

WHY WORK AT MCCORMICK?
  
  

As a McCormick employee you’ll be empowered to focus on more than your individual responsibilities. You’ll have the opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself—to have a say in where the company is going and how it’s growing.
  
  

Between our passion for flavor, our 130\-year history of leadership and integrity, the competitive and comprehensive benefits we offer, and our culture, which is built on respect and opportunities for growth, there are many reasons to join us at McCormick.

* Proactively manage expectations, dependencies, and cross\-team coordination.

* Ensure strong engineering practices across:
+ Cloud\-native application development
+ Good experience in AI Product building
+ Strong knowledge and experience in AI native SDLC
+ Platform and systems engineering
+ CI/CD and automation
+ Quality engineering and testing
+ Database and data platform operations

* Drive architecture reviews, technical decision forums, and standards adoption.
* Ensure systems meet expectations for security, scalability, reliability, and compliance.


**Operational Excellence**
* Own operational readiness, including incident response, root cause analysis, and remediation tracking.

* Ensure documentation, runbooks, and operational processes are in place.

**Required Skills**

**Stakeholder \& Delivery Management**
* Strong experience managing product, architecture, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to translate business objectives into clear engineering execution plans.
* Experience delivering complex, cloud\-based systems using Agile methodologies.
* Strong ownership mindset with accountability for outcomes, not just execution.


**Technical Background \& Hands\-on Experience**
* Strong hands\-on experience designing and building enterprise\-grade applications using Java programming stack.
* Strong experience in AI embedded application stack and modern AI technologies.
* Proven experience building microservices\-based architectures, including RESTful APIs, grpc and distributed systems.

title: Product Release Manager / Scrum Master
description:
Product Release Manager / Scrum Master Experience: 4 to 6 years
 Location: Bengaluru
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 About the Role We are looking for a smart, dynamic, and highly execution-oriented Product Release Manager / Scrum Master to drive the planning and execution of product releases. This role will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, internal business teams, and client teams to ensure that product initiatives and releases are planned effectively, executed smoothly, and delivered on time. The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership, follows through relentlessly, is comfortable working with different stakeholders, and gets things closed . You do not necessarily need to be the most technically experienced person in the roombut you should be able to understand the work, ask the right questions, identify dependencies and risks, and ensure that everyone delivers what they have committed to. This is a highly collaborative and execution-focused role for someone who enjoys making things happen. 

 Key Responsibilities 1. Release Planning & Execution Own the planning and coordination of product releases from requirement readiness through development, QA, UAT, and production release . Work with Product and Engineering to break down requirements into actionable tasks, milestones, and release plans. Create and maintain release schedules, timelines, dependencies, and milestones. Track progress closely and ensure commitments are met. Identify delays, dependencies, and bottlenecks early and drive them toward resolution. Ensure that release activities are completed within agreed timelines. 2. Drive Engineering & QA Execution Work closely with Engineering leads, developers, and QA teams to track execution. Understand the high-level technical scope sufficiently to identify dependencies, risks, and potential delivery challenges. Conduct regular follow-ups on development and testing activities. Ensure defects, blockers, and open points are assigned and driven to closure. Escalate issues when required rather than allowing them to remain unresolved. Maintain clear visibility of what is done, what is pending, who owns it, and by when it will be completed . 3. Cross-Functional Coordination Coordinate with Product, Engineering, QA, Design, Support, Sales/Pre-Sales, Operations, and other internal teams as required. Ensure all teams are aligned on release scope, timelines, dependencies, and responsibilities. Coordinate activities that require inputs or actions from multiple teams. Ensure handoffs between teams happen smoothly and on time. 4. Client & Stakeholder Coordination Coordinate with client teams for requirements, clarifications, UAT, feedback, and release readiness. Track client dependencies and ensure timely responses/actions from both sides. Organize and drive requirement discussions, UAT coordination, issue resolution, and release-related meetings. Maintain professional and clear communication with client stakeholders. Ensure that client commitments and open action items are actively tracked through closure. 5. Agile / Scrum Ceremonies Facilitate Scrum ceremonies such as: Sprint Planning Daily Stand-ups Sprint Reviews / Demos Retrospectives Backlog Refinement Ensure ceremonies are focused, structured, and outcome-oriented. Maintain sprint goals and ensure the team remains aligned with priorities. Track sprint commitments and proactively address slippages. 6. Tracking, Reporting & Visibility Maintain release trackers, sprint trackers, RAID logs, action-item trackers, and other project documentation as required. Provide concise and meaningful status updates to Product and leadership. Highlight: Progress against plan Delayed items Key dependencies Risks and blockers Decisions required Overall release readiness Ensure there are no surprises close to the release date . 7. Process Improvement Identify gaps in the product development and release process. Improve planning, tracking, communication, and execution practices. Establish simple and effective processes that help the team deliver consistently. Learn from previous releases and implement improvements in subsequent releases. 

 What We Are Looking For Must-Have 46 years of experience in Scrum Master, Project Management, Program/Delivery Management, Product Operations, or a similar role. Strong ownership and execution mindset. Excellent planning and organizational skills. Strong follow-up skills with a demonstrated ability to drive tasks to closure . Ability to coordinate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and parallel workstreams. Ability to identify risks, dependencies, and blockers proactively. Comfortable working in a fast-paced and changing product environment. Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies. Experience working with Engineering and QA teams. Good working knowledge of tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar project management tools. 

 Most Important: Mindset & Personality We are looking for someone who is: Smart and sharp understands situations quickly and knows what needs to happen next. Dynamic and proactive does not wait for someone to tell them what to do. Strong on follow-through – keeps pushing until an action is completed. Closure-oriented – does not just track tasks; makes sure they get completed. Comfortable asking questions – can challenge timelines, assumptions, and dependencies when required. Accountable – takes ownership of the outcome rather than simply managing a tracker. Good with people – can work effectively with developers, QA, Product, senior leadership, and clients. Calm under pressure – can handle tight timelines, changing priorities, and release challenges. Practical and solution-oriented – focuses on solving problems rather than explaining why something cannot be done. 
 Technical Understanding The candidate does not need to be a hands-on developer. However, they should be comfortable working with technical teams and understand concepts such as: Software development lifecycle APIs and integrations Web/mobile applications Development and testing environments QA/UAT cycles Defect management Release management Dependencies between systems/modules Basic understanding of databases and cloud applications 
 The expectation is that the person can understand enough technical context to manage execution effectively and ask the right questions . Success in This Role The person will be successful if: Releases are planned realistically and executed on schedule. Engineering and QA teams have clear priorities and timelines. Dependencies and risks are identified early. Blockers are actively driven to resolution. Client and internal action items do not remain open unnecessarily. Product, Engineering, QA, and client teams remain aligned. Leadership has clear visibility into release status. Most importantly, things actually get done and closed . 
 Education Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Management, or a related field preferred. Scrum Master / Agile certification is a plus but not mandatory . 
 Preferred Experience Candidates with experience in any of the following environments will be preferred: B2B SaaS / Enterprise Software HR Tech / Workforce Management / HCM Product companies Enterprise integrations Client-facing technology implementations Multi-team product development environments

Key Skills: scrum,Sprint Planning,Azure,APIs,uat,Safe,stakeholders,Sprint Review

Continuous Improvement

Required Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field (Master's a plus).

* Understanding of pharma compliance (Sunshine Act, HIPAA, OIG guidelines) as applied to commercial data use.

Key Competencies

title: Assistant Manager - Product Delivery
description:
Assistant Manager – Product Delivery
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

 At IDfy, a great product only creates value when it actually lands \- deployed, adopted, and working in the real world. As our Assistant Manager – Product Delivery, you'll be the person who makes that happen: turning client requirements into working solutions, translating messy real\-world problems into clean product outcomes, and owning delivery end\-to\-end from the first conversation to go\-live. If you love figuring out "what the client actually needs, how to solve it, and how to ship it" \- this role is built for you.
   

  

**We're The Perfect Match If You**
* Have 1–3 years of experience in a client\-facing implementation, SaaS delivery, solutioning, or technical project role.
* Have worked directly with enterprise clients and juggled multiple stakeholders and workstreams without dropping the ball.
* Are AI\-first and hands\-on \- you reach for AI tools instinctively to move faster and solve smarter.
* Bring a can\-do attitude \- when someone says "this is tricky," your first instinct is "let's figure it out."
* Communicate with clarity and influence \- equally comfortable aligning a client's HR team and rallying internal Product \& Engineering.
* Thrive on ownership and ambiguity \- you'd rather run a thread yourself than wait for a map.


**Here's What Your Day Would Look Like**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of IDfy's products for clients \- from requirement understanding through solutioning, UAT, and go\-live \- within agreed timelines.
* Get deep into the client's employee onboarding journey and HRTech ecosystem to spot process and product gaps before they become delivery issues.
* Translate client requirements into clear, actionable asks for internal teams \- and translate the most appropriate solution back out to the client.
* Partner across teams to balance what the client wants against what's buildable, scalable, and on\-time.
* Act as the key point of contact across the delivery lifecycle, keeping clients and internal Product / Engineering / Sales / CX aligned.
* Run multiple client implementations at once \- tracking dependencies, risks, blockers, and timelines, and prioritizing by client impact and business criticality.
* Spot recurring patterns and push to standardize and improve how delivery gets done.


 Why IDfy
   

  

 At IDfy, we don't just build products \- we build trust infrastructure for the digital economy. In this role, you'll sit at the frontline of how that trust actually reaches clients: owning delivery, shaping solutions, and working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with Product and Engineering.
   

  

 If you've ever wanted to turn delivery puzzles into product wins \- this is your playground.

title: Manager - Ecommerce transformation
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Consulting \- Manager \- Ecommerce Transformation**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Manager \- Ecommerce Transformation will drive ecommerce transformation initiatives within the Customer practice, combining digital commerce strategy, customer experience improvement, operating model design, and delivery excellence. The role will support clients in improving online growth, commerce operations, product discovery, conversion, order experience, and omnichannel effectiveness. You will work with business and technology stakeholders to shape commerce roadmaps, design scalable operating models, and implement transformation initiatives that improve revenue realization, digital adoption, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Business Development \& Market Leadership
+ Support ecommerce transformation pipeline development across advisory, implementation, and managed transformation opportunities.
+ Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, business cases, demos, and executive presentations focused on digital commerce growth and operational improvement.
+ Support GTM strategies for ecommerce transformation offerings across B2B, B2C, and marketplace\-led business models.
+ Design and refine commerce transformation offerings aligned with client priorities, including digital channel growth, product data improvement, checkout optimization, and omnichannel enablement.
+ Contribute to thought leadership, client workshops, and points of view on ecommerce trends, digital buying behaviour, platform modernization, and commerce operating model evolution.


* Client Engagement \& Delivery
+ Lead ecommerce transformation workstreams from current\-state assessment through strategy, roadmap design, implementation planning, and execution support.
+ Assess commerce journeys, digital storefronts, product information flows, merchandising processes, search and navigation, order management touchpoints, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
+ Design ecommerce operating models, governance structures, product data processes, merchandising workflows, channel strategies, and performance management frameworks.
+ Support initiatives across product discovery, catalog readiness, personalization, pricing and promotions, cart and checkout, order visibility, returns experience, and customer support integration.
+ Partner with product, technology, data, marketing, sales, and operations teams to translate commerce priorities into structured requirements, process flows, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
+ Develop business cases and benefits models to quantify conversion improvement, revenue uplift, digital adoption, cost\-to\-serve reduction, and operational productivity gains.
+ Ensure delivery excellence across assigned workstreams, including scope, timeline, budget, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment.
+ Support change management, adoption, and governance activities to embed sustainable commerce capabilities across business teams.


* Technology \& Innovation
+ Enable teams to leverage ecommerce platforms, product information management systems, order management systems, CRM, analytics, personalization tools, automation, and AI\-enabled insights.
+ Stay ahead of technology trends shaping ecommerce transformation, including composable commerce, headless architecture, AI\-enabled product discovery, personalization, digital shelf analytics, and omnichannel orchestration.
+ Identify opportunities to develop reusable accelerators for commerce journey assessment, product data maturity, conversion diagnostics, and benefits tracking.


* Leadership \& People Development
+ Manage project teams or workstreams and ensure high\-quality delivery across ecommerce transformation engagements.
+ Mentor consultants and analysts on ecommerce strategy, requirements structuring, delivery governance, and cross\-functional stakeholder management.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Demonstrate knowledge of digital commerce capabilities, including B2B and B2C commerce, marketplace models, dealer and distributor portals, and subscription commerce.
* Have exposure to leading commerce platforms and ecosystems, including Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, Shopify, SAP Commerce Cloud, commerce tools, BigCommerce, Akeneo, Salsify, and similar technologies.


**What We Look For**
* 8\+ years of experience in ecommerce transformation, digital commerce, omnichannel strategy, customer experience, product data transformation, or commerce operations.
* Consulting experience is desired.
* Proven experience supporting or leading ecommerce transformation programs, digital channel improvement initiatives, or commerce operating model redesign.
* Strong understanding of ecommerce journeys, digital merchandising, product information management, order experience, conversion optimization, and commerce performance metrics.
* Hands\-on experience with ecommerce platforms, analytics tools, PIM, OMS, CRM, or related digital commerce technologies.
* Strong business development support, stakeholder management, communication, and project delivery skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

 Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Title : Product Intern
   

  

 Location : Mumbai

**About Upstox**
 At Upstox, we’re building the future of investing simple, powerful, and for everyone. We’re one of India’s fastest\-growing fintech platforms, backed by the best in the business, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global, and on a mission to make wealth creation accessible to every Indian. From first\-time investors to seasoned traders, millions trust us to power their financial journeys. We’re not just moving fast, we're moving with purpose. If you thrive in a high\-energy, high\-impact environment, you’re in the right place.
   

  

 The Role: Product Intern – US Stocks
   

  

 You’ll join the US Stocks Product team and help build and scale products that enable Indian investors to invest in the US stock market.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, 0\-to\-1 product role where you’ll work across product discovery, research, competitive intelligence, partner evaluation, and integrations. You’ll work closely with design, engineering, growth, and external partners to turn ideas into products that customers can use. You won’t inherit a finished playbook, you'll help build it.
   

  

 What You’ll Own
   

  

* Write and refine PRDs and help drive features from idea to launch — scoping requirements, chasing open questions, and keeping execution on track.
* Run competitive intelligence across Indian and global US\-stock investing platforms. Track what competitors are building, break down their features, and identify opportunities relevant to our roadmap.
* Research the US Stocks investing ecosystem and understand customer needs, market trends, product offerings, and the overall investing journey.
* Identify and evaluate vendors and partners required for the product, including market data, trading infrastructure, payments, compliance\-related services, and other third\-party solutions.
* Drive integrations end to end, coordinating with external partners and internal teams to get third\-party services live and working smoothly.
* Work closely with Design, Engineering, Growth, and other stakeholders to translate product requirements into execution.
* Roll up your sleeves on the groundwork: research, analysis, documentation, partner coordination, testing, and the unglamorous wiring that turns an early idea into a real product.


 What We’re Looking For

title: Senior Test Analyst, AI
description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose\-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.
   

  

**Overview** 
  

  

 The Senior AI Test Analyst is responsible for defining, implementing, and executing testing strategies for AI\-powered solutions, including AI agents, generative AI applications, machine learning models, APIs, and business process workflows. The role focuses on AI model validation, data quality assessment, performance testing, responsible AI compliance, and the automation of testing processes to ensure the delivery of robust, scalable, secure, and high\-quality AI solutions.
   

 As MUFG Retirement Solutions continues to embed AI across its technology landscape, this role plays a key part in driving the adoption of AI\-enabled testing practices and automation capabilities. The position is responsible for identifying innovative and cost\-effective solutions, leveraging AI to enhance testing efficiency, quality, and coverage while promoting industry best practices.
   

 The role also ensures that the AI testing and automation strategy aligns with business objectives, quality standards, regulatory requirements, and the broader technology vision of MUFG Retirement Solutions.
   

**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities** 
  

 Strategic Focus 
   

* Develop and execute testing strategies for AI, Machine Learning (ML), and Generative AI solutions to ensure accuracy, reliability, performance, and business value.
* Define and implement robust AI test frameworks, methodologies, and automation solutions covering functional, integration, API, system, end\-to\-end, model validation, data validation, prompt validation, and adversarial testing scenarios.
* Establish comprehensive validation processes for AI model outputs against business requirements, acceptance criteria, Responsible AI principles, regulatory standards, and organizational governance policies.
* Drive quality assurance across the complete AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, data preparation, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, inference, monitoring, retraining, and reporting.
* Assess AI solution performance across dimensions such as accuracy, relevance, consistency, explainability, fairness, robustness, and reliability.
* Integrate AI testing activities and test automation framework \& scripts with continuous integration, CI/CD pipelines and tools to support continuous testing and deployment of AI solutions.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, product owners, and project managers to define testing requirements, success criteria, and quality measures.
* Manage the execution of automated test suites, monitor the test results and collaborate with teams to troubleshoot and resolve the issues promptly.
* Lead defect triage, root cause analysis, and quality risk management activities, ensuring timely resolution of issues impacting AI model performance and business outcomes.
* Champion the adoption of AI\-enabled testing tools, intelligent automation techniques, synthetic test data generation, and predictive quality engineering practices to improve testing efficiency and coverage.
* Drive research and evaluation of emerging AI testing methodologies, LLM evaluation frameworks, model benchmarking techniques, automation technologies, and industry best practices, providing strategic recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Establish and govern enterprise standards, processes, controls, and best practices for AI testing, validation, Responsible AI compliance, and model quality assurance across multiple AI initiatives.


  

 Operational Management
   

* Design, develop, execute, and maintain test cases and test scripts for AI, ML, and Generative AI applications.
* Validate data quality, data integrity, and data lineage across AI systems and supporting platforms.
* Lead functional, integration, API, regression, user acceptance, and end\-to\-end testing of AI\-enabled solutions.
* Assess AI model outputs for accuracy, consistency, bias, hallucinations, explainability, fairness, and alignment with business requirements and responsible AI standards.
* Execute prompt testing, response validation, and scenario\-based testing for Generative AI solutions.
* Execute model validation and inference testing activities, ensuring AI solutions perform consistently across diverse datasets, use cases, and operating conditions.
* Monitor and analyse test execution results, quality metrics, and model performance indicators, producing actionable insights and comprehensive test reports for stakeholders.
* Identify, document, track, and drive resolution of defects, model performance issues, data quality concerns, and AI\-specific risks throughout the testing lifecycle.
* Collaborate with business analysts, developers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver high\-quality AI solutions.
* Support test data preparation, environment validation, and model release verification activities.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance AI testing frameworks, processes, and automation capabilities.
* Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to project teams on AI testing methodologies, Responsible AI validation, test automation approaches, and emerging industry practices.
* Mentor junior testers and contribute to building AI testing capabilities across teams through coaching, standards adoption, and continuous learning initiatives.


  

 Governance \& Risk
   

* Identify quality, model, data, security, privacy, ethical, and compliance risks associated with AI solutions and proactively support mitigation activities.
* Validate adherence to Responsible AI principles, regulatory requirements, organizational policies, and governance standards.
* Conduct and support the assessment and reporting of AI\-related risks, including model bias, explainability, fairness, and data quality concerns.
* Maintain appropriate test evidence, validation reports, defect records, and audit documentation to support governance and compliance requirements.
* Escalate risks, issues, and control gaps that may impact AI solution quality, regulatory compliance, or business outcomes.


  

 The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time\-to\-time based on business needs.
   

**Experience \& Personal Attributes** 
  

 Experience
   

* 5\+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, and AI\-driven testing, with preference for candidates having 4\+ years of experience in Retirement Solutions, Financial Services, or BFSI domains.
* Strong experience in designing, developing, and executing AI\-powered test automation frameworks and quality assurance solutions using tools such as Selenium, Appium, UFT/OpenText (at least one mandatory), Python, Maven, Postman, REST APIs, SoapUI, Cortex, and Snowflake.
* Hands\-on experience leveraging AI\-assisted testing tools and technologies for test case generation, test optimization, defect prediction, intelligent test execution, and quality analytics.
* Strong understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and best practices, including test strategy, test planning, test design, test execution, defect management, reporting, and test governance.
* Experience validating AI/ML\-enabled applications, including model testing, data quality validation, prompt testing and optimization, response evaluation, bias and fairness assessment, hallucination detection, adversarial testing, explainability validation, and performance assessment of AI\-powered systems.
* Solid understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Quality Assurance (SQA) processes across Agile, Waterfall, and DevOps delivery models.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices using tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Azure Repos, Bitbucket, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to define quality standards, establish AI testing governance, track AI model evaluation metrics and quality KPIs, automate validation processes, and ensure reliable, scalable, and secure AI\-driven applications.
* Experience with cloud platforms, data validation, API testing, integration testing, and complex enterprise environments is highly desirable.
* Lead AI testing strategy and provide technical leadership for AI testing initiatives.
* Collaborate with Developers, Testers, and Business Analysts to design test cases and develop them using AI and automation testing tools.
* Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and API testing using tools such as Postman and REST Assured.
* Manage defects through JIRA and Azure DevOps and produce comprehensive test evidence documentation.
* Develop and execute end\-to\-end test automation solutions covering the entire data lifecycle, from raw data through to the reporting layer.
* Mentor team members and support the onboarding, training, and upskilling of testers in AI and automation testing tools, frameworks, and best practices.


  

 Personal Attributes
   

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Strong communication, collaboration.
* Strong attention to detail and quality orientation.
* Demonstrate ability to solve technical problems and implement innovative solutions.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Ability to learn new AT testing tools, test automation tools, technologies, and trends quickly and effectively.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and projects simultaneously and prioritize them

title: Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Why should you apply to this role?**
 The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision\-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large\-scale Cloud migrations.
   

  

 You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross\-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Migration Strategy:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
   

  

* Risk Management: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL\-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* Technical Architecture: Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision\-making through data\-backed insights.
* Delivery Excellence: Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support \& engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go\-live.
* Drive Accountability: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* Escalation Management: Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* Team Leadership: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data\-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.


**Industry Insight:** 
 Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
   

  

**Compensation**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Qualifications
   

  

* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on\-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision\-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior\-level decision\-makers and c\-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**
**About Atlassian**
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
