title: Asset & Wealth Management - AM Digital Product Management - Associate -Bengaluru
description:
**Job Description**
**What We Do**
 At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals.
   

  

 A career with Goldman Sachs Asset \& Wealth Management is an opportunity to help clients across the globe realize their potential, while you discover your own. As part of one of the world’s leading asset managers with over $3\.14 trillion in assets under supervision globally, you can expect to participate in exciting investment opportunities while collaborating with talented colleagues from all asset classes and regions and building meaningful relationships with your clients. Working in a culture that values integrity and transparency, you will be part of a diverse team that is passionate about our craft, our clients, and building sustainable success. Bringing together traditional and alternative investments, Goldman Sachs Asset \& Wealth Management provides clients around the world with a dedicated partnership and focus on long\-term performance. As the primary investment area within Goldman Sachs, we provide investment and advisory services for pension plans, sovereign wealth funds, insurance companies, endowments, foundations, financial advisors and individuals.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking an Associate Product Manager to help shape the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our marketing website. This role is ideal for someone passionate about creating engaging and informative online experiences that attract and convert potential clients. You will be responsible for ensuring the
 **Goldman Sachs website effectively communicates our firm's value proposition and supports our marketing goals.**
 As part of the Product Management team, key responsibilities will include conducting user research to understand website visitor behavior and needs, defining website requirements based on marketing objectives, prioritizing website features and content updates, managing the website backlog, and collaborating closely with marketing, design, and development teams to ensure successful and timely website enhancements. This includes improving user engagement metrics, and ensuring a seamless user experience across all devices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Supporting the Roadmap
+ Work with business stakeholders and end\-clients to gather key requirements
+ Ruthlessly prioritize potential initiatives by understanding alignment with business strategy and value generated for current and future clients

* Working with Product Development/Engineering:
+ Work with dev, architect, UX teams and business stakeholders to shape the core modules of the Institutional Portal
+ Work with UX team to ensure consistency and incorporation of client feedback
+ Balance new functionality, bugs, and client requests
+ Assign commercial opportunities to work queue
+ Prioritize potential initiatives by understanding alignment with business strategy and value generated for current and future users

* Establish Metrics of Usage and track OKRs
+ Track client usage, production issues, system stability
+ Establish usage metrics and production monitoring system KPIs to improve end user experience
+ Track OKRs

* Build Platform Collateral
+ Support demos and trainings on the product
+ Manage internal communication, updates, trainings for new feature releases
+ Develop, communicate and continuously refine product roadmaps that deliver innovative and engaging products


**Required Experience**
* 3 to 5 years of experience in product management, consulting, business analytics, or a related field
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related fields
* Proven experience in, and a passion for, building and shipping cutting edge financial and/or data products
* Exceptional communication skills
* Experience in agile product management methodologies
* Capability to apply a blend of strategic and tactical approaches to problems
* Creative design thinking, strong business acumen and technical know\-how
* Comfort with working in a rapidly evolving environment
* Ability to navigate and influence the organization with ease
* Tenacity. Someone who is willing to go beyond their comfort zone and be proactive, as neede


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in building and executing digital roadmaps within a financial context
* Experience working with data and API products, platforms and capabilities


**Why Join Us**
* Opportunity to work at the intersection of finance, data, and technology
* Exposure to product management best practices in a growing team
* A collaborative, fast\-moving environment where your ideas will be heard


**Goldman Sachs Engineering Culture**
 At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
   

  

 We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
**Bring order to complexity. Help deliver technology solutions that make an impact.**
 At The Missing Link, we don't just deliver technology solutions, we help organisations achieve meaningful business outcomes. As one of Australia's most awarded IT and Cyber Security providers, and now part of the Infosys family, we are continuing to grow our Cyber Security Penetration Testing team and are looking for a talented Project Coordinator to join us.
   

  

 With over 28 years of experience, 200\+ team members, and a culture built on inclusion, innovation and impact, we create an environment where skilled professionals can do meaningful work, sharpen their craft and grow their careers.
   

  

***We are The Missing Link between where you are and where you want to be.***
**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for an organised and customer\-focused Project Coordinator to join our Security Consulting team.
   

  

 This role serves as a key interface between clients, sales teams, technical specialists, vendors and delivery teams. You will be responsible for coordinating the successful delivery of small to medium\-scale security and technology projects, ensuring agreed scope, quality, timelines and budget objectives are achieved.
   

  

 You will work closely with internal and external stakeholders to coordinate resources, manage project administration activities, support billing processes and help deliver an exceptional customer experience from project initiation through to completion.
   

  

**What You'll Be Working On**
 Depending on project requirements, your typically date will include:
   

  

* Coordinating the delivery of small to medium\-scale security and technology projects, ensuring scope, timelines, budget, and quality objectives are achieved
* Working closely with clients, technical specialists, vendors, and internal stakeholders to manage project schedules, resources, risks, and deliverables
* Maintaining project plans, documentation, reporting, and administration activities through ConnectWise and other project management tools
* Facilitating project meetings and providing regular updates to ensure stakeholders remain informed and aligned throughout the project lifecycle
* Reviewing project deliverables, supporting project billing activities, and ensuring successful project handover and closure


 You'll play a key role in keeping projects on track, supporting delivery teams, and ensuring clients receive an exceptional experience from project commencement through to completion.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 1\+ year of experience within the IT industry, ideally in a Project Coordinator, Project Administrator, or similar role
* Tertiary qualification in Business, Information Technology, Project Management, or a related discipline
* Experience supporting the successful delivery of multiple technology projects in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience in preparing and reviewing project reports, resource allocation and scheduling resources
* Strong organisational, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail
* Customer\-focused mindset with a proactive approach to problem solving and continuous improvement
* Advanced Microsoft Word skills and intermediate Microsoft Excel skills
* Experience using Microsoft Project and ConnectWise, or similar project and service management platforms


**Benefits**
 A great company culture is very important to The Missing Link. Keeping everyone happy is one of our top priorities.
   

  

 Here are some of the best bits about working at The Missing Link and some of the ways we try and maintain our staff happiness levels:
   

  

* Supportive, collaborative and respectful environment
* Company culture that fosters learning and development through training and mentoring programs
* Opportunities for professional development and career advancement
* Learn from experienced professionals who actively share knowledge and mentor others
* Training and company paid certifications supported
* Exposure to diverse clients and industries
* Challenging, varied work that keeps you engaged and continuously learning


 If you are passionate about delivering exceptional client experiences, enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment, and want to be surrounded by people who genuinely care about quality and growth, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Software Staff Engineer
description:
Come join our passionate team! Barracuda is a leading cybersecurity company providing complete protection against complex threats. Our platform protects email, data, applications, and networks with innovative solutions, and a managed XDR service, to strengthen cyber resilience. Hundreds of thousands of IT professionals and managed service providers worldwide trust us to protect and support them with solutions that are easy to buy, deploy, and use.
   

  

 We know a diverse workforce adds to our collective value and strength as an organization. Barracuda Networks is proud to be an employer that complies with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity regardless of race, gender, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, or disability.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Working On**
* Serve as the lead front\-end engineer and core architect for the Data Inspector team.
* Drive technical design and architecture decisions for front\-end applications and platforms.
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high\-performance web applications using modern front\-end technologies.
* Lead the implementation of reusable UI components, shared libraries, and design systems across products.
* Collaborate closely with the Design and UX teams to deliver intuitive, accessible, and high\-quality user experiences.
* Work with product management and cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Contribute to and enhance shared design components and frameworks used across the organisation.
* Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and backend services in collaboration with platform and backend teams.
* Ensure application performance, security, reliability, and responsiveness across browsers and devices.
* Drive code reviews, establish engineering standards, and champion best practices in software development.
* Mentor team members and promote engineering best practices, code quality, maintainability, and technical excellence.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues and provide long\-term architectural solutions.
* Participate in technical roadmap planning and contribute to strategic technology decisions


**What You Bring To The Role**
* React.js,
* Redux,
* Node.js,
* Material UI,
* Chart.js,
* C\#.NET,
* HTML5,
* CSS3,
* JavaScript / TypeScript,
* JSON,
* REST APIs,
* Web Technologies and Web Application Architecture,
* Responsive UI Development,
* Cross\-browser Compatibility,
* Performance Optimisation, Git and CI/CD Practices


**What You’ll Get From Us**
 A team where you can voice your opinion, make an impact, and where you and your experience are valued. Internal mobility – there are opportunities for cross training and the ability to attain your next career step within Barracuda. In addition, you will receive equity, in the form of non\-qualifying options.

title: Product Operations Associate
description:
**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 




**Replication launches \& platform setup** 



* Own end to end setup of new program launches across our messaging and IVR stack such as RapidPro, Turn, Exotel, Motor Admin and our internal Orchestrator.
* Validate and consolidate requirements from medical, film and translation teams before setup; manage template approvals and campaign creation, including code based configuration.
* Set up project specific journey logic (e.g., conditional acknowledgments, response handling) based on program requirements.
* Ensure every launch is delivered on time, thoroughly tested and fully functional before going live.



**IVR \& onboarding** 



* Build complete IVR journeys in Exotel such as onboarding flows, campaign journeys and user friendly navigation.
* Set up QR and IVR based onboarding, including QR configuration, Motor Admin flows, and Turn journeys, ensuring users are routed to the right campaigns.



**Data management** 



* Track incoming program data, maintain data trackers, monitor ingestion and identify and flag data errors on the dashboards.



**Platform quality \& troubleshooting** 



* Independently investigate and resolve technical issues across platforms where needed (e.g., language mapping, user profile updates, template approval scripts).
* Support platform transitions and migrations (e.g., moving flows, campaigns and media between messaging platforms).



**Documentation \& research tooling** 



* Write and maintain PRDs, launch runbooks, dashboard requirements, and other product documentation.
* Build survey flows in SurveyCTO for research and training projects, working with research teams on implementation and refinement, including IRB approval processes where required.



**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 



* 1\-3 years of experience in product management, program operations or technical implementation, ideally in digital health, social impact or messaging platforms.
* Comfort working hands on with no code/low code platforms (e.g., RapidPro, Turn, Exotel, SurveyCTO)
* Strong execution and coordination skills, able to run multiple concurrent launches with cross functional teams and hit deadlines without dropping quality.
* Clear written communication, can turn messy requirements into PRDs, runbooks, and documentation others actually use.
* A user first, detail oriented mindset: you test everything before launch and care about the experience of caregivers on the other end.



**Good to have** 



* Experience with IVR systems, audio content management or multilingual content operations.
* Familiarity with public health programs (MCH, TB, NCD) or working with government health systems.
* Experience with Figma

description:
**Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?**
 Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long\-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.
   

  

 With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.
   

  

 Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Position Title: Application Engineer
   

  

 Corporate Title: Analyst
   

  

 Reporting to: VP
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru
   

  

**Job Profile**
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor/master’s degree in computer science or a closely related discipline, or an equivalent combination of formal education and experience.
* Minimum 3\-8 years of software development experience in implementing technologies and/or vendor platforms to service the business needs.
* 3\+ years of developing, supporting and maintaining applications which are build / deployed in UNIX environment.
* Proficient in development, Unix Shell Scripting and PL/SQL.
* Hands on experience in HP QC, UNIX, AIX, MQ, Tidal/Autosys, Shell scripting, Jira, ServiceNow.
* Lead and manage projects throughout the system SDLC lifecycle to meet functional goals, budget constraints and delivery timeline.
* Excellent communication skills and flexible and adaptable to new environments. Ability to quickly learn new systems, products, and businesses; Proactive and result oriented.
* Ability to independently manage, organize and prioritize multiple tasks, projects/BAU responsibilities.


**Good To Have**
* 2\+ years of experience in Banking, Financial Services, payments application.
* Good to have experience with CGI HotScan product or any other Sanction screening system.
* Sound knowledge of wire scanning process. Different list, OFAC, Acuity, Internal and external, alert review, list management, defining rules, system tuning and scaling system of application.


**Job Responsibilities**
* Installing, Upgrading, Configuring the off the shelf vendor product – developed in UNIX/JAVA/Oracle and AIX environment.
* Perform application support for Compliance applications; Troubleshoot and perform root cause analysis, coordinate with vendor and business to resolve critical SLA driven issues.
* Able to research and learn new methodologies and technologies and bring knowledge to the team.

* Perform analysis to determine and verify business requirements/issues specification, flows and deliverables for projects.
* Tracking BAU issue with Jira and managing INC tickets.

* Working with different teams for system vulnerability remediation.

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI\-powered data security. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on\-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. description:

 Office
   

  

**Job Description**
 Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with an annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving sophisticated analytical challenges, growing efficiency in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life\-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our distributed team of more than 130,000 colleagues delivers an unrivalled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry\-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.thermofisher.com.
   

  

 As a Software Developer, you will actively engage in comprehending software requirements thoroughly, ensuring end\-to\-end understanding, and delivering high quality code to fulfill these requirements. Your focus extends to optimizing system performance while prioritizing the long\-term maintainability of the codebase.
   

  

**What will you do?**
* Perform scenario\-based manual testing of software applications to identify defects and ensure adherence to quality standards.
* Analyze requirements and develop comprehensive test scenarios and test cases covering positive, negative, boundary, edge, exception, and end\-to\-end business scenarios.
* Apply strong software testing techniques Decision Table Testing, State Transition Testing, Error Guessing, and Exploratory Testing.
* Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on project requirements.
* Conduct verification and validation activities to confirm that software meets specified requirements and user expectations.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand system requirements, identify requirement gaps, and validate software functionality.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, system, exploratory, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Analyze test results, identify issues, and report defects in a clear and timely manner.
* Work closely with developers to troubleshoot issues, verify fixes, and ensure the integrity of the software.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright with Python, where applicable, to improve regression coverage and testing efficiency.
* Execute and maintain automated test scripts as part of the overall testing process.
* Perform mobile device testing across applicable devices, operating systems, screen sizes, and configurations, where required.
* Participate in sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, and retrospective meetings to provide input on testing activities and contribute to process improvement initiatives.


**Minimum Requirements Or Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 6\-9 years of experience in software testing, verification, and validation.
* Strong proficiency in scenario\-based manual testing methodologies and techniques.
* Strong knowledge and hands\-on experience in test design techniques such as Boundary Value Analysis, Equivalence Partitioning, Decision Table Testing, State Transition Testing, Error Guessing, and Exploratory Testing.
* Strong ability to derive comprehensive test scenarios from requirements, business workflows, and user behavior, including positive, negative, boundary, edge, and exception scenarios.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
* Experience in functional, integration, regression, system, exploratory, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Experience with Playwright automation using Python is an added advantage.
* Experience with Python and pytest is an added advantage.
* Experience in mobile device testing is an added advantage.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* Proven ability to prioritize tasks, manage workload efficiently, and meet project deadlines.
* Knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC), software testing lifecycle (STLC), and Agile methodologies.
* Exposure to ISO 13485 and IEC 62304 standards for medical device development.
* ISTQB or similar certification is a plus.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
**Who we are** 






 DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum\-safe future at www.digicert.com
 




  
 




**Job summary** 






 The Engineering Manager is responsible for leading a single engineering team to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure software solutions. This role focuses on day‑to‑day technical leadership, people management, and delivery execution within a defined product or platform area. The Engineering Manager works closely with Product, Architecture, and Operations to ensure the team delivers high‑quality outcomes aligned to roadmap and business goals.
 




  
 




**What you will do**

	+ Lead technical execution for a specific product, service, or platform area.
	+ Ensure designs and implementations follow established architecture, security, and reliability standards.
	+ Promote best practices in coding, code review, testing, CI/CD, observability, and performance tuning.
	+ Partner with senior engineers and architects to plan and implement refactoring, modernization, and tech‑debt reduction.

	+ Manage, coach, and develop a team of software engineers and senior engineers.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

* Experience working with distributed systems, APIs, and microservices.

**Benefits** 




* Generous time off policies
* Top shelf benefits

title: Global Product Cyber Security Expert – R&D Digital Portfolio EM&AO
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.



This Position reports to:



Digital Solution Engineering Manager \#\#\#


**Your role and responsibilities**



Working as a Global Digital Portfolio Cyber Security Expert, you will play a critical role in safeguarding our organization's digital assets for products of the global AUEN Digital Energy Management / Autonomous Operations products.



You will be responsible for **defining, governing and assuring cybersecurity\-by\-design across global R\&D product development**, ensuring compliance with ABB Product Security requirements, international standards (e.g. IEC 62443\), and applicable regulations.



The role acts as **global cybersecurity reference for the Digital Energy Management and Autonomous Operations product portfolio**, working with R\&D teams to embed security requirements into architectures, software, and lifecycle processes (SPDLC), while **challenging designs and approving security readiness**.



In this role, you will be part of a global team of product owners, software developers, architects, and testers to apply principles of software engineering, contribute to development as part of different state\-of\-the\-art cloud and edge software systems and architectures of the product portfolio.



You will be hosted in one of the team locations: Mannheim (DE), Genoa (IT), Bangalore (IN) in a hybrid mode (\#LI\-Hybrid)



Relocation of the candidate is not required.**\***



Your work will have a profound impact on the global cloud, cloud\-native and edge platform landscape.



You will be mainly accountable for:


**Cyber Security Management:**



Develop and implement comprehensive cyber security strategies, policies, and procedures to protect digital on\-prem/edge/cloud products against cyber threats, including malware, phishing, data breaches, and insider threats following the minimum cyber\-security requirements from ABB in full compliance, and responsibility, with PSA (Product Security Assessment) internal process.



Conduct regular security assessments and audits to identify vulnerabilities, risks and take proactive measures to address them.



Respond promptly to security incidents.



Implement access controls, encryption, and other security measures to safeguard sensitive data in line with Global Digital Team direction.


**Compliance and Risk Management:**



Stay up to date with industry Standards \& Compliance, regulations, and best practices related to cyber security and cloud computing, such as GDPR, NIS2, ISO/IEC 27001 and IEC 62443 SL3\.



Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.



Collaborate with internal teams and external auditors to ensure adherence to compliance requirements and address any findings, incidents or recommendations by executing and coordinating: investigation, schedule, corrective actions and disaster recovery plan to ensure business continuity.


**Other responsibilities/skills:**


* Collaborate with all organization members to contribute to the overall software development lifecycle in assigned areas and reach targets, share knowledge and contribute to a positive work atmosphere
* Follow agile software development practices to build and deliver software in an iterative and incremental manner as part of a global team’s scrum\-based development process
* Continue your personal learning journey by staying abreast of new and evolving software engineering technologies and sharing knowledge with team members
* A high level of self\-motivation, curiosity, as well as a strong desire and ability to learn and adapt to new technologies, tools, and programming languages
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot and debug software issues
* Project management capabilities
* Scrum and Agile methodologies knowledge
* Ensure that CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices incorporate cybersecurity controls and security testing requirements.


**Qualifications for the role**


* Master's degree in computer science with a focus on IT security. A PhD with cyber security focus is considered a plus.


Advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CCSP) preferred.



10 years of proven experience in product or system cybersecurity for industrial or critical systems.



5 years in cloud computing, with a strong understanding of security principles, technologies, and best practices.



Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including proficiency in cloud services and management tools. Familiarity with Azure DevOps for CI/CD pipelines.



Strong experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and Podman for container orchestration and management.



Proficiency in OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and identity management solutions such as Keycloak.



Experience with Helm charts for managing Kubernetes applications and deployments.



Strong understanding of the design and architecture of microservices, including principles such as loose coupling, bounded contexts, and domain\-driven design.



Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and work cross\-functionally with internal teams geographically distributed.



Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks in a fast\-paced environment, while also collaborating effectively as part of a global team.



Effective verbal and written communication skills in English, eventually German if location is Germany. Willing to travel, time to time, for office/site visit.



This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.\*


*The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.*

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.



Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Data Architect
description:
### **Job Title**

Data Architect
### **Job Description**

* Executes robust data strategies, adapting them to align with evolving business requirements and operational needs while coordinating with cross\-functional teams to ensure strategic alignment and feasibility, working under limited supervision.
* Handles the execution of complex data requests and queries, employing advanced analytical techniques to derive actionable insights and support decision\-making processes effectively.
* Helps to safeguard the integrity of data outputs and reports through rigorous verification, validation, and adherence to established quality standards, implementing data quality frameworks and monitoring data health metrics proactively.
* Optimizes scalable data pipeline architectures, assembling and managing extensive datasets crucial for Post Market Analytics and other strategic initiatives, implementing best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and storage.
* Documents and ensures compliance with comprehensive statistical\-based trending procedures, maintaining transparency and readiness for regulatory audits, and developing and maintaining documentation of data processes, methodologies, and compliance measures.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Kinaxis**
 Are you looking to join an innovative, market\-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
   

  

 In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best\-in\-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
   

  

 Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end\-to\-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
   

  

**Location**
 Chennai / Bangalore \- India
   

  

 Work Model \- Hybrid
   

  

**About The Role**
 Kinaxis is building a Forward Deployed Engineers team whose singular mission is to Help customer transform how work gets done in the Agentic Age. This is not a consulting role, and it is not a features team. It is a Multi deployment unit embedded, operating with the speed and ownership culture of a startup.
   

  

 This team operates as a POD inside Kinaxis — a small, tight unit with end\-to\-end ownership and a startup mentality inside a larger company. We are scrappy, resourceful, and self\-directed. We move fast, trade tasks to whoever is closest to the need, and stay relentlessly focused on customer impact.
   

  

 You will work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customers — from warehouse floor to executive sponsor — designing, building, and shipping Agentic AI solutions on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform. When a solution works, you abstract it into a reusable pattern. When something breaks in production, you own the fix. You operate in a POD team: tight, multi\-disciplinary, and self\-directed.
   

  

 💡 Attitude is the biggest asset. We hire for trajectory and mindset, not years on a resume. The right bias to action, ownership, and appetite to keep learning cannot be taught — but every technical skill here can be. Bring those, and we will invest in the rest.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Build the data backbone for AI Agents on Maestro**
* Design, build, and operate production data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — that feed agentic AI workflows on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform.
* Integrate customer data sources (ERP systems, data warehouses, supply chain applications, flat files, APIs) into a unified data layer that agents can reason over reliably.
* Build and maintain data platform services, tooling, and infrastructure that enable reliable data ingestion, processing, sharing, and discovery across customer deployments.
* Own data quality end\-to\-end: profiling, validation, anomaly detection, and lineage — because an agent is only as good as the data behind it.


**Ship AI Agents alongside the POD**
* Partner with AI\-focused FDEs to design, develop, and ship agentic AI workflows — including multi\-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, and tool\-use patterns — ensuring the data layer is production\-ready.
* Translate messy, real\-world customer data landscapes into clean, well\-modeled foundations that agents can consume — iterating rapidly from prototype to deployment.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across the full stack data pipelines, model context, API layers, and infrastructure — in live customer environments.


**Own the full solution lifecycle**
* Carry multiple customer engagements in parallel; set expectations early, renegotiate honestly when priorities shift, and own outcomes end\-to\-end.
* Define and track success in business terms: data freshness SLAs, pipeline reliability, query performance, exception rates — not just deployment completion.
* Drive platform engineering best practices through Infrastructure\-as\-Code, CI/CD automation, observability, and automated testing across customer deployments.


**Work inside a POD team**
* Operate as part of a small, self\-directed POD within Kinaxis tasks traded fluidly to whoever has the right skills, focus maintained with urgency.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to convert field learnings and repeatable data patterns into durable platform capabilities, not one\-off scripts.
* Serve as the technical face of the team in customer rooms — from IC\-level engineers to skeptical architects to VP sponsors and build genuine trust across all of them.


**Drive adoption and change**
* Guide customer data teams through solution transitions: the new data architecture has to stick, not just ship.
* Mentor customer teams on modern data engineering practices, agentic data workflows, and new operating patterns so capability transfers and does not remain dependent on you.


****What we are looking for****
**Bias to action**
 You move on what matters. You finish what you start. The outcome is yours — no waiting for perfect clarity.
   

  

**Self\-directed**
 You identify what matters, secure the help or learning you need, and deliver — without being told.
   

  

**Always learning**
 Every customer, teammate, and new tool is a chance to level up. Not knowing something is fine; refusing to learn it is not.
   

  

**Customer\-obsessed**
 You can sit with a frustrated VP, a skeptical architect, or a junior analyst — and leave each one feeling heard, helped, and impressed.
   

  

**Comfortable with ambiguity**
 Undefined problem, undefined scope, undefined success metric — and you still ship.
   

  

**Drives change, not just code**
 You guide customers through transitions and mentor their teams to adopt new ways of working.
   

  

 The following are the technical areas we look for. You do not need depth in all of them — we look for strong foundations, a growth trajectory, and the ability to pick up what is missing quickly.
   

  

**Data Engineering \& Platforms (Primary)**
* Strong hands\-on experience building and operating production data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — using tools such as Spark, Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents.
* Deep working knowledge of modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar), including Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, data modeling, query optimization, and performance tuning at scale.
* Strong SQL skills and deep understanding of data modeling, schema design, and large\-scale data processing patterns.
* Experience with data governance practices: RBAC, PII handling, data lineage, data quality frameworks, and enterprise\-scale data management.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure, GCP, or AWS) and Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar).
* Strong debugging instincts with imperfect, real\-world data in production environments — you have untangled broken pipelines at 2 AM and lived to tell the tale.


**AI \& Agentic Development**
* Hands\-on experience building LLM\-based applications — RAG systems, multi\-agent workflows, tool\-use patterns, prompt and context engineering.
* Familiarity with modern AI\-assisted development tools (Copilot, Claude Code, agentic IDE workflows) as daily practice, not novelty.
* Understanding of agentic orchestration patterns — when to use single vs. multi\-agent architectures, how to handle memory and state.


**Software Engineering**
* Solid, hands\-on software engineering fundamentals: you have built and shipped real systems, not just scripts.
* Proficiency in at least one backend language (Python strongly preferred) and the ability to read and contribute across a polyglot codebase.
* Experience with REST and streaming APIs, authentication patterns, and integration with enterprise systems.


**Data Engineering \& Platforms**
* Ability to build and maintain data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — using tools such as Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents.
* Working familiarity with modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or similar), including data modeling and performance fundamentals.

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Department**
 Technology
   

  

**Our Company Promise**
 We are committed to provide our Employees a stable work environment with equal opportunity for learning and personal growth. Creativity and innovation are encouraged for improving the effectiveness of Southwest Airlines. Above all, Employees will be provided the same concern, respect, and caring attitude within the organization that they are expected to share externally with every Southwest Customer.
   

  

**Job Description**
 About Us
   

  

 At Southwest Airlines, we believe that flying should feel like freedom. For over 50 years, we’ve been connecting people to what matters most with low fares, legendary hospitality, and a heart for service. Our culture is built on the principles of fun, friendliness, and family, making us one of the most admired workplaces in the world.
   

  

 If you’re passionate about making a difference, love working in a fast\-paced environment, and want to help millions of travelers reach their destinations with a smile, Southwest Airlines is the place for you. Here, your career can truly take flight.
   

  

**Job Summary**
* Serve as the liaison between the business (represented by the Product Owner) and the Agile software development team. Help the team reach peak productivity by working with team members, resolving impediments blocking a team, and helping to track their progress. Play a critical role in the adoption of Scrum and other Agile development practices by the organization.
* As a Scrum Master \- MarTech / Content Supply Chain, you’ll enable a high\-performing delivery pod by establishing disciplined Scrum practices, improving flow and predictability, and creating an operating rhythm that helps teams deliver transformative MarTech and digital experiences.
* You’ll coach teams through purposeful ceremonies, remove impediments, strengthen collaboration across Product, Engineering, QA, and dependent teams, and use delivery metrics and feedback loops to drive continuous improvement. The role will also support Agile delivery for AI\-enabled and agentic capabilities, where experimentation, evaluation thresholds, probabilistic outputs, and human escalation paths influence planning and incremental delivery.


**Responsibilities**
* Organize and facilitate planning, daily stand\-up meetings, reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, demos and other Scrum\-related meetings
* Serve as the team’s radiator, ensuring necessary internal and external communication, while improving overall transparency
* Ensure the development teams are practicing the core Agile values, practices and principles of collaboration, prioritization, team accountability, and visibility
* Look for avenues to increase the productivity effectiveness of the teams in any way possible
* Assist team with making appropriate commitments through story selection, task definition
* Add value to the team and organization and coach the team up
* May perform other job duties as directed by Employee's Leaders
* Establish and facilitate effective Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily coordination, reviews, retrospectives, backlog refinement, and other team operating rhythms.
* Coach the pod on Scrum principles, Agile practices, ownership, accountability, estimation, and continuous improvement while protecting the team from avoidable delivery disruption.
* Improve delivery predictability by monitoring and using velocity, WIP, throughput, cycle time, predictability, and other flow metrics to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
* Identify, surface, track, and remove impediments that affect team delivery, coordinating with Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, Platform, and dependent teams as needed.
* Create an environment where team members own commitments, decisions, and outcomes while constructively resolving conflicts and improving team collaboration.
* Partner closely with the Product Owner to support backlog readiness, story clarity, acceptance criteria, sprint goals, sequencing, and realistic delivery commitments.
* Support delivery of AI\-enabled and agentic capabilities by helping teams incorporate experimentation, evaluation metrics, probabilistic outputs, human\-review or escalation points, and learning loops into iterative delivery.
* Coordinate dependencies across multiple pods, shared platform teams, and Agile Release Trains, making commitments, risks, dependencies, and release readiness visible to stakeholders.
* Use Jira or Azure DevOps to create and maintain dashboards that make flow, dependencies, commitments, release readiness, and continuous\-improvement actions visible.
* Facilitate retrospectives that result in specific, owned actions and follow through on improvement commitments to strengthen team health and delivery performance.
* Partner with distributed US/India teams and cross\-functional stakeholders to maintain clear communication, operating rhythms, and handoffs across the delivery ecosystem.
* Coach teams through change and support the establishment of a high\-performance Agile culture within new or evolving MarTech delivery pods.


**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
* Ability to demonstrate capacity in airport/airline operations, airport finances, contracts, and high regard for interpersonal relationships
* Ability to produce working contracts among different stakeholders such as definition of done, scope lock, acceptance of work etc.
* Skilled in strong organization and communication
* Skilled in utilizing strong problem\-solving in an unstructured environment as a self\-starter
* Skilled in planning, preparing for, and leading meetings
* Ability to demonstrate and maintain an extremely high regard for confidential and sensitive information
* Skilled in SAFe
* Deep practical command of Scrum and Agile delivery, including sprint planning, daily coordination, reviews, retrospectives, backlog refinement, estimation, and impediment removal.
* Strong experience coaching software or platform delivery teams and improving team ownership, collaboration, accountability, and delivery discipline.
* Strong understanding of flow and delivery metrics including velocity, WIP, throughput, predictability, cycle time, and retrospective action tracking.
* Ability to facilitate difficult conversations, resolve delivery and team conflicts, and build alignment across Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, and dependent teams.
* Strong delivery\-tooling skills with Jira or Azure DevOps, including dashboards and reporting for flow, dependencies, commitments, release readiness, and improvement actions.
* Ability to support scaled Agile delivery across multiple pods, shared platforms, and Agile Release Trains while making dependencies and risks visible.
* Ability to coach teams delivering AI\-enabled or agentic products where probabilistic outputs, experimentation, evaluation thresholds, and human escalation paths affect planning and acceptance.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills with the ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams.
* Strong problem\-solving and systems\-thinking skills with a focus on sustainable delivery improvements rather than short\-term process compliance.


 Education
   

  

* Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related field and/or equivalent formal training


**Experience**
* Required: Intermediate\-level experience, fully functioning broad knowledge in:
+ Scrum framework and Kanban methods
+ Velocity and flow metrics
+ Techniques for increasing team effectiveness

* 2\-5 years of relevant work\-related experience


**Other Qualifications**
* Must meet confidentiality expectations as to confidential, proprietary and sensitive Company information
* Ability to work extended hours as needed

description:

 Treibt Initiativen zur Verbesserung der Effektivität der Engineering\-Funktion voran und arbeitet mit anderen Funktionen zusammen, um eine effektive Koordination von Metriken, Dashboards, funktionalen Prozessen und einer funktionsübergreifenden Initiativkoordination zu gewährleisten. **Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**
* Verantwortlich für die Entwicklung und Verwaltung von Ingenieur\-/Technologieprojekten. Fungiert als Schnittstelle zwischen internen/externen Kunden, um sicherzustellen, dass die Zuweisung der Organisationsressourcen erfolgt. * Dient als Ressource für Kollegen mit weniger Erfahrung.Kann kleine Projekte mit moderaten Risiken und Ressourcenanforderungen leiten.Erklärt schwierige oder vertrauliche Informationen; arbeitet, um einen Konsens zu schaffen.Entwicklung von Überzeugungsfähigkeiten, die erforderlich sind, um andere bei Themen innerhalb des Fachgebiets zu beeinflussen.


**Grundqualifikationen**
* Diese Rolle erfordert umfangreiche Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor\-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule.


**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**
* Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Nachweisliche Fähigkeit, Probleme zu analysieren und zu lösen. Nachweislich eFähigkeit, Programme/Projekte zu leiten. Fähigkeit, Programme zu dokumentieren, zu planen, zu vermarkten und auszuführen. Dokumentierte Projektmanagementfähigkeiten.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.

title: Scrum Master - Senior Engineer
description:
TJX Companies
   

  

 At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off\-price retailer.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About TJX:**
 TJX is a Fortune 100 company that operates off\-price retailers of apparel and home fashions. TJX India \- Hyderabad is the IT home office in the global technology organization of off\-price apparel and home fashion retailer TJX, established to deliver innovative solutions that help transform operations globally. At TJX, we strive to build a workplace where our Associates’ contributions are welcomed and are embedded in our purpose to provide excellent value to our customers every day. At TJX India, we take a long\-term view of your career. We have a high\-performance culture that rewards Associates with career growth opportunities, preferred assignments, and upward career advancement. We take well\-being very seriously and are committed to offering a great work\-life balance for all our Associates.
   

  

**What You Will Discover**
* Inclusive culture and career growth opportunities
* A truly Global IT Organization that collaborates across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia, click here to learn more
* Challenging, collaborative, and team\-based environment


**Our Organization**
 The Global Stores Engineering organization is responsible for delivering technology solutions to drive growth, enable efficiency, and improve the customer experience at the front\-line in our stores. We innovate globally across all TJX banners to ensure a first\-class transaction process for our customers (sales, returns, and exchanges), enable payment processing and TJX rewards programs, facilitate downstream sales audit and financial reporting, and much more!
   

  

 We are on a mission to modernize our solutions, which include extending our solutions globally and exploring alternative and mobile checkout solutions. We aspire to align with our global partners to deliver high value products and streamlined experiences to our customers and associates. Our commitment is to lead the way, empowering our team to drive efficiencies, grow skills, and deliver great solutions.
   

  

 We are expanding our organizational footprint and need your help to accomplish our vision! You will have a real opportunity to be a part of driving over $50B in annual revenue and make our stores a destination that our customers love.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 This Scrum Master role will support our Stores \& Supply Chain Engineering Teams from India. As a Scrum Master, in an Agile/iterative team you will be responsible for educating and coaching your Scrum/Kanban team(s) on GFOS Agile / Iterative processes. You will also be responsible for leading continuous improvement initiatives within your team and display a working knowledge of Kanban, Scrum and Iterative principles. Supporting impediment removals, fostering an environment that builds and supports a high performing team and monitoring team progress are key functions or this role.
   

  

 You will partner with the Product Owner and Product Manager (who in India may be Product, Delivery and or Engineering associates) to ensure the product backlog is continuously refined and work is prioritized and scheduled. The Scrum Master is accountable for delivering value to the business and stakeholders. Understanding and supporting the TJX Solution Delivery Process (SDP) while adhering to Compliance guidelines is key.
   

  

 The following are examples of typical Scrum Master activities.
   

  

* Supports team impediment removal and dependency tracking
* Facilitates Agile team ceremonies e.g., daily standups, reviews, retrospectives
* Ensures team agreements are in place
* Drives team iteration commitments and plan to maximize business value delivery
* Collaborates with other Scrum Masters across the ART as necessary e.g., Scrum of Scrums
* Coordinates with other teams as necessary, for example Shared Services or DevOps team
* Key Partner with the Product Owner to ensure product backlog items are refined, prioritized, and scheduled
* Supports estimating activities within the team
* Supports Release Planning
* Responsible for facilitating capacity planning
* Reviews metrics to measure team progress and responsible for achieving baseline KPI
* Validates time tracking
* Tracks team objectives using appropriate Agile tools/applications
* Protects team from external interference
* Supports ART Readiness/Preparations
* May provide Flow Board Management if supporting a Kanban team
* May be an Epic Owner


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Over 5 years of experience working in Agile environments, with a strong focus on iterative delivery and continuous improvement
* 4\+ years serving as a Scrum Master, guiding teams through Agile transformation and execution
* Advanced Scrum certification (PSM II or CSP), demonstrating deep understanding of Agile principles and practices
* Expertise in Agile delivery models, including Scrum and Kanban
* Proficient in story structuring and sizing, defining "Definition of Done," facilitating Agile ceremonies, and driving effective sprint execution
* Proven ability to coach and support multiple teams simultaneously, fostering collaboration and high performance
* Exceptional facilitation and conflict resolution skills, enabling productive team dynamics and stakeholder engagement
* Experienced in estimation and budgeting, supporting planning and forecasting across initiatives
* Clear and transparent communicator, adept at aligning teams and stakeholders through concise messaging
* Empathetic leadership style, supporting and motivating teams through challenges and change
* Strong problem\-solving capabilities, focused on removing impediments and maintaining team momentum
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Understanding of retail operations, in\-store technologies, and omnichannel commerce
* SAFE Agile Certifications are a plus.


 In addition to our open door policy and supportive work environment, we also strive to provide a competitive salary and benefits package. TJX considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity and expression, marital or military status, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. TJX also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state and local law.

title: Manager, IT Delivery

**Vanguard India**
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud\-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world\-class experience for our clients.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Manager, IT Delivery role manages and leads a team of technical support staff who design, develop, test, implement, and monitor software and tools; works with business leaders to define scope and requirements, and plans and executes the development of various systems; and acts as liaison with business sponsors and principals, while leading cross\-functional teams, managing project risks and resources, and integrating cybersecurity best practices to ensure secure and successful project delivery.
   

  

**Responsibilites**
* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Responsible for delivering software releases relating to the product for the business units. Works with business clients to determine scope, and develops environmental requirements for each project.
* Works closely with management to develop and implement staffing and operational plans. Participates in the development of short and long term department goals. Monitors and reports on service delivery metrics and overall performance.
* Develops and implements changes to department policies and procedures to meet changing business needs and to achieve department objectives. Identifies opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Leads quality initiatives to improve the delivery of service levels. Works with senior management in the planning, development, and execution of short and long range goals.
* Presents status, metrics, and department initiatives at meetings with management and project peers. Maintains relationships with technical teams, IT, and business partners.
* Participates in the development of the department budget. Reviews expenses and ensures department operates within budgetary guidelines.
* Ensures staff complies with information technology and information security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead cross\-functional teams, fostering collaboration and effectively communicating project progress and updates to stakeholders.
* Identify potential risks throughout the project lifecycle and implement strategies to mitigate them, ensuring smooth project delivery.
* Develop comprehensive project plans, set timelines, allocate resources efficiently, and manage budgets to ensure successful project delivery.
* Enhance cybersecurity frameworks by integrating advanced security measures and best practices into IT projects to safeguard company data and assets.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* Minimum 8 years of experience in IT project management, software development, or IT service delivery. Previous leadership experience required.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. PMP, ITIL, or Agile certifications preferred.
* Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in IT infrastructure, software development, and enterprise IT solutions.
* Must have skills: Node.js, TypeScript, ECS, Kubernetes,Kore.AI, Android, iOS development
* Proficiency in risk management, budgeting, and IT governance. Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and IT compliance standards.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.


**Location**

title: Senior Manager, Agile Transformation, Commercial Ops
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Agile Transformation Leader will be accountable for driving measurable business outcomes through Agile transformation, scaled execution, and continuous improvement across CCFT. This role will ensure that CCFT staff, product teams, Agile Release Trains, and leaders effectively leverage SAFe practices, Agile governance, product delivery disciplines, and performance metrics to improve speed, quality, predictability, customer value, and strategic alignment.
   

  

 This role will serve as a senior transformation leader, coach, people leader, and change agent focused on translating Agile ways of working into tangible business impact. The Agile Transformation Leader will partner closely with CCFT leadership, Agile Enablement, product teams, and global stakeholders to improve delivery effectiveness, strengthen execution accountability, and build a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous value delivery.
   

  

 AIN Scrum Masters within CCFT will report directly to this role, and SM across geographies will have a dotted line of reporting.
   

  

**Key Roles And Responsibilities**
**Business Outcome\-Driven Agile Transformation**
* Lead Agile transformation across CCFT with a clear focus on improving business outcomes, delivery predictability, product value, stakeholder satisfaction, operational efficiency, and time\-to\-market.
* Assess Agile maturity across teams and Agile Release Trains to identify opportunities that directly improve execution, flow, quality, transparency, and value realization.
* Develop and implement Agile maturity accelerators that help teams move beyond process adoption toward measurable improvements in delivery performance and business impact.
* Partner with CCFT leadership to align Agile practices, team priorities, and product execution with strategic business objectives.
* Drive transformation initiatives that improve how CCFT plans, funds, prioritizes, delivers, measures, and continuously improves product and technology outcomes.
* Strengthen our operation and execution excellence by focusing on Incident Management and Live narratives across product teams within Commercial Tech.


**People Leadership and Agile Capability Building**
* Provide direct management, leadership, and mentorship to Scrum Masters/BA, ensuring their work is aligned to business priorities, team outcomes, and Agile delivery excellence.
* Shortlist, interview, hire, onboard, and develop Scrum Masters who can enable high\-performing teams and improve delivery outcomes.
* Mentor Scrum Masters, Release Train Engineers, Product Analysts, and Product Managers to strengthen Agile execution, product thinking, stakeholder alignment, and outcome\-based delivery.
* Establish clear expectations for Agile roles with an emphasis on value delivery, impediment removal, decision enablement, and continuous improvement.
* Support performance development for Agile delivery roles by connecting individual contributions to team maturity, product outcomes, and organizational goals.


**Coaching, Mentoring, and Enablement**
* Coach Global CCFT teams and leaders on applying SAFe, Agile, Lean, and product management practices in ways that improve business agility and execution effectiveness.
* Provide practical guidance to teams on Agile events, roles, planning, prioritization, dependency management, and delivery practices that support better business outcomes.
* Deliver training, enablement sessions, and workshops that help teams, leaders, and stakeholders understand how Agile practices enable faster decisions, better alignment, improved quality, and increased value delivery.
* Facilitate workshops focused on outcome\-based planning, product alignment, Agile governance, continuous improvement, and SAFe adoption.
* Promote shared learning across teams to scale proven practices and improve Agile capability across CCFT globally.


**Agile Governance, Metrics, and Value Measurement**
* Enable Agile governance practices that improve transparency, accountability, decision\-making, and business alignment across CCFT product teams and Agile Release Trains.
* Establish and promote the use of meaningful Agile and product metrics to measure delivery health, predictability, flow, quality, risk, dependencies, customer value, and business impact.
* Help teams and leaders use metrics to make better decisions, identify improvement opportunities, and demonstrate progress against strategic objectives.
* Conduct regular program reviews with stakeholders to provide visibility into delivery progress, risks, dependencies, value delivered, and outcomes achieved.
* Ensure Agile measurement practices are used to drive learning, prioritization, and continuous improvement rather than solely administrative reporting.


**Continuous Improvement and Innovation**
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, collaboration, accountability, and measurable value delivery across CCFT.
* Identify systemic delivery impediments and partner with leaders and teams to remove barriers that limit speed, quality, predictability, or business value.
* Drive improvements in planning, execution, feedback loops, prioritization, dependency management, and stakeholder engagement.
* Develop reusable accelerators, playbooks, coaching models, and operating practices that improve Agile maturity and business effectiveness.
* Encourage experimentation and learning to help teams improve delivery outcomes and respond more effectively to changing business needs.


**Agile Transformation Leadership and Stakeholder Engagement**
* Act as a change agent by promoting the business value of SAFe, Agile ways of working, DPOM, and product\-oriented delivery.
* Collaborate with leaders, stakeholders, and business partners to build shared understanding of how Agile transformation supports CCFT’s strategic goals and business outcomes.
* Help teams and stakeholders overcome resistance to change by clearly connecting new ways of working to improved delivery, stronger alignment, and better outcomes.
* Build strong partnerships with the Agile Enablement team to scale knowledge sharing, accelerate capability development, and improve organizational Agile maturity.
* Participate in stakeholder and leadership meetings to communicate transformation progress, business impact, risks, recommendations, and improvement opportunities.


**Program Execution and Delivery Accountability**
* Support efficient program execution across CCFT by helping teams improve planning discipline, dependency management, risk management, decision\-making, and delivery accountability.
* Partner with Scrum Masters, RTEs, Product Analysts, Product Managers, and stakeholders to improve team performance and ensure execution remains aligned with business priorities.
* Help teams understand stakeholder needs, decision\-making workflows, business processes, and information requirements to improve delivery relevance and business value.
* Collaborate with geographically dispersed teams, including teams in the United States and international locations, to improve consistency, transparency, and delivery outcomes.
* Ensure Agile delivery practices support product strategy, business objectives, operational excellence, and enterprise priorities.


**Must\-Have Skills**
**Required Functional Skills and Qualifications**
* 12 \-17 years of experience managing, mentoring, and developing Scrum Masters, Release Train Engineers, Product Analysts, or Product Managers.
* Direct hands\-on experience with Agile and product software delivery in roles such as Scrum Master, Release Train Engineer, Product Owner or Product Manager, Agile Coach, or SAFe Practice Consultant.
* Proven experience leading Agile transformations that delivered measurable improvements in delivery performance, team maturity, stakeholder alignment, or business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of SAFe principles, Agile delivery practices, Lean\-Agile mindset, Agile governance, product management, and continuous improvement methods.
* Experience facilitating Agile training, workshops, coaching sessions, transformation planning, and outcome\-based improvement initiatives.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence leaders and teams at all levels.
* Experience collaborating with global and geographically dispersed teams.
* Ability to connect Agile practices with business objectives, product outcomes, stakeholder value, and enterprise priorities.
* Ability to foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, continuous improvement, and measurable value delivery.


**Preferred Experience**
* SAFe Practice Consultant certification or equivalent SAFe leadership experience.
* Experience supporting Agile Release Trains, PI Planning, Inspect and Adapt events, ART execution, and Agile program or portfolio governance.
* Experience building Agile maturity models, value measurement frameworks, metrics dashboards, coaching playbooks, or transformation accelerators.
* Experience driving improvements in time\-to\-market, delivery predictability, quality, stakeholder satisfaction, operational efficiency, or product value realization.


**Leadership Expectations**
 The Agile Transformation Leader is expected to be a business\-focused delivery leader who helps CCFT improve how it delivers strategic value. This role requires strong people leadership, business acumen, transformation execution, stakeholder influence, and the ability to connect Agile practices to measurable outcomes.
   

  

 The successful candidate will model Lean\-Agile behaviors, promote transparency, strengthen accountability, and help teams continuously improve how they plan, prioritize, deliver, measure, and realize business value.
