title: Manager - Engineering
description:
**About ScienceLogic…**
 ScienceLogic is redefining IT operations for the modern enterprise. Our AIOps platform empowers organizations to achieve Autonomic IT — where systems are self\-healing, self\-optimizing, and seamlessly aligned with business outcomes. We help enterprises and service providers gain unified visibility across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments, automate workflows, and unlock performance at scale.
   

  

 We’re accelerating digital transformation through the power of automation, AI, and analytics — giving IT and business leaders the tools to deliver superior customer experiences, drive efficiency, and innovate with confidence.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For…**
 ScienceLogic is hiring an Engineering Manager for our PowerPack team based in our Hyderabad office. This role will manage a team of approximately 20 software engineers and SDETs responsible for the development, quality, and ongoing evolution of the PowerPack portfolio. You will report to the Director of Product Engineering (India) and will be a member of the India engineering leadership team. This is a people\-first leadership role with meaningful technical responsibility. We are looking for an experienced engineering leader who can build trust, develop future leaders, drive execution, and thoughtfully apply AI\-enabled practices to improve engineering outcomes.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing…**
 You’ll lead a team of approximately 20 engineers comprised of full\-time employees and, covering responsibilities across:
   

  

**People \& Growth**
* Conduct regular 1:1s with team members, providing coaching, feedback, and career development support.
* Hiring: run screening and calibration with recruiting partners, and own onboarding for new hires.
* Management of Contractors performance monitoring and support through contractor\-to\-FTE conversion process.
* Performance management and career development conversations that go beyond the annual review.
* Team health across the org: morale and psychological safety, not just velocity metrics.
* Conflict resolution and mediation to keep the team cohesive under pressure.


**Delivery \& Execution**
* Weekly alignment with your Product Owner on priorities, roadmap, and backlog, and with the leads you're developing as they take on more scope.
* Sprint execution accountability across both working groups, including capacity planning.
* Handling major or complex escalations, including regular syncs to work through what's outstanding.
* Tracking delivery metrics (velocity, uptime, bug counts, deployment frequency) and reporting progress, risk, and dependencies to stakeholders.


**Technical Leadership**
* Architecture and design review for pull requests, ensuring sound technical decisions across the team's work.
* Promoting engineering best practices: testing, code review, documentation, and CI/CD.
* Sponsoring and helping lead cross\-team technical initiatives, such as major platform migrations and release\-process automation.
* Running demo sessions and hands\-on skill\-building with the team on key technical areas.


**AI\-Enabled Engineering**
* Identify where AI creates real leverage in your team's engineering workflows, and act on it yourself, not just approve it from a distance.
* Work alongside engineers to design and deliver AI\-enabled solutions to real product and delivery problems.
* Build your team's capability to use AI as a working tool, including hands\-on training for engineers who are still building that muscle.


**Org Design**
* Today, the org runs flat: you manage all 20 engineers directly, organized across two informally\-led working groups.
* A key responsibility of this role is to identify and develop emerging leaders, establish a Team Lead layer, and evolve the organization into a more scalable team structure over time.


**Qualities you possess…**
* Experience:
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline
* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 3\-5 years leading engineering teams.
* Proven track record of delivering high\-impact software products, with the willingness to roll up your sleeves and work directly with engineers when needed.
* Experience managing engineering teams of this size directly, and a track record of developing individual engineers into first\-line leaders, even where that title doesn't formally exist yet.
* Self\-starter with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
* Technical Competence:
* Strong understanding of modern software architecture and distributed systems.
* Proficiency in Python and REST APIs, with familiarity across other technology stacks.
* Proficiency in database technologies and event\-driven architecture.
* Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), CI/CD, and testing methodologies.
* Hands\-on, personal experience building or shipping at least one AI\-enabled feature: you were in the technical problem, contributing to design and trade\-offs, not sponsoring or approving someone else's work.
* Leadership \& Management:
* Exceptional leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills, with a visible track record of developing engineers with diverse experience levels and career aspirations.
* Demonstrated ability to build, motivate, and retain high\-performing engineering teams, with strong delivery instincts across sprint accountability, capacity planning, and cross\-team coordination.
* Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills with engineers, peers, and senior leadership.


**As a plus, you have...**
* Experience in a GCC, IDC, or other geographically distributed engineering environment.
* Product engineering background: ownership of outcomes, not just delivery of tasks.
* Familiarity with AIOps, monitoring, observability, or enterprise SaaS domains.
* Engineering background with hands\-on depth in Python, REST APIs, or cloud\-native development, enough that you're credible in architecture and design conversations, even though you won't be writing production code day to day in this role.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum at scale, where ceremonies drive outcomes rather than checkbox rituals.
* Familiarity with JavaScript and frameworks like React.
* Exposure towards Spec Driven Development(AI\-DLC) and or TDD


*Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At ScienceLogic, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which you are applying.*
**About ScienceLogic**
 ScienceLogic is a leader in IT Operations Management, providing modern IT operations with actionable insights to resolve and predict problems faster in a digital, ephemeral world. Its solution sees everything across cloud and distributed architectures, contextualizes data through relationship mapping, and acts on this insight through integration and automation.
   

  

 www.sciencelogic.com

title: Lead Test Engineer
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
   

  

 Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
   

  

 The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high\-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**
* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well\-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).


**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
 Being a member of testing team under IT Enterprise Architecture Data and Corporate Technology department, the Enterprise Test Engineering ("ETE") family is responsible for ensuring that all applications and systems meet defined quality standards. The ETE family encompasses three major areas including (a) functional testing, (b) non\-functional testing, and (c) test architecture and enablement. Other key focuses include: regression testing, browser testing, performance testing, capacity and stress testing, resiliency testing, environment management services, and infrastructure testing. Develops, conducts, and evaluates testing processes, working closely with developers to remediate identified system defects. In\-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches including the creation of reusable foundational test automation framework for the entire organization. The Test Engineering role is responsible for ensuring that all applications, system products, projects, and solutions meet defined enterprise quality standards. Provide centralized, independent quality assurance services across the firm, including functional and non\-functional testing for all products, services, and applications across businesses. Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions, providing testing expertise, oversight, and direction to ensure the functionality of solutions and that design specifications are met.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities**
* Responsible for system integration testing, including automation, of newly developed or enhanced applications.
* Play an active role in translating business and functional requirements into concrete results.
* Lead, develop, and advise on test automation strategies and provide critical feedback in requirements, design, implementation and execution phases.
* Partner with collaborators \- Product Management, Application Development, DevOps and other technical teams.
* Track test execution milestones and report on issues and risks with the potential to affect project timelines.
* Construct appropriate end\-2\-end business scenarios through the application of a broad understanding of business objectives and goals.
* Responsible for Delivery Pipeline adoption
* Identify dependencies for environmental and data requirements.
* Contribute to standard framework of reusable functions.
* Develop a thorough understanding of the product(s) being delivered.
* Responsible for process compliance \& associated documentation
* Aligns risk and control processes into day\-to\-day responsibilities to supervise and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately.
* Works closely with business and application development domain experts, to continually improve depth and breadth of knowledge for assigned applications/systems.
* Responsible for Project Coordination and Technical Management tasks.


 \*\*NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. \*\*
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Minimum 6 years of related experience in delivering software solutions with hands on automated testing.
* Bachelor's degree preferred and/or equivalent experience.


**Talents Needed For Success**
* Experience in Agile/Waterfall, onsite/offshore work model and coordination.
* In depth knowledge of the software implementation lifecycle (specifically the testing model, methodology, and processes).
* Experience with Test Engineering methodologies and Test Automation Frameworks
* Proficient in automation at all software layers (e.g. UI, services, APIs, etc.) as well as CI/CD technologies (e.g. Cloudbees, Jenkins, Cucumber, Git, JUnit, Jira, etc.).
* Sophisticated Java / Selenium development skills with significant experience applying those skills in test environments.
* Track test execution milestones, report on issues and risks with the potential to affect project timelines.
* Extensive experience with testing modern scripting language\-based components.
* Proven expertise in frontend test automation using Selenium Webdriver.
* Expert and hands on with backend test automation for API testing (e.g. Rest Assured, Karate, Postman) and database testing (e.g. Oracle/ DB2/ Snowflake).
* Experience in writing sophisticated SQL queries.
* Experience with JIRA, ALM, Bitbucket, Git, and Jenkins.
* Requires the ability to work with both business clients and technical team and the ability to work independently, both individually and as part of a team.
* Experience in mentoring junior test engineers, verifying work products and providing mentorship, as needed.
* Unix, Python and AWS experience in a plus.
* Accountable for process compliance \& associated documentation
* Aligns risk and control processes into day\-to\-day responsibilities to supervise and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately.
* Excellent problem\-solving, collaboration, and written and verbal communication skills.

title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
**About StarRez**
 StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off\-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400\+ clients across 25\+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user\-friendly, all\-in\-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.
   

  

**Role:**
 As a Senior Quality Engineer \- you will play a pivotal role in elevating our quality practices across StarRez communication, Marketplace, System Administration and Maintenance systems. You will be an expert within our product engineering organization, deeply understanding user and product behaviour, customer journeys, business rules, and the systems that support StarRez personas. This role will balance hands\-on individual contributor responsibilities with leading, influencing, and coaching your peers.
   

  

 This individual contributor role is for someone who is passionate about seeing systems holistically, has a strong vision for product quality, and is eager to drive the highest standards of customer experience, functional correctness, usability, accessibility, reliability, performance, and release confidence. You will leverage your deep understanding of SaaS product behaviour, end\-to\-end workflows, integrations, environments, and customer operations to guide and influence our development process.
   

  

 Your role is not to manage a team, but to be a quality champion who partners directly with developers, product managers, designers, support, implementation, and customer\-facing teams. You will help teams anticipate risk, clarify expected behaviour, validate business logic, protect the customer experience, and build more robust, scalable, and reliable conference and event products. At the core of this role is a strong focus on the customer experience; success means our platform behaves predictably, is easy to use, and enables our resident communities to thrive.
   

  

**What You Will Own:**
* Own and drive end\-to\-end quality for the StarRez Foundations product team.
* Champion StarRez's quality standards by establishing, maintaining, and advocating for quality gates and rapid feedback loops throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
* Design and execute testing, validation and risk mitigation strategies for feature related initiatives.
* Partner with Product, Design and Engineering from ideation through delivery to ensure acceptance criteria, personas, customer journeys, test data, edge cases, non\-functional expectations, and quality gates reflect real customer operations and the intended product experience.
* Champion shift\-left quality culture by mentoring developers, product managers, and design partners on testing principles, behavioural specifications, clear acceptance criteria, early validation, fast feedback loops, and production\-quality observability.
* Work effectively with ambiguity, proactively designing quality solutions based on evidence when clear requirements, behaviour definitions, customer workflow expectations, or quality baselines do not yet exist.
* Champion test automation best practices, create clear testing standards, and coach engineers to take shared ownership of building and maintaining automated tests.
* Apply AI tools and techniques to improve product quality and enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of quality engineering practices and processes.
* Own production defect triage for your product domain, partnering with Engineering, Product, and Support to assess impact, prioritise fixes, identify root causes, and drive preventative quality improvements.


**Required Qualifications:**
* 5\+ years of progressive software engineering or quality engineering with deep focus on quality in complex, distributed systems environments
* SQL. Required for test data setup, backend validation, data integrity checks across integrations, and root cause analysis.
* Tech stack context (.NET/C\#, SQL Server, Azure).
* API testing tooling (Postman, REST Assured, or similar).
* Cloud platform exposure (Azure/AWS).
* Proven track record advocating for quality and ability to influence technical direction through innovative, pragmatic, and evidence\-based approaches.
* Hands\-on experience working with web\-based products, including front\-end behaviour, API, service integration and functional end\-to\-end testing.
* Experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
* Practical experience integrating automated tests and quality checks into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub, Build\-kite, or similar platforms.
* Experience contributing to deployment and release quality gates, including test suite selection, environment readiness checks.
* Genuine curiosity and passion for understanding product architecture, user experience flows, customer workflows, analytics use cases, and the business impact of engineering and data decisions.
* Experience utilising AI in modern software development.


**Reasons to join our team:**
* Opportunity to be a part of a well\-established, high\-performance company that has been in business for over 30\+ years
* Full benefits including health care, paid time off, and others
* A supportive team environment with emphasis on learning and development opportunities
* Our Promise: You will learn, grow, and be appreciated for your impact and contributions.
* Z\-Factor: Our most celebrated value, you will work with a team of caring, high\-performing, and passionate people who have fun supporting our vision, innovation, and continuous improvement.


 Even if you don't have all of the Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!
   

  

 StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

title: DE-ET-Deployment Engineer Senior-GDS
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Position: Forward Deployed Engineer – Digital Engineering (Senior)**
 EY Consulting Digital Engineering is seeking highly skilled and customer focused Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) to operate at the frontlines of enterprise transformation. This role sits at the intersection of product engineering, platform architecture, AI\-led solutioning, and client value realization, requiring deep hands\-on technical expertise combined with strong consulting acumen.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As an FDE in Digital Engineering, you will work directly with clients to co\-create, engineer, and scale AI\-first digital solutions that accelerate business outcomes. You will play a critical role in translating business problems into PDLC\-driven solutions, rapidly moving from POCs to enterprise\-grade platforms, and embedding GenAI, data, and cloud\-native engineering into core business workflows.
   

  

 You will be instrumental in driving future\-ready digital engineering capabilities across product engineering, platform modernization, and AI\-enabled transformation programs.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Customer Engagement \& Solution Delivery
   

  

* Partner with clients to shape business problems into solution hypotheses aligned to PDLC (Product Delivery Lifecycle).
* Drive co\-creation workshops, rapid prototyping, and outcome\-led solution design.
* Translate ambiguous requirements into architecture, data flows, and scalable engineering constructs.
* Deliver end\-to\-end solutions spanning discovery, POC, MVP, and enterprise\-scale rollout.
* Anchor business value realization (cycle time reduction, cost efficiency, productivity gains) as part of delivery.


**Engineering \& Development**
* Build AI\-first, cloud\-native applications and platforms using modern engineering practices.
* Develop accelerators, reusable components, and engineering patterns for repeatable delivery.
* Work across APIs, microservices, event\-driven systems, and composable architectures.
* Integrate GenAI copilots, agents, and automation into enterprise workflows.
* Drive engineering excellence (performance, scalability, resilience, security).


 Emerging Technology Enablement
   

  

* Apply and scale cutting\-edge capabilities across:
+ Generative AI \& Agentic AI (LLMs, copilots, multi\-agent systems)
+ Data platforms \& real\-time intelligence
+ Cloud\-native \& platform engineering (Azure/AWS/GCP)
+ Automation \& intelligent workflows

* Evaluate, incubate, and industrialize new tools, frameworks, and accelerators within DE.
* Contribute to future readiness initiatives (e.g., advanced compute paradigms, next\-gen architectures).


**Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as a bridge between business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering teams.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional squads (architects, data scientists, designers, and product teams).
* Provide technical leadership in FDE engagements, influencing architecture and delivery direction.
* Present value articulation, solution architecture, and outcomes to CXO and senior stakeholders.


**Deployment \& Support**
* Lead CI/CD, DevSecOps, and production rollout strategies.
* Ensure seamless transition from POC to scaled deployment across environments.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues in client environments.
* Drive continuous optimization using telemetry, feedback, and usage insights.


**Soft Skills**
* Consulting excellence: Strong client engagement and storytelling skills with ability to influence senior stakeholders.
* Outcome orientation: Focus on measurable business impact, not just technical output.
* Architectural mindset: Ability to design modular, composable, scalable digital platforms.
* Bias for action: Thrive in ambiguity with a build\-first, iterate\-fast mindset.
* Leadership: Ability to guide teams, mentor engineers, and own delivery outcomes.


**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in digital/product engineering, solution architecture, or FDE/customer\-facing engineering roles.
* Strong programming expertise (Python, Java, JavaScript, Go or similar).
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* Experience in distributed systems, APIs, microservices, and event\-driven architectures.
* Strong exposure to data engineering, pipelines, and modern data platforms.
* Proven experience in client\-facing engagements or consulting\-driven delivery models.


**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**
* Experience working in AI\-led engineering / GenAI use cases / intelligent automation
* Exposure to PDLC, product\-centric delivery models, or platform engineering
* Experience building POCs and scaling them to enterprise\-grade solutions
* Strong problem\-solving and structured thinking approach
* High adaptability in fast\-paced, multi\-stakeholder environments
* Strong ownership and accountability mindset


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY Digital Engineering, you will operate in a high\-impact, front\-line engineering model, solving real\-world business problems using AI, data, and platform engineering at scale.
   

  

 You will:
   

  

* Work on transformative FDE engagements with global clients
* Build industry\-leading AI\-led digital solutions
* Be part of next\-gen engineering transformation (GenAI, agentic systems, platformization)
* Gain access to continuous learning, innovation programs, and leadership opportunities


**EY Offers**
* A collaborative environment with global engineering talent and leadership
* Opportunities to drive end\-to\-end AI\-led transformation programs
* Flexible work culture with strong focus on innovation and growth


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Newgen ONE / IBPS Implementation Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
 At Verisk, we are seeking an experienced and self\-driven Newgen ONE Implementation Specialist to independently deliver end\-to\-end implementations of the Newgen ONE platform. This expert\-level role is ideal for someone with deep knowledge of Newgen ONE and IBPS, strong Java development skills, and experience across the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), from architecture to deployment.
   

  

 You will be responsible for the complete technical lifecycle of implementation projects—from requirements gathering to solution delivery. This includes workflow automation, web service integration, Okta configuration, and deployment automation using CI/CD. The ideal candidate thrives in an independent role with minimal supervision, confidently managing complex technical workstreams.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Independently execute full lifecycle Newgen ONE implementations from the ground up, ensuring on\-time, high\-quality delivery.
* Lead all aspects of project architecture including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Configure and customize Newgen ONE workflows, forms, ECM, and case management modules at an expert level.
* Integrate Newgen ONE with third\-party systems using RESTful web services and Java.

**Qualifications**
* 8\-12\+ years of overall IT experience.
* 5\-7 years of hands\-on experience with the Newgen IBPS platform.
* 2\-3 years of independent implementation experience with Newgen ONE projects.
* Deep understanding of Newgen ONE APIs for workflows, DMS, queue management, and forms.
* Strong expertise in OmniDocs advanced features, including versioning and document workflows.
* Proficiency in Java and RESTful web service integration.
* Experience with Jenkins build pipelines and Newgen Deployment Manager.

**Job Description**

**Senior Technical Project Manager \- Supply Digital Technology**

**Job Purpose / Overview**


This role exists to provide senior technical project management leadership for the Food \& Nutrition Supply Digital Technology portfolio, ensuring critical Supply DT initiatives are delivered with quality, pace, strong governance and clear business value.


The role will drive the delivery of digital and technology projects across key Supply capabilities, including Thema / Supply Data Foundations, Planning capabilities such as Blue Yonder, and Smart Manufacturing / Industry 4\.0 solutions.


The Senior Technical Project Manager will coordinate business, DT, data, architecture, security, vendor and delivery teams to move initiatives from concept through design, build, testing, deployment, transition and benefit realization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of Supply Digital Technology projects across Food \& Nutrition, covering data foundations, planning, manufacturing and analytics capabilities.
* Manage project delivery across the full lifecycle, including demand shaping, business case support, concept and initiation, design, build, test, deployment, hypercare, project closure and transition to support.
* Drive delivery of Supply DT initiatives such as Thema / Supply Data Foundations, Blue Yonder planning enhancements, and Smart Manufacturing / Industry 4\.0 capabilities, ensuring each initiative has clear scope, milestones, dependencies, risks and success measures.
* Coordinate internal teams, third\-party vendors, system integrators, data partners and business stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within agreed budget and to expected quality standards.
* Build and maintain integrated project plans, RAID logs, dependency maps, governance materials, financial tracking and status reporting for senior DT and business stakeholders.
* Translate business objectives and Supply pain points into actionable delivery plans, working closely with Supply leaders, Business Partners, Product Owners, Data teams, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, GDO and functional SMEs.
* Ensure technical delivery activities are aligned with architecture, cybersecurity, data governance, integration, service introduction and operational support standards.
* Partner with Supply business stakeholders to support business readiness, UAT planning, deployment preparation, adoption tracking and post\-go\-live stabilization.
* Manage delivery risks and issues proactively, escalating where required and driving clear decisions through appropriate governance forums.
* Support vendor and partner management, including input to Statements of Work, delivery plans, resource models, deliverable acceptance and performance management.
* Ensure project documentation is complete, controlled and suitable for transition to support teams, including business process documentation, technical design artefacts, testing evidence, cutover plans and operational handover materials.
* Work with Finance and PMO stakeholders to support budget planning, capitalization requirements, cost tracking, forecast updates and benefits realization.
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery ways of working, including stronger use of PMX, agile/hybrid delivery methods, lessons learned, reusable templates and project governance discipline.
* Build strong relationships across global and regional Supply teams to ensure delivery plans reflect business priorities, local deployment realities and global template requirements.
* Act as a senior delivery leader within the Supply DT team, providing coaching, structure and delivery discipline to project teams, vendors and junior project resources where required

 **Context and Scope**

  

The role operates within the Food \& Nutrition Supply Digital Technology team, partnering closely with Supply business leaders, regional business partners, functional SMEs, DT delivery teams, Data \& AI, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, GDO, Finance, PMO and external vendors.


The portfolio includes initiatives that enable Supply Chain visibility, planning effectiveness, data\-driven decision making, factory performance improvement and digital adoption across Food \& Nutrition. These include data and analytics foundations through Thema, planning capabilities involving Blue Yonder, and Smart Manufacturing capabilities such as connected worker, factory data, operational visibility and predictive insights.


The role must balance strategic ambition with practical delivery constraints, ensuring projects are planned realistically, governed effectively and delivered in a way that creates sustainable business value. The role will work across regions and functions, often influencing without direct authority and managing delivery through a combination of internal resources, vendors, contractors and cross\-functional teams.


The Senior Technical Project Manager will be expected to operate comfortably with senior stakeholders, manage ambiguity, resolve delivery blockers, and bring structure to complex initiatives that span process, data, technology, integration and change

 **Job Specifications / Qualifications**

**Education \& Professional Qualifications**

title: Product Intern
description:
**Title :** 
 Product Intern
   

  

**Location :** 
 Mumbai
   

  

**Internship Duration:** 
 6 Months
   

  

**Work arrangement:** 
 5 days in the office
   

  

**About Upstox**
 At Upstox, we’re building the future of investing simple, powerful, and for everyone. We’re one of India’s fastest\-growing fintech platforms, backed by the best in the business, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global, and on a mission to make wealth creation accessible to every Indian. From first\-time investors to seasoned traders, millions trust us to power their financial journeys. We’re not just moving fast, we're moving with purpose. If you thrive in a high\-energy, high\-impact environment, you’re in the right place.
   

  

 The Role: Product Intern
   

  

 You’ll join the Product team and work closely with Product Managers on building and improving products across the investing journey, with a focus on the Mutual Funds and Advisory space.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on product \+ data role where you’ll work across product requirements, analytics, customer behaviour, competitive intelligence, and execution. You’ll use SQL and product analytics tools to understand how users interact with our products, identify opportunities, and turn data into actionable insights.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Analytics, and other stakeholders to turn ideas and insights into products that customers can use. You won’t just look at the numbers you’ll help understand what they mean for the product and what we should do next.
   

  

 What You’ll Own
   

  

* Write and refine PRDs and help drive features from idea to launch — defining requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and keeping documentation updated as features evolve.
* Work with the product backlog — help groom, prioritise, and organise requirements so the team stays focused on what matters.
* Own product analytics — build and analyse dashboards, funnels, and key product metrics to understand user behaviour and feature performance.
* Use SQL to answer product questions — write basic queries using filters, joins, and aggregations to retrieve and analyse data without always depending on the data team.
* Analyse user behaviour through tools such as Mixpanel or Amplitude — build funnels, retention reports, and cohorts and understand what the numbers mean for the product.
* Turn data into insights — identify trends, drop\-offs, and opportunities and translate them into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Run competitive intelligence across investing, wealth\-tech, and broader fintech platforms. Track product launches, UX changes, features, and pricing.
* Conduct structured product teardowns of competitor products and customer journeys to understand gaps and identify opportunities relevant to our roadmap.
* Research the investing ecosystem and understand customer needs, market trends, product offerings, and user behaviour.
* Work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Analytics, and other stakeholders to translate product requirements and insights into execution.
* Roll up your sleeves on the groundwork: research, SQL analysis, documentation, dashboarding, testing, competitive analysis, and the detailed work that turns product questions into real improvements.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* Strong analytical thinking. You enjoy working with numbers, breaking down problems, and finding meaningful patterns in data.
* Comfortable with SQL. You can write basic queries using SELECT, filters, joins, and aggregations to retrieve and analyse data. Deep SQL expertise is not required.
* Sharp product sense and genuine curiosity about how users interact with financial products.
* Strong ownership. You take a problem and run with it end to end, without needing constant hand\-holding.
* A figure\-it\-out instinct. When you don’t know something, you find the answer yourself instead of waiting to be told.
* Genuine interest in fintech, investing, or financial products is a strong plus.
* Strong written communication. You can take a messy problem or a set of data and turn it into a clear, structured insight.
* High comfort with ambiguity and a strong bias for action.


 Why This Role Rocks
   

  

 You’ll be part of a fast\-moving
 **Product team** 
 , working on real product problems across the investing journey, with exposure to the
 **Mutual Funds and Advisory** 
 space.
   

  

 You’ll get hands\-on exposure to
 **product management, SQL, product analytics, customer behaviour, competitive intelligence, and data\-driven decision\-making** 
 while working on real problems and seeing how your insights translate into product improvements.
   

  

 You’ll learn how to connect
 **data → insights → product decisions** 
 and get direct exposure to the full product lifecycle in a fast\-moving fintech environment.
   

  

 By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our
 **Prospective Employee Privacy Notice** 
 , which outlines how Upstox collects, uses, and protects your Personal Information ("PI").

**About Business Line/Function**

These IT systems range from industry standard products for standard process automation to internally developed, often, market leading IT applications. The IT teams owning these IT systems are made up of functions that include Technical and Application production support, Business Analysis \& Project Management, Development \& Maintenance and Quality Control. BNP Paribas India Solutions is the key partner in all IT functions and has interactions with colleagues in other locations including Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Singapore \& Hong Kong. This partnership ranges from sharing the IT workload, executing global strategy to owning global applications offshore. The technology and engineering landscape is wide, encompassing almost all techniques and platforms. It continues to evolve and transform with the market with the business continuing to invest in it. To ensure our efficiency and alignment with the market expectations, we have to ensure that both our architecture and our technologies are up to date and aligned with the most efficient and reliable standards.
   

  

**Position Purpose**
 The Reconciliation Java Technical Lead will lead the transformation of the CEFS Recon platform into a technically robust, cloud‑native platform. The position is vital for shaping up the technical vision, strategy and execution of the Recon initiatives. The role is expected to define the Java micro‑service landscape, streaming pipelines, persistence strategy, CI/CD and cloud‑deployment model (Kubernetes/Docker), guaranteeing high availability, scalability, performance and security. Keep the platform reliable, future ready and aligned with client service standards.
   

  

 The position has a strong focus on stability, flexibility, and expertise to always guarantee the proper Clients’ expectations. Working in an international Clients base environment but also as part of an Offshore organization, the capacity to interact in a respectful and easy way with both his/her Clients, Management, and team to find compromises while guaranteeing the proper organization and seamless relations is a must.
   

  

 This position requires strong leadership, communication, and adaptability to navigate the complexities of working in a globally distributed environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

* Ensure system reliability, scalability, stability and security by implementing appropriate design patterns and architectural principles.
* Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and recommend enhancements to optimize performance.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices to drive innovation.
* Design the Java micro‑service landscape, CI/CD pipeline, container‑orchestration (Kubernetes/Docker) and infrastructure\-as\-code, and monitoring tools.
* Establish security‑by‑design patterns and embed them in all solutions.
* Ensure that all solutions are well\-documented and align with industry’s best practices.
* Own API and message‑schema contracts for all inbound/outbound feeds, manage versioning and backward compatibility.
* Define data‑lineage, master‑data‑management and data‑quality controls required for auditability
* Conduct architectural and code reviews, apply security controls, enforce best practices, and mentor junior engineers – all in line with the organization’s architectural standards.
* Champion DevOps automation (shift‑left testing, shift‑right monitoring) and drive an “automation‑first” mindset to reduce manual hand‑offs.
* Produce and maintain architectural documentation, user manuals, SOPs and materials.


 Contributing Responsibilities
   

  

* Proficiency in business analysis tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, MS Visio)
* Familiarity with software development methodologies
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives: DevSecOps adoption, automated contract testing, observability
* Quick to learn and adapt
* Strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.
* Good Team player
* Someone who could have long\-term commitment with the team and organization


**Specific Qualifications**
* 8\-10 years total experience, minimum 5 years in the Banking/Financial Reconciliation domain and 5 years in Java architecture roles.
* A proven experience in multi\-expertise team management in an international environment,
* An experience in an Onshore/Offshore would be a key factor,
* A very good English level is mandatory,


 Qualification
   

  

 :
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business or a related field; Master’s degree or certifications such as TOGAF are a plus.
   

  

**Skills Referential (Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities)**
 Technical \& Soft Skills:
   

  

* Strong expertise in Java, microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and event\-driven architecture
* Hands on experience in software development using Java/J2EE technologies, frameworks (e.g. Spring, Hibernate), messaging (e.g. MQ)
* Deep understanding of software design patterns, principles, and best practices.
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms and cloud\-native architectures.
* Expertise in designing and developing RESTful APIs and integrating with external systems.
* Proficiency in working with databases: SQL (Oracle, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB).
* Hands\-on experience with containerization tools like Docker and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
* Experience with DevOps tools and practices, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code, and monitoring tools.
* Knowledge of security principles and best practices for securing applications and data.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills with a focus on performance optimization.
* Capacity to structure, synthesize and summarize concepts,
* Resilience in a strong pressure environment,
* Strong track record in successful interactions with peers in a non\-hierarchical framework.


**Behavioral Skills**
* Proven ability to lead and mentor technical teams across multiple projects.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Excellent analytical and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to balance technical requirements with business needs.
* Self\-motivated with a proactive approach to identifying and solving challenges.
* Organized and delivery\-focused, with attention to detail.
* Solid work ethic, high level of motivation and resilience.
* Comfortable operating with a strong level of autonomy, self\-driven
* Showing strong leadership and assertiveness
* Strong empathy and people care.
* Coaching \& mentoring techniques
* Strong communication and reporting skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and negotiation skills.
* Capacity to interact with senior members of the organization.

description:
**About the Role and Team:**
 The Team Lead, UX Design is responsible for leading a small team of UX Designers while actively contributing to product design delivery. This role ensures that high\-quality, user\-centered design solutions are delivered across assigned product areas, while continuously improving design practices, team capabilities, and collaboration with cross\-functional stakeholders. In addition to hands\-on design responsibilities, this role focuses on developing team members, fostering a high\-performance culture, and ensuring alignment between UX design activities, product goals, and business objectives.
   

  

**We hope you are ready to change the game! Be ready to:**
* Team Leadership and Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of UX Designers by setting clear expectations, providing continuous feedback, and supporting professional growth. Foster a collaborative, high\-performance culture with strong ownership and accountability.
* UX Design Delivery: Contribute to and lead the design thinking cycle by proactively identifying user problems and opportunities and delivering UX design solutions across all phases of the Product Development Process (discovery, scope analysis, development, and validation).
* Design Quality and Consistency: Ensure high standards of UX design quality across the team by applying and evolving the UX design framework, design system, and best practices. Promote consistency and scalability of design solutions. Designs are web / desktop focused.
* Work Planning and Prioritization: Plan and prioritize UX design activities across the team, ensuring alignment with Product Development Process phases, product priorities, and delivery timelines to maximize impact.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with Product Management, UX Research, UX Writing, Engineering, and stakeholders, providing UX design consultations during product definition and scope analysis, and acting as a subject matter expert within product domain teams.
* User\-Centered Design Advocacy: Advocate for user\-centered design principles by proactively identifying user needs and ensuring that design decisions are guided by user insights, while acting as a trusted UX expert in balancing user, business, and technical perspectives.
* Process Improvement and Best Practices: Contribute to the evolution of UX ways of working, frameworks, and internal processes. Identify improvement opportunities and help scale successful practices across teams.
* Recruitment and Talent Growth: Support recruitment, onboarding, and retention of UX Designers. Participate in hiring processes and contribute to building a strong design organization.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Ensure alignment between UX design outcomes and broader product and business objectives. Communicate design decisions clearly and influence stakeholders effectively.


**Attitude First. Everything else will follow. We can grow together faster if you have:**
* Strong experience in UX / product design with a proven track record of delivering user\-centered solutions for complex digital products.
* 7\+ years of experience in UX design or related disciplines, with demonstrable impact on product quality and user experience.
* 4\+ years of experience in leading, mentoring, or managing UX Designers or similar roles.
* Experience balancing people leadership responsibilities with hands\-on design execution.
* Strong knowledge of UX methodologies, interaction design, and design systems.
* Experience working in cross\-functional environments with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders.
* Experience applying AI\-supported tools to accelerate UX design workflows across the Product Development Process, including discovery, scope definition, prototyping, validation, and release phases
* Ability to structure and prioritize design work in alignment with product and business goals.
* Ability to make and own UX design decisions, balancing user needs, business objectives, and technical constraints
* Ability to take ownership of UX design outcomes within assigned domains and ensure successful delivery across the Product Development Process
* Ability to plan, prioritize, and structure UX design work across multiple scopes in alignment with product priorities
* Strong understanding of the how UX design contributes across all phases of product development process (discovery, scope definition, development, validation, release)
* Ability to mentor and develop UX Designers by setting expectations, providing structured feedback, and scaling design quality across the team
* Strong ability to frame user problems and translate them into actionable design opportunities
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a structured, detail\-oriented approach to design challenges.
* Experience with modern design tools such as Figma or similar at least 2 years.
* Experience working with distributed and cross\-cultural teams is an advantage.

description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well\-being.
   

  

 Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi\-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
   

  

 Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The CFOC (CFO Change) team, which is part of the COO \& Governance organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The CFO Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 7 to 10 years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)


**Desired Skills**
* Exposure to projects in Financial Accounting and reporting (in Financial Control / Product Control/Treasury), and/or in Risk Regulatory reporting (Market or Counterparty risk) in financial services industry

title: Lead D&T Analyst – AI & Automation
description:
**Company Overview**
 We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Digital and Technology (D\&T) India, is seeking a Lead Analyst, to join the AI and Automation team. The AIA Activation team serves as the bridge between identifying AI use cases to enabling value through business adoption. The AI \& Automation team is seeking a Lead AIA Analyst to shepherd General Mills’ AI journey into agent\-based (agentic) capabilities — planning, delivering, and governing our enterprise AI platforms, custom AI agents, and the processes that support them. This highly visible role will partner with business and D\&T stakeholders to identify and execute high‑value AI use cases, then create, manage, and sustain the expansion of generative and agent\-based capabilities across the enterprise, working closely with other D\&T AI initiatives to shape the overall AI user experience
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Partner with functional domain stakeholders to identify, assess, and prioritize high\-value AI and agentic AI use cases.
* Lead discovery and opportunity assessment efforts to determine where AI can improve decision\-making, process efficiency, service levels, productivity, and user experience.
* Translate business problems into clear analytical, technical, and delivery requirements for AI solutions, agents, and supporting workflows.
* Lead planning and implementation of AI and automation initiatives, including pilots, proofs of value, and scaled deployments.
* Collaborate with business teams, product teams, data scientists, engineers, and platform partners to design and deliver Supply Chain AI capabilities.
* Support development of domain\-specific agents and workflows that augment functional domain processes and enable better human decision\-making.
* Evaluate existing functional domain processes, data, and pain points to determine where agentic AI can be responsibly and effectively applied.
* Facilitate workshops and working sessions with stakeholders to educate teams on AI possibilities, assess readiness, and define business value.
* Help establish and sustain governance processes for functional domain AI use cases, including risk management, user acceptance, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure activation work follows established responsible AI, governance, risk, and documentation practices in partnership with the relevant teams.
* Contribute to development of best practices, playbooks, enablement assets, KPIs, and operating processes that strengthen activation capabilities across the Agentic AI office.
* Translate the learnings from the engagement to reusable consumable form for other areas to benefit from it.
* Support the intake, build, publish of the agents are in accordance to the defined frameworks by the AI Office.
* Monitor solution performance, user feedback, and business outcomes, then make recommendations for optimization and broader adoption.
* Analyze, present, and report on key performance indicators, value realization, and overall initiative progress to business and D\&T leaders.
* Partner to evaluate the technological releases including platform, services, models etc. within the Agentic AI space and document the recommendations.
* Work closely with the vendor partners as required to influence the prioritization of required features / fixes.
* Monitor feedback and insights, collaborating with Agent Authors to assess program effectiveness and make recommendations for optimization and improvement.
* Manage the agent publishing lifecycle, including user acceptance testing and acting as the first line of triage for agents.
* Monitor adoption, usage, performance, and user feedback for deployed capabilities, and help drive iterations that improve business impact and user experience over time.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, practical learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's in technology /engineering/science in a related field is required.
* Minimum years of related experience required: 2\+ years in AI, analytics, automation, digital product activation, data science, or related technical delivery roles, including experience leading projects or small teams.
* Overall industry experience: 10\+ years preferred Total analytics experience required 5\-6 Years.
* Experience activating AI, automation, analytics, or digital capabilities from pilot or proof of concept into business adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with stakeholders to define business problems, translate needs into delivery plans, and drive measurable outcomes.
* Strong communication and storytelling skills with the ability to explain AI concepts, rollout implications, and recommendations to non\-technical audiences.
* Working knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI practices, documentation expectations, and production monitoring disciplines.
* Ability to operate effectively in an environment with global partners and cross\-functional D\&T teams.
* Technical Skillset \- AI / Automation Activation, Adoption \& Change Management, Use Case Framing / Business Translation, KPI Tracking / Value Realization.
* Responsible for AI, Security, Governance, Process Design, Workflow Mapping, Visualization / Storytelling, Agile Delivery / Backlog Management, Data Intuition, Analytics, Cloud Platform literacy.
* Strong understanding of AI and automation activation in at least one business or functional domain.
* Aware of adjacent DNA capabilities and knows when to engage experts from other domains.
* Creates stories and translates needs into executable work.
* Helps manage team backlog and delivery priorities.
* Supports creation and management of feature or activation roadmaps with manager guidance.
* Demonstrates learning agility and applies new ideas to improve work.
* Adopts and scales practical innovations that improve AI activation and business adoption.
* Contributes to playbooks, standards, and ways of working across the activation community.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Preferred Major Area of Study: Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
* Experience with GenAI and LLM\-enabled workflows is preferred.


**ELIGIBILITY**
 Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

 The Anaplan Center of Excellence (CoE) owns a portfolio of 50\+ connected planning applications used across Finance, Commercial, and Operations. * Build and maintain strong relationships with finance partners, commercial stakeholders, and other business functions; manage expectations, translate business priorities into a realistic delivery roadmap, and communicate status, risks, and trade\-offs transparently.

* Excellent documentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, including negotiation and relationship management, with the ability to drive achievement of objectives.
* Excellent problem\-solving, organizational, analytical, and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent understanding of and work experience with project budgets and financial management.
* Experience in life sciences, medical devices, or another regulated industry.

title: Mechanical Software Development Professional
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day.**
 As a Mechanical Software Development Professional, you are a key contributor to the development and maintenance of state\-of\-the\-art software applications that support product selection and automation within Siemens Energy. Your day involves collaborating with a global team of multidisciplinary experts, engaging in Agile Scrum development practices, and leveraging engineering and software development knowledge to deliver high\-quality solutions.
   

  

 You work closely with internal clients to understand requirements, transform them into robust software artifacts, and provide guidance and support to ensure project success. By fostering best practices and continuous improvement, you help drive innovation and operational excellence in engineering automation software development.
   

  

 The position reports to the Head of Core Compressor Tools and is based in Pune.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Design, develop, and unit test applications in accordance with established standards and methodologies (SCRUM, Extreme Programming).
* Guide team development efforts towards successful project delivery and coach others in best practices.
* Lead and participate in peer\-reviews of solution designs and related code.
* Migrate legacy applications to the latest technologies and develop integrations between applications.
* Maintain high standards of software quality within the team by establishing and promoting good practices.
* Collaborate with software developers, business analysts, and architects to plan, design, test, and maintain business applications.
* Develop high\-level architecture, generate UML documents (use\-case, class, sequence diagrams) as required.
* Leverage core engineering principles to realize engineering and design automation software solutions.
* Normalize and provide relational data to support engineering knowledge capture and represent complex mathematical models programmatically.
* Provide user support for deployed applications in the production environment


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering with at least 10\+ years of experience as a Mechanical Engineer, similar role in engineering for Turbo Machinery preferred.
* 5\+ years of experience in automated tool development, Java preferred.
* 2\+ years of experience in SQL Server database design and development.
* 2\+ years of experience working with GIT.
* Experience with Service Oriented Application (SOA) development.
* Proven communication, presentation, and mentoring skills.
* Willingness to travel internationally as required (up to 5%).


**About The Team**
 Our
 **Transformation of Industry** 
 division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities. Candidates want to learn about the divisions they will be joining–the structure, how it works together, and the role it plays in driving Siemens Energy’s mission forward.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies crafted in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our distributed team is committed to making balanced, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* All employees are automatically covered under the Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for Meal Card to all its employees which will be as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy as a part of CTC, tax saving measure
* Flexi Pay empowers employees with the choice to customize the amount in some of the salary components within a defined range thereby optimizing the tax benefits. Accordingly, each employee is empowered to decide on the best Possible net income out of the same fixed individual base pay on a monthly basis

* Tests multi\-tenant security boundaries, Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC), and authentication mechanisms across cloud\-managed and self\-managed backends.

**Technology**
* Graph Databases: Neo4j (Enterprise, Cypher, Causal Clustering) and exploration of alternative graph options.
* Testing Frameworks \& Tools: PyTest, Selenium/Playwright, RestAssured, Postman, JMeter / k6 for load testing.
* Data \& AI Stack: Vector Databases (e.g., Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone), Graph Databases (e.g., Neo4j), LLM Orchestration (LangChain, LlamaIndex), and Dataiku.
* Cloud \& Infrastructure: Microsoft Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
* Programming \& Scripting: Python or Java for test automation script development.
* Cloud Infrastructure: Microsoft Azure (Azure Marketplace, AKS, Azure VMs, Managed Disks, Key Vault, VNet peering).


**Previous Experience And Competencies**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related discipline.
* 6 – 10 years of strong QA engineering experience with a heavy focus on backend services, APIs, and data platforms.
* Proven experience testing modern AI/ML workloads, vector search systems, or graph\-based data architectures.

* Familiarity with testing non\-deterministic outputs of Large Language Models (LLMs) and evaluating Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline quality.
* Systematic problem\-solving approach, strong analytical mindset, and acute attention to detail.
* Experience working within platform engineering or foundational infrastructure teams.

**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.

* Strong knowledge of secure API and microservices design, validation, versioning, failure handling and distributed\-system fundamentals.
* Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, data modeling and transaction management.
* Experience with Azure, AWS or OCI; Git workflows; CI/CD; automated deployment; and environment\-based configuration.
* Experience with unit, integration and end\-to\-end testing, quality gates, code scanning and security scanning.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot production issues across browser, API, application, database and integration layers.
* Strong estimation, planning, risk\-management, stakeholder and technical\-communication skills.

* Event\-driven architecture and messaging technologies such as Kafka.
